items.q3: (الف) د کيمياوي تعادل د ثابت د بیان په مرسته به تاسو د کيمياوي تعامل لوری او اندازه څنګه وړاندوینه کوئ؟
items.a: (a) Compare the reaction quotient Q (the expression of K_c with the present concentrations) with K_c: if Q < K_c the reaction goes forward; if Q > K_c it goes backward; if Q = K_c the system is at equilibrium. The size of K_c shows the extent: K_c very large (> 10³) means the reaction is almost complete; very small (< 10⁻³) means hardly any product; intermediate means appreciable amounts of both.
items.e: Prediction using K_c.

items.q: (b) The equilibrium constant for the reaction, 2O₃ ⇌ 3O₂ is 1.0 × 10[scan obscured] at 25°C. Predict the extent of the formation of O₂ at room temperature.
items.q2: (ب) تعامل 2O₃ ⇌ 3O₂ کا توازنی مستقلہ 25°C پر 1.0 × 10[scan obscured] ہے۔ کمرے کے درجہ حرارت پر O₂ کی تشکیل کی حد کی پیش گوئی کریں۔
items.q3: (ب) د 2O₃ ⇌ 3O₂ تعامل د تعادل ثابت په 25°C کې 1.0 × 10[scan obscured] دی. د خونې په تودوخه کې د O₂ د جوړېدو اندازه وړاندوینه کړئ.
items.a: (b) For 2O₃ ⇌ 3O₂, K_c = [O₂]³/[O₃]² is enormous (about 10⁵⁵ or more at 25 °C), so the reaction goes practically to completion in the forward direction: at room temperature ozone is thermodynamically unstable and changes almost completely into oxygen (the rate may be slow without a catalyst).
items.e: The exponent is partly hidden in the scan.

items.q: Define acid, base and amphoteric substance.
items.q2: تیزاب، اساس اور ایمفوٹیرک مادے کی تعریف کریں۔
items.q3: اسید، القلي او امفوټریک مواد تعریف کړئ.
items.a: An acid is a substance that gives H⁺ ions in water (Arrhenius), a proton donor (Bronsted-Lowry) or an electron-pair acceptor (Lewis). A base gives OH⁻ ions in water, is a proton acceptor or an electron-pair donor. An amphoteric substance can act as both an acid and a base, e.g. water, HCO₃⁻, Al(OH)₃.
items.e: Definitions.

items.q: What is mean by relative strength of acid and bases?
items.q2: تیزابوں اور اساسوں کی اضافی قوت سے کیا مراد ہے؟
items.q3: د اسیدونو او القليو د نسبي قوت څخه څه مراد دی؟
items.a: The relative strength of an acid or base is its tendency to donate or accept a proton. A strong acid donates protons readily (HCl) and has a weak conjugate base; a weak acid (CH₃COOH) donates protons less readily. Strength is expressed by K_a for acids and K_b for bases.
items.e: Relative strength.

items.q: Define strength of acids and bases.
items.q2: تیزابوں اور اساسوں کی قوت کی تعریف کریں۔
items.q3: د اسیدونو او القليو قوت تعریف کړئ.
items.a: The strength of an acid is its ability to ionize (donate H⁺) in water: strong acids (HCl, HNO₃, H₂SO₄) ionize almost completely and weak acids (CH₃COOH, HCN) ionize only slightly. Similarly strong bases (NaOH, KOH) ionize completely and weak bases (NH₃) only partially. Strength is measured by K_a and K_b.
items.e: Strength of acids and bases.

items.q: Briefly explain amphoteric substance with examples.
items.q2: ایمفوٹیرک مادے کی مثالوں کے ساتھ مختصراً وضاحت کریں۔
items.q3: امفوټریک مواد په بېلګو سره په لنډه توګه تشریح کړئ.
items.a: An amphoteric substance can behave as an acid as well as a base. Water: H₂O + NH₃ ⇌ NH₄⁺ + OH⁻ (acts as an acid) and H₂O + HCl → H₃O⁺ + Cl⁻ (acts as a base). Other examples: HCO₃⁻, HS⁻, H₂PO₄⁻, Al(OH)₃, ZnO.
items.e: Amphoteric substances.

items.q: Give examples of Bronsted-Lowery concept for acids and bases.
items.q2: تیزابوں اور اساسوں کے لیے برونسٹڈ لوری تصور کی مثالیں دیں۔
items.q3: د اسیدونو او القليو لپاره د برونسټډ-لوري د مفکورې بېلګې ورکړئ.
items.a: According to Bronsted-Lowry, an acid is a proton donor and a base is a proton acceptor. Examples: HCl + H₂O → H₃O⁺ + Cl⁻ (HCl is the acid, H₂O the base); NH₃ + H₂O ⇌ NH₄⁺ + OH⁻ (NH₃ is the base, H₂O the acid); CH₃COOH + H₂O ⇌ CH₃COO⁻ + H₃O⁺.
items.e: Bronsted-Lowry concept.

items.q: What is relative strength of acids and bases?
items.q2: تیزابوں اور اساسوں کی اضافی قوت کیا ہے؟
items.q3: د اسیدونو او القليو نسبي قوت څه دی؟
items.a: The relative strength is the tendency of an acid to donate protons (or of a base to accept them). The stronger the acid, the weaker its conjugate base, and the stronger the base, the weaker its conjugate acid. HCl (strong acid) has a very weak conjugate base Cl⁻; acetic acid (weak) has a stronger conjugate base CH₃COO⁻.
items.e: Relative strengths.

items.q: What are conjugate acid – base pairs? Give their examples.
items.q2: مزدوج تیزاب اساس جوڑے کیا ہیں؟ ان کی مثالیں دیں۔
items.q3: مزدوج اسید-القلي جوړې څه دي؟ د هغوی بېلګې ورکړئ.
items.a: A conjugate acid-base pair consists of two species that differ by a single proton: the acid has one more H⁺ than its conjugate base. Examples: HCl/Cl⁻, H₂O/OH⁻, H₃O⁺/H₂O, NH₄⁺/NH₃, CH₃COOH/CH₃COO⁻.
items.e: Conjugate pairs.

items.q: Define ionization constant of water.
items.q2: پانی کے آئنائزیشن مستقلہ کی تعریف کریں۔
items.q3: د اوبو د آیونایزیشن ثابت تعریف کړئ.
items.a: Water ionizes slightly: 2H₂O ⇌ H₃O⁺ + OH⁻. The ionization constant (ion product) of water is K_w = [H⁺][OH⁻] = 1 × 10⁻¹⁴ mol² dm⁻⁶ at 25 °C.
items.e: Ion product of water.

items.q: Define pH, pOH and pK_w.
items.q2: pH، pOH اور pK_w کی تعریف کریں۔
items.q3: pH، pOH او pK_w تعریف کړئ.
items.a: pH is the negative logarithm (base 10) of the hydrogen ion concentration: pH = −log[H⁺]. pOH = −log[OH⁻]. pK_w = −log K_w = 14 at 25 °C, so pH + pOH = 14.
items.e: Definitions.

items.q: What is pK_a and pK_b?
items.q2: pK_a اور pK_b کیا ہیں؟
items.q3: pK_a او pK_b څه دي؟
items.a: pK_a = −log K_a and pK_b = −log K_b. K_a is the ionization constant of an acid and K_b of a base. A small pK_a means a strong acid; a small pK_b a strong base.
items.e: Definitions.

items.q: What is meant by leveling effect?
items.q2: برابری کے اثر سے کیا مراد ہے؟
items.q3: د برابرولو اغېز څخه څه مراد دی؟
items.a: The leveling effect is the tendency of a solvent to make all strong acids (or strong bases) appear to have the same strength: in water all acids stronger than H₃O⁺ (HCl, HBr, HNO₃, HClO₄) are completely ionized and give H₃O⁺, so their strengths cannot be differentiated.
items.e: Leveling effect.

items.q: What is K_w?
items.q2: K_w کیا ہے؟
items.q3: K_w څه دی؟
items.a: K_w is the ion product constant of water: K_w = [H⁺][OH⁻] = 1.0 × 10⁻¹⁴ mol² dm⁻⁶ at 25 °C; it increases with temperature.
items.e: Definition.

items.q: What are Lewis acids, explain it with examples?
items.q2: لیوس تیزاب کیا ہیں، مثالوں کے ساتھ وضاحت کریں؟
items.q3: لیویس اسیدونه څه دي، په بېلګو سره یې تشریح کړئ؟
items.a: A Lewis acid is a substance that accepts a pair of electrons. Examples: BF₃, AlCl₃ (electron-deficient molecules, incomplete octet), H⁺, Fe³⁺, Ag⁺ (cations) and SO₃.
items.e: Lewis acids.

items.q: What is the significance of Lewis concept? Explain it with suitable examples.
items.q2: لیوس تصور کی کیا اہمیت ہے؟ مناسب مثالوں کے ساتھ وضاحت کریں۔
items.q3: د لیویس مفکورې اهمیت څه دی؟ په مناسبو بېلګو سره یې تشریح کړئ.
items.a: The Lewis concept is more general: it explains acid-base behaviour without protons or water (e.g. BF₃ + :NH₃ → F₃B←NH₃), explains the acidity of molecules like CO₂ and SO₃, reactions in non-aqueous solvents, and the formation of coordinate covalent bonds and complex ions (Cu²⁺ + 4NH₃ → [Cu(NH₃)₄]²⁺).
items.e: Significance.

items.q: How the sum of pK_a and pK_b is equal to 14.
items.q2: pK_a اور pK_b کا مجموعہ 14 کے برابر کیسے ہے۔
items.q3: د pK_a او pK_b مجموعه له 14 سره څنګه مساوي ده.
items.a: For an acid HA and its conjugate base A⁻: K_a = [H⁺][A⁻]/[HA] and K_b = [HA][OH⁻]/[A⁻]. Multiplying: K_a × K_b = [H⁺][OH⁻] = K_w = 10⁻¹⁴. Taking −log of both sides: pK_a + pK_b = pK_w = 14.
items.e: Derivation.

items.q: What is buffer solution?
items.q2: بفر محلول کیا ہے؟
items.q3: بفر محلول څه دی؟
items.a: A buffer solution is a solution which resists a change in pH on the addition of a small amount of an acid or a base. It consists of a weak acid and its salt with a strong base (acidic buffer, e.g. CH₃COOH/CH₃COONa) or a weak base and its salt with a strong acid (basic buffer, e.g. NH₄OH/NH₄Cl).
items.e: Definition.

items.q: What is buffer action also write its application.
items.q2: بفر عمل کیا ہے، اس کا اطلاق بھی لکھیں۔
items.q3: د بفر عمل څه دی، د هغه کارونه هم ولیکئ.
items.a: Buffer action is the ability of a buffer to resist changes in its pH when small amounts of acid or base are added. Applications: maintaining the pH of blood (about 7.4) by the carbonic acid/bicarbonate buffer, in pharmaceuticals, in industrial processes (electroplating, dyeing), in analytical chemistry and in fermentation and in biological laboratories.
items.e: Buffer action.
items.x: 3. Salts of Weak Acids and Weak Bases

items.q: What is hydrolysis? Explain why aqueous solutions of some salts are acidic or basic.
items.q2: ہائیڈرولائسس کیا ہے؟ وضاحت کریں کہ کچھ نمکوں کے آبی محلول تیزابی یا اساسی کیوں ہوتے ہیں۔
items.q3: هایدرولیز څه دی؟ تشریح کړئ چې د ځینو مالګو اوبیز محلولونه ولې اسیدي یا القلي دي.
items.a: Hydrolysis is the reaction of the ions of a salt with water to give an acidic or basic solution. A salt of a strong acid and a weak base (NH₄Cl) gives an acidic solution (NH₄⁺ + H₂O ⇌ NH₃ + H₃O⁺); a salt of a weak acid and a strong base (CH₃COONa) gives a basic solution (CH₃COO⁻ + H₂O ⇌ CH₃COOH + OH⁻).
items.e: Salt hydrolysis.
items.x: 3. Salts of Weak Acids and Weak Bases

items.q: Explain why the solution of a salt is not necessarily neutral.
items.q2: وضاحت کریں کہ نمک کا محلول ضروری نہیں کہ معتدل ہو۔
items.q3: تشریح کړئ چې د مالګې محلول ولې اړینه نه ده چې خنثی وي.
items.a: The solution of a salt is not necessarily neutral because the ions may react with water (hydrolysis). Only salts of a strong acid and a strong base (NaCl) are neutral; salts of a weak acid or a weak base are basic or acidic, depending on which ion hydrolyses.
items.e: Salt hydrolysis.

items.q: What information would you use to support the view that water can act either as a weak acid or as a weak base?
items.q2: آپ کون سی معلومات استعمال کریں گے جو اس نظریے کی تائید کریں کہ پانی کمزور تیزاب یا کمزور اساس دونوں کی طرح کام کر سکتا ہے؟
items.q3: تاسو به کومه معلومات وکاروئ چې د دې نظر ملاتړ وکړي چې اوبه د ضعیف اسید یا ضعیف القلي په توګه عمل کولای شي؟
items.a: Water acts as a weak acid when it donates a proton to a stronger base (H₂O + NH₃ ⇌ NH₄⁺ + OH⁻) and as a weak base when it accepts a proton from a stronger acid (H₂O + HCl → H₃O⁺ + Cl⁻). Pure water ionizes slightly to give equal amounts of H₃O⁺ and OH⁻ (K_w = 10⁻¹⁴), which shows that it can both donate and accept protons.
items.e: Amphoteric nature of water.

items.q: Explain that why the sum of pK_a and pK_b is always equal to 14.
items.q2: وضاحت کریں کہ pK_a اور pK_b کا مجموعہ ہمیشہ 14 کے برابر کیوں ہوتا ہے۔
items.q3: تشریح کړئ چې د pK_a او pK_b مجموعه تل له 14 سره ولې مساوي وي.
items.a: For an acid and its conjugate base K_a × K_b = K_w. Taking logarithms with a negative sign: pK_a + pK_b = pK_w. At 25 °C, K_w = 10⁻¹⁴, so pK_w = 14 and pK_a + pK_b = 14.
items.e: Derivation.

items.q: Explain why the conjugate base of a strong acid is a weak base and the conjugate acid of a strong base is a weak acid.
items.q2: وضاحت کریں کہ مضبوط تیزاب کا مزدوج اساس کمزور اساس اور مضبوط اساس کا مزدوج تیزاب کمزور تیزاب کیوں ہوتا ہے۔
items.q3: تشریح کړئ چې د قوي اسید مزدوج القلي ولې ضعیف القلي او د قوي القلي مزدوج اسید ولې ضعیف اسید وي.
items.a: The stronger an acid, the more completely it gives up its proton, so its conjugate base has little tendency to take the proton back, thus it is a weak base (Cl⁻ from HCl). Likewise, a strong base has a strong tendency to hold a proton, so its conjugate acid has little tendency to give it back, thus it is a weak acid.
items.e: Conjugate pairs.

items.q: Justify your answer with equations that CH₃COONa gives a basic solution while NH₄Cl an acidic solution in water.
items.q2: معادلات کے ساتھ اپنے جواب کی توجیہ کریں کہ CH₃COONa پانی میں اساسی محلول دیتا ہے جبکہ NH₄Cl تیزابی محلول۔
items.q3: خپل ځواب په معادلو سره توجیه کړئ چې CH₃COONa په اوبو کې القلي محلول ورکوي پداسې حال کې چې NH₄Cl اسیدي محلول.
items.a: CH₃COONa is the salt of a weak acid and a strong base: CH₃COO⁻ + H₂O ⇌ CH₃COOH + OH⁻; the excess OH⁻ makes the solution basic. NH₄Cl is the salt of a strong acid and a weak base: NH₄⁺ + H₂O ⇌ NH₃ + H₃O⁺; the excess H₃O⁺ makes it acidic.
items.e: Hydrolysis equations.

items.q: Why do you call AlCl₃ and BF₃ as Lewis acids, Cl⁻ and NH₃ as Lewis bases?
items.q2: آپ AlCl₃ اور BF₃ کو لیوس تیزاب اور Cl⁻ اور NH₃ کو لیوس اساس کیوں کہتے ہیں؟
items.q3: تاسو AlCl₃ او BF₃ ولې لیویس اسیدونه او Cl⁻ او NH₃ ولې لیویس القلي بولئ؟
items.a: AlCl₃ and BF₃ are electron-deficient (the central atom has only six electrons in the outer shell), so they accept a pair of electrons: Lewis acids. Cl⁻ and NH₃ have lone pairs of electrons which they can donate: Lewis bases. Example: BF₃ + :NH₃ → F₃B←NH₃; AlCl₃ + Cl⁻ → AlCl₄⁻.
items.e: Lewis concept.

items.q: (a) What is Bronsted–Lowery acids and bases? Explain it with suitable examples.
items.q2: (الف) برونسٹڈ لوری تیزاب اور اساس کیا ہیں؟ مناسب مثالوں کے ساتھ وضاحت کریں۔
items.q3: (الف) برونسټډ-لوري اسیدونه او القلي څه دي؟ په مناسبو بېلګو سره یې تشریح کړئ.
items.a: Bronsted-Lowry acids are proton donors and bases are proton acceptors. HCl + H₂O → H₃O⁺ + Cl⁻ (HCl acid, H₂O base); NH₃ + H₂O ⇌ NH₄⁺ + OH⁻ (NH₃ base, H₂O acid). Each acid has a conjugate base and each base a conjugate acid.
items.e: Bronsted-Lowry concept.

items.q: (b) Write equations and indicate the conjugate acid – base pairs for the following; (i) Acetic acid and water, (ii) Ammonia and hydrochloric acid
items.q2: (ب) درج ذیل کے لیے مساواتیں لکھیں اور مزدوج تیزاب اساس جوڑے ظاہر کریں؛ (i) ایسیٹک ایسڈ اور پانی، (ii) امونیا اور ہائیڈروکلورک ایسڈ
items.q3: (ب) د لاندې لپاره معادلې ولیکئ او مزدوج اسید-القلي جوړې وښیئ؛ (i) اسیټیک اسید او اوبه، (ii) امونیا او هایدروکلوریک اسید
items.a: (i) CH₃COOH + H₂O ⇌ CH₃COO⁻ + H₃O⁺: acid CH₃COOH with conjugate base CH₃COO⁻; base H₂O with conjugate acid H₃O⁺. (ii) NH₃ + HCl → NH₄⁺ + Cl⁻: base NH₃ with conjugate acid NH₄⁺; acid HCl with conjugate base Cl⁻.
items.e: Conjugate pairs.

items.q: Justify that NH₃ is a base according to Lewis concept.
items.q2: (ج) لیوس تصور کے مطابق ثابت کریں کہ NH₃ اساس ہے۔
items.q3: (ج) د لیویس مفکورې له مخې ثابته کړئ چې NH₃ القلي دی.
items.a: NH₃ has a lone pair of electrons on nitrogen which it can donate to an electron-deficient species (H⁺, BF₃, Ag⁺), so it is a Lewis base: NH₃ + H⁺ → NH₄⁺; NH₃ + BF₃ → H₃N→BF₃.
items.e: Lewis concept.

items.q: (a) Define buffer solution. What is buffer action and show with equations how a buffer system works?
items.q2: (الف) بفر محلول کی تعریف کریں۔ بفر عمل کیا ہے اور مساواتوں کے ساتھ دکھائیں کہ بفر نظام کیسے کام کرتا ہے؟
items.q3: (الف) بفر محلول تعریف کړئ. د بفر عمل څه دی او په معادلو سره وښیئ چې د بفر سیسټم څنګه کار کوي؟
items.a: A buffer solution resists a change in pH on addition of small amounts of acid or base. Buffer action (acidic buffer CH₃COOH/CH₃COO⁻): on adding H⁺, the acetate ions combine with it: CH₃COO⁻ + H⁺ → CH₃COOH; on adding OH⁻, the acetic acid neutralises it: CH₃COOH + OH⁻ → CH₃COO⁻ + H₂O. In both cases the concentration ratio changes only slightly, so the pH remains almost constant.
items.e: Buffer.

items.q: (b) What are the applications of buffers solutions?
items.q2: (ب) بفر محلولوں کے اطلاقات کیا ہیں؟
items.q3: (ب) د بفر محلولونو کارونې څه دي؟
items.a: Applications of buffer solutions: (1) blood is buffered at pH 7.4 by the carbonic acid-bicarbonate and phosphate buffers; (2) used in preparation of medicines, injections and eye drops; (3) used in industries such as dyeing, electroplating, leather and fermentation; (4) used in analytical chemistry to keep the pH constant; (5) calibration of pH meters.
items.e: Uses.

items.q: an acid or a base is added.
items.q2: تیزاب یا اساس شامل کیا جائے۔
items.q3: اسید یا القلي اضافه شي.
items.a: Take a buffer made of a weak acid HA and its salt A⁻. On adding a small amount of acid (H⁺): A⁻ + H⁺ → HA, so H⁺ is used up and the pH changes only slightly. On adding a small amount of base (OH⁻): HA + OH⁻ → A⁻ + H₂O, so OH⁻ is removed. As the buffer contains a large reserve of both HA and A⁻ the ratio [A⁻]/[HA] hardly changes, so the pH remains almost constant.
items.e: Henderson equation: pH = pK_a + log([salt]/[acid]).

items.q: (a) Briefly describe the leveling effect.
items.q2: (الف) برابری کے اثر کو مختصراً بیان کریں۔
items.q3: (الف) د برابرولو اغېز په لنډه توګه بیان کړئ.
items.a: Leveling effect: in a given solvent all acids stronger than the solvent's conjugate acid appear to have the same strength. In water, HCl, HBr and HNO₃ are completely ionized and give H₃O⁺, so their strength is levelled to that of H₃O⁺.
items.e: Leveling effect.

items.q: (b) What is the relationship between K_a and K_b?
items.q2: (ب) K_a اور K_b کے درمیان کیا تعلق ہے؟
items.q3: (ب) د K_a او K_b ترمنځ اړیکه څه ده؟
items.a: K_a × K_b = K_w for a conjugate pair; at 25 °C K_a × K_b = 10⁻¹⁴, so a strong acid has a weak conjugate base.
items.e: Relationship.

items.q: Write the equation relating K_a for a weak acid and K_b for its conjugate base. Use NH₃ and its conjugate acid NH₄⁺ to derive the relationship betwe[scan obscured] K_a and K_b.
items.q2: (ج) کمزور تیزاب کے K_a اور اس کے مزدوج اساس کے K_b کو جوڑنے والی مساوات لکھیں۔ NH₃ اور اس کے مزدوج تیزاب NH₄⁺ کو استعمال کر کے K_a اور K_b کے درمیان تعلق [scan obscured] اخذ کریں۔
items.q3: (ج) د ضعیف اسید K_a او د هغه د مزدوج القلي K_b سره تړونکې معادله ولیکئ. NH₃ او د هغه مزدوج اسید NH₄⁺ وکاروئ ترڅو د K_a او K_b ترمنځ اړیکه [scan obscured] استنباط کړئ.
items.a: For NH₃ + H₂O ⇌ NH₄⁺ + OH⁻: K_b = [NH₄⁺][OH⁻]/[NH₃]. For NH₄⁺ + H₂O ⇌ NH₃ + H₃O⁺: K_a = [NH₃][H₃O⁺]/[NH₄⁺]. Multiplying: K_a × K_b = [H₃O⁺][OH⁻] = K_w = 1 × 10⁻¹⁴.
items.e: Relationship between K_a and K_b.

items.q: (a) What is meant by the term amphoteric? Give an example of a substanc[scan obscured] or ion with amphoteric characteristics.
items.q2: (الف) ایمفوٹیرک کی اصطلاح سے کیا مراد ہے؟ ایمفوٹیرک خصوصیات والے مادے [scan obscured] یا آئن کی مثال دیں۔
items.q3: (الف) د امفوټریک له اصطلاح څخه څه مراد دی؟ د امفوټریک ځانګړنو لرونکي مادې [scan obscured] یا آیون یوه بېلګه ورکړئ.
items.a: An amphoteric substance can act as an acid or a base. Example: water (H₂O + HCl → H₃O⁺ + Cl⁻; H₂O + NH₃ ⇌ NH₄⁺ + OH⁻); bicarbonate ion HCO₃⁻ (donates H⁺ to form CO₃²⁻ or accepts H⁺ to form H₂CO₃); also Al(OH)₃ and ZnO.
items.e: Amphoteric.

items.q: (b) Define pH, pOH, pK_a and pK_b.
items.q2: (ب) pH، pOH، pK_a اور pK_b کی تعریف کریں۔
items.q3: (ب) pH، pOH، pK_a او pK_b تعریف کړئ.
items.a: pH = −log[H⁺]; pOH = −log[OH⁻]; pK_a = −log K_a (of an acid); pK_b = −log K_b (of a base). At 25 °C, pH + pOH = 14.
items.e: Definitions.

items.q: Differentiate between first order and second order reactions.

items.a: A first order reaction has a rate proportional to the first power of one concentration, rate = k[A]; its rate constant has the unit s⁻¹ and the half-life is constant (0.693/k). A second order reaction has a rate proportional to the square of one concentration or the product of two, rate = k[A]² or k[A][B]; k has the unit dm³ mol⁻¹ s⁻¹ and the half-life depends on the initial concentration.
items.e: Comparison.

items.q: Name the factors affecting the rate of reaction.

items.a: Factors affecting the rate of reaction: (1) nature of the reactants; (2) concentration of the reactants (or pressure for gases); (3) temperature; (4) surface area (particle size) of solids; (5) presence of a catalyst; (6) light (photochemical reactions).
items.e: Factors.

items.q: Explain the effect of temperature on rate of reaction with graph.
items.q2: گراف کے ساتھ تعامل کی شرح پر درجہ حرارت کے اثر کی وضاحت کریں۔
items.q3: د ګراف سره د تعامل په چټکتیا د تودوخې اغېز تشریح کړئ.
items.a: With a rise in temperature the average kinetic energy of molecules increases, so a larger fraction of molecules has energy greater than or equal to the activation energy and the collisions are more frequent; the rate roughly doubles for each 10 °C rise. The graph of rate (or rate constant) against temperature is a curve rising steeply (exponential, Arrhenius equation k = Ae^(−Ea/RT)); the Maxwell-Boltzmann curve shifts to the right, increasing the area beyond the activation energy.
items.e: Effect of temperature.

items.q: Define activation energy and transition state.
items.q2: توانائی دہلیز اور عبوری حالت کی تعریف کریں۔
items.q3: د فعالولو انرژي او انتقالي حالت تعریف کړئ.
items.a: Activation energy is the minimum energy that colliding molecules must have for a collision to result in a reaction. The transition state (activated complex) is the unstable, high-energy intermediate arrangement of atoms formed at the top of the energy barrier, which either breaks into the products or goes back to the reactants.
items.e: Definitions.

items.q: Differentiate between homogenous and heterogenous catalysis.

items.a: Homogeneous catalysis: the catalyst is in the same phase as the reactants (e.g. NO gas catalysing SO₂ to SO₃ in the lead chamber process, H⁺ in ester hydrolysis). Heterogeneous catalysis: the catalyst is in a different phase (e.g. solid iron in the Haber process, solid Pt in the catalytic converter, V₂O₅ in the contact process).
items.e: Types of catalysis.

items.q: Explain why a molecular collision should be sufficiently energetic to cause a reaction.
items.q2: وضاحت کریں کہ سالماتی ٹکراؤ تعامل پیدا کرنے کے لیے کافی توانائی والا کیوں ہونا چاہیے۔

items.a: Molecules must collide with enough energy (at least the activation energy) to break the existing bonds and form the new ones. If the collision energy is lower, the molecules just bounce apart without reaction, because the repulsion between the electron clouds is not overcome.
items.e: Collision theory.

items.q: Name the four factors that increase the rate of reaction.

items.a: Four factors that increase the rate of a reaction: (1) an increase in the concentration of the reactants; (2) an increase in temperature; (3) an increase in the surface area of solid reactants (smaller particles); (4) the use of a suitable catalyst.
items.e: Factors.

items.a: By collision theory, an increase in temperature increases the average kinetic energy and speed of the molecules, so (1) they collide more frequently and (2) a much larger fraction of the collisions have energy at least equal to the activation energy. The number of effective collisions increases, so the rate increases.
items.e: Collision theory.

items.q3: ب. د ګاز A د مالیکولونو شمېر دوه برابر شي.
items.a: If the number of molecules of A is doubled, the number of collisions between A and B doubles, so the rate of the reaction also doubles (for a reaction first order in A).
items.e: Effect of concentration.

items.q: The temperature is decreased by 10 °C
items.q2: ج۔ درجہ حرارت 10 °C کم کر دیا جائے
items.q3: ج. تودوخه 10 °C کمه شي
items.a: If the temperature is decreased by 10 °C, the molecules have lower kinetic energy, so fewer collisions are effective and the rate is reduced to about one half.
items.e: Effect of temperature.

items.q: a. What is the overall order of the reaction?
items.q2: الف۔ تعامل کا مجموعی درجہ کیا ہے؟
items.q3: الف. د تعامل ټولیزه درجه څه ده؟
items.e: The reaction is first order in CO and first order in NO₂, so the overall order is 1 + 1 = 2.

items.q: b. What is the rate of the reaction at 400 °C when the concentration of CO is 0.025 mol dm⁻³ and that of NO₂ is 0.040 mol dm⁻³? (Ans: 5×10⁻⁴ mol dm⁻³sec⁻¹[scan obscured])
items.q2: ب۔ 400 °C پر تعامل کی شرح کیا ہے جب CO کا ارتکاز 0.025 mol dm⁻³ اور NO₂ کا 0.040 mol dm⁻³ ہو؟ (جواب: 5×10⁻⁴ mol dm⁻³sec⁻¹[scan obscured])
items.q3: ب. په 400 °C کې د تعامل چټکتیا څومره ده کله چې د CO غلظت 0.025 mol dm⁻³ او د NO₂ 0.040 mol dm⁻³ وي؟ (ځواب: 5×10⁻⁴ mol dm⁻³sec⁻¹[scan obscured])
items.e: Answer 5 × 10⁻⁴ mol dm⁻³ s⁻¹.

items.q: Explain briefly why all collisions between reactant molecules do not lead t[scan obscured] reaction?
items.q2: مختصراً وضاحت کریں کہ تعامل کنندہ سالموں کے درمیان تمام ٹکراؤ تعامل تک کیوں نہیں پہنچاتے [scan obscured]؟
items.q3: په لنډه توګه تشریح کړئ چې د متعامل مالیکولونو ترمنځ ټول ټکرونه ولې تعامل ته نه رسوي [scan obscured]؟
items.a: In a gas, the molecules collide very often, but only a small fraction of collisions are effective. A collision leads to a reaction only if the colliding molecules have energy at least equal to the activation energy and the molecules collide with the proper orientation for the bonds to break and form.
items.e: Collision theory.

items.q: a. Rate of the reaction
items.q2: الف۔ تعامل کی شرح
items.q3: الف. د تعامل چټکتیا
items.a: The rate of a reaction is the change in the concentration of a reactant or product per unit time, e.g. rate = −Δ[reactant]/Δt = Δ[product]/Δt, in mol dm⁻³ s⁻¹.
items.e: Definition.

items.q: b. Rate constant.
items.q2: ب۔ شرحی مستقلہ۔
items.q3: ب. د چټکتیا ثابت.
items.a: The rate constant (k) is the proportionality constant in the rate equation; it is the rate of reaction when the concentration of each reactant is unity (1 mol dm⁻³). It depends on temperature and the catalyst but not on concentration.
items.e: Definition.

items.q: Order of the reaction.
items.q2: ج۔ تعامل کا درجہ۔
items.q3: ج. د تعامل درجه.
items.a: The order of a reaction is the sum of the exponents of the concentrations in the rate law (rate = k[A]^m[B]^n has order m + n); it is determined by experiment: zero, first, second order.
items.e: Definition.

items.q: d. Rate law or rate equation.
items.q2: د۔ شرحی قانون یا شرحی مساوات۔
items.q3: د. د چټکتیا قانون یا د چټکتیا معادله.
items.a: The rate law (rate equation) is the mathematical expression which relates the rate of a reaction to the concentrations of the reactants raised to appropriate powers: rate = k[A]^m[B]^n.
items.e: Definition.

items.q: e. Catalyst
items.q2: ہ۔ اتپریرک
items.q3: ه. کتلیست
items.a: A catalyst is a substance that changes the rate of a reaction without itself being used up in the reaction. A positive catalyst increases the rate by providing a path with lower activation energy; a negative catalyst (inhibitor) decreases it.
items.e: Definition.

items.q: Q2: (a) Define the activation energy. What role does it play in chemical reaction[scan obscured]
items.q2: سوال 2: (الف) توانائی دہلیز کی تعریف کریں۔ کیمیائی تعامل میں یہ کیا کردار ادا کرتی ہے [scan obscured]
items.q3: پوښتنه 2: (الف) د فعالولو انرژي تعریف کړئ. په کيمياوي تعامل کې دا کوم رول لوبوي [scan obscured]
items.a: (a) Activation energy is the minimum energy that the reacting molecules must possess before their collisions can lead to a chemical change. It acts as an energy barrier: the lower the activation energy, the faster the reaction.
items.e: Definition.

items.q: (b) Household gas (methane) burns in the presence of oxygen and gives ene[scan obscured] for our daily use. If a mixture of methane and oxygen is kept in a contai[scan obscured] for indefinite period, no reaction takes place, explain?
items.q2: (ب) گھریلو گیس (میتھین) آکسیجن کی موجودگی میں جلتی ہے اور ہماری روزمرہ کے استعمال کے لیے توانائی [scan obscured] دیتی ہے۔ اگر میتھین اور آکسیجن کا آمیزہ برتن میں [scan obscured] غیر معینہ مدت تک رکھا جائے تو کوئی تعامل نہیں ہوتا، وضاحت کریں؟
items.q3: (ب) کورنۍ ګاز (میتان) د اکسیجن په شتون کې سوځي او زموږ د ورځني کارونې لپاره انرژي [scan obscured] ورکوي. که د میتان او اکسیجن مخلوط په یوه لوښي کې [scan obscured] د نامحدودې مودې لپاره وساتل شي نو هېڅ تعامل نه پېښېږي، تشریح کړئ؟
items.a: (b) Methane and oxygen in a container do not react at room temperature because the collisions of molecules do not have the necessary activation energy (to break the strong C-H and O=O bonds). When a spark or flame supplies this energy, the reaction starts and the heat evolved keeps it going.
items.e: Activation energy.

items.q: Q3: Explain how does a catalyst increase the rate of a reaction? Compar[scan obscured] catalyzed and un-catalyzed reaction on a potential energy diagram.
items.q2: سوال 3: وضاحت کریں کہ اتپریرک تعامل کی شرح کیسے بڑھاتا ہے؟ اتپریری اور غیر اتپریری [scan obscured] تعامل کا مخفی توانائی کے خاکے پر موازنہ کریں۔
items.q3: پوښتنه 3: تشریح کړئ چې کتلیست د تعامل چټکتیا څنګه زیاتوي؟ د کتلیستي او غیر کتلیستي [scan obscured] تعامل په پوټنشیل انرژۍ انځور پرتله کړئ.
items.a: A catalyst provides an alternative route with a lower activation energy (a lower energy barrier), so a greater fraction of molecules has enough energy and the rate rises, while ΔH is unchanged. On the potential energy diagram the uncatalysed reaction has a high peak, the catalysed one a lower peak; the energies of reactants and products are the same.
items.e: Catalyst.

items.q: Q4: Explain the relationship between reactant concentration and rate of[scan obscured] reaction.
items.q2: سوال 4: تعامل کنندہ کے ارتکاز اور تعامل کی شرح کے درمیان تعلق کی وضاحت کریں [scan obscured]۔
items.q3: پوښتنه 4: د متعامل د غلظت او د تعامل د چټکتیا ترمنځ اړیکه تشریح کړئ [scan obscured].
items.a: The rate of a reaction increases with the concentration of the reactants because more molecules per unit volume give more frequent collisions. The relationship is given by the rate law, rate = k[A]^m[B]^n: for a first order reaction doubling the concentration doubles the rate; for second order it increases four times; for zero order the rate is independent of concentration.
items.e: Concentration and rate.

items.q: Q5: Discuss why, (according to collision theory of chemical reactions) s[scan obscured] molecular collisions result in a chemical reaction while others do not. D[scan obscured] and explain a reaction energy diagram (reaction profile) for
items.q2: سوال 5: بحث کریں کہ (کیمیائی تعاملات کے تصادمی نظریے کے مطابق) کچھ [scan obscured] سالماتی ٹکراؤ کیمیائی تعامل کا باعث کیوں بنتے ہیں جبکہ دوسرے نہیں۔ ڈرا [scan obscured] کریں اور تعاملی توانائی کے خاکے (تعاملی پروفائل) کی وضاحت کریں
items.q3: پوښتنه 5: بحث وکړئ چې (د کيمياوي تعاملاتو د ټکر د تیورۍ له مخې) ځینې [scan obscured] مالیکولي ټکرونه ولې کيمياوي تعامل ته رسوي پداسې حال کې چې نور نه. رسم [scan obscured] کړئ او د تعامل د انرژۍ انځور (د تعامل پروفایل) تشریح کړئ لپاره
items.a: According to collision theory, a reaction takes place only when molecules collide with energy at least equal to the activation energy and with the correct orientation; most collisions are ineffective. On a reaction profile the energy of reactants rises to a maximum (activation energy, transition state) and then falls to the products. See the diagrams for the exothermic and endothermic reactions in the following parts.
items.e: Collision theory.

items.q: a. an exothermic reaction.
items.q2: الف۔ حرارت خارج کرنے والا تعامل۔
items.q3: الف. تودوخه خوشې کوونکی تعامل.
items.a: An exothermic reaction: the products are at a lower energy than the reactants, so ΔH is negative; the curve rises to a peak (activation energy Ea) and then falls to a lower level, the difference being the heat released.
items.e: Reaction profile.

items.q: b. an endothermic reaction.
items.q2: ب۔ حرارت جذب کرنے والا تعامل۔
items.q3: ب. تودوخه جذبوونکی تعامل.
items.a: An endothermic reaction: the products are at a higher energy than the reactants, so ΔH is positive; the curve rises to a peak and then falls to a level above that of the reactants; the activation energy of the forward reaction is smaller than that of the reverse reaction.
items.e: Reaction profile.

items.q: a. position of the energy of reactants
items.q2: الف۔ تعامل کنندگان کی توانائی کا مقام
items.q3: الف. د متعاملینو د انرژۍ موقعیت
items.a: On the vertical (potential energy) axis the reactants are shown at the starting level on the left of the diagram.
items.e: Position of the reactants' energy.

items.q: b. position of the energy of products
items.q2: ب۔ حاصلات کی توانائی کا مقام
items.q3: ب. د محصولاتو د انرژۍ موقعیت
items.a: The products are shown at the end level on the right: lower than the reactants in an exothermic reaction and higher in an endothermic one.
items.e: Position of the products' energy.

items.q: activation energy.
items.q2: ج۔ توانائی دہلیز۔
items.q3: ج. د فعالولو انرژي.
items.a: Activation energy (Ea) is the vertical height from the energy of the reactants to the top of the peak (transition state).
items.e: Activation energy.

items.q: d. ΔH of the reaction.
items.q2: د۔ تعامل کا ΔH۔
items.q3: د. د تعامل ΔH.
items.a: ΔH is the difference between the energy of the products and that of the reactants: ΔH = H(products) − H(reactants), negative (downward arrow) for exothermic and positive (upward arrow) for endothermic reactions.
items.e: Heat of reaction.

items.q: The conversion of X to Y follows second order kinetics. If concentration X is increased 3 times to what factor the rate of formation of Y will be increased. (Ans. 9 times)
items.q2: X کی Y میں تبدیلی دوسرے درجے کی حرکیات کی پیروی کرتی ہے۔ اگر X کا ارتکاز 3 گنا بڑھا دیا جائے تو Y کی تشکیل کی شرح کتنے گنا بڑھ جائے گی۔ (جواب: 9 گنا)
items.q3: د X له Y ته بدلون د دویمې درجې کینیټیکس تعقیبوي. که د X غلظت 3 ځله زیات شي نو د Y د جوړېدو چټکتیا به څو برابره زیاته شي. (ځواب: 9 ځله)
items.a: For second order kinetics the rate = k[X]². If [X] is increased 3 times, the rate increases (3)² = 9 times.
items.e: Answer 9 times.

items.q: A first order reaction (A → Product) has a rate of 0.008 Ms⁻¹ with [A]=0.002 M. what is the rate constant for this reaction? (Ans. 4 s⁻¹)
items.q2: ایک پہلے درجے کے تعامل (A → حاصل) کی شرح 0.008 Ms⁻¹ ہے جبکہ [A]=0.002 M ہے۔ اس تعامل کا شرحی مستقلہ کیا ہے؟ (جواب: 4 s⁻¹)
items.q3: یو لومړۍ درجې تعامل (A → محصول) چټکتیا 0.008 Ms⁻¹ لري کله چې [A]=0.002 M وي. د دې تعامل د چټکتیا ثابت څومره دی؟ (ځواب: 4 s⁻¹)
items.a: For a first order reaction rate = k[A], so k = rate / [A] = 0.008 / 0.002 = 4 s⁻¹.
items.e: Answer 4 s⁻¹.

items.q: (b) If the rate of decomposition of N₂O₅ at a particular instant is 4.2×10⁻⁷ Ms⁻¹, what is the rate of appearance of (a) NO₂ (b) O₂? (Ans.(a) 8.4×10⁻⁷Ms⁻¹ (b) 2.1×10⁻⁷Ms⁻¹)
items.q2: (ب) اگر کسی خاص لمحے پر N₂O₅ کی تحلیل کی شرح 4.2×10⁻⁷ Ms⁻¹ ہو تو (الف) NO₂ (ب) O₂ کے ظاہر ہونے کی شرح کیا ہے؟ (جواب: (الف) 8.4×10⁻⁷Ms⁻¹ (ب) 2.1×10⁻⁷Ms⁻¹)
items.q3: (ب) که په یوه ځانګړې شېبه کې د N₂O₅ د تجزیې چټکتیا 4.2×10⁻⁷ Ms⁻¹ وي نو د (الف) NO₂ (ب) O₂ د ښکارېدو چټکتیا څومره ده؟ (ځواب: (الف) 8.4×10⁻⁷Ms⁻¹ (ب) 2.1×10⁻⁷Ms⁻¹)
items.a: 2N₂O₅ → 4NO₂ + O₂. The rate of appearance of NO₂ = 4/2 × rate of decomposition of N₂O₅ = 2 × 4.2 × 10⁻⁷ = 8.4 × 10⁻⁷ M s⁻¹. The rate of appearance of O₂ = ½ × 4.2 × 10⁻⁷ = 2.1 × 10⁻⁷ M s⁻¹.
items.e: Answers (a) 8.4 × 10⁻⁷ M s⁻¹, (b) 2.1 × 10⁻⁷ M s⁻¹.

items.q: Differentiate between solution, suspension and colloids.
items.q2: محلول، معلق اور کولائیڈز میں فرق کریں۔
items.q3: د محلول، معلق او کلوایډونو ترمنځ توپیر وکړئ.
items.a: Solution: a homogeneous mixture with particles smaller than 1 nm (ions or molecules), transparent, does not scatter light, does not settle and cannot be separated by filtration (salt in water). Colloid: a heterogeneous-looking mixture with particles of 1 to 1000 nm; scatters light (Tyndall effect), does not settle, passes through ordinary filter paper but not through parchment (milk, fog, ink). Suspension: particles larger than 1000 nm, visible, settles on standing, scatters or blocks light and is filtered (muddy water, chalk in water).
items.e: Comparison.

items.q: Give example of each type of solutions of liquids in liquids.
items.q2: مائعات کے مائعات میں محلولوں کی ہر قسم کی مثال دیں۔
items.q3: د مایعاتو په مایعاتو کې د محلولونو د هر ډول بېلګه ورکړئ.
items.a: Examples of solutions of liquids in liquids: completely miscible liquids (alcohol in water, benzene in toluene); partially miscible liquids (phenol in water, ether in water); immiscible liquids (oil and water, which do not form a solution).
items.e: Types.

items.q: Explain the effect of temperature and pressure on solubility.
items.q2: حلالیت پر درجہ حرارت اور دباؤ کے اثر کی وضاحت کریں۔
items.q3: په حلالیت د تودوخې او فشار اغېز تشریح کړئ.
items.a: Effect of temperature: for most solids the solubility increases with temperature (endothermic dissolution), e.g. KNO₃; a few, such as Ce₂(SO₄)₃ and Ca(OH)₂, are less soluble when hot; the solubility of gases in liquids decreases when the temperature rises. Effect of pressure: it has almost no effect on solids and liquids, but the solubility of a gas in a liquid is directly proportional to the pressure (Henry's law), e.g. carbonated drinks.
items.e: Solubility.

items.q: In how many ways, percentage of solution can be expressed.
items.q2: محلول کی فیصد کتنے طریقوں سے ظاہر کی جا سکتی ہے۔
items.q3: د محلول سلنه په څو لارو ښودل کېدای شي.
items.a: The percentage of a solution can be expressed in four ways: (1) % mass/mass (w/w), (2) % mass/volume (w/v), (3) % volume/volume (v/v), (4) % volume/mass (v/w).
items.e: Concentration units.

items.q: Differentiate between molarity (M) and Molality (m).
items.q2: مولریت (M) اور مولیلٹی (m) میں فرق کریں۔
items.q3: د مولاریت (M) او مولالیت (m) ترمنځ توپیر وکړئ.
items.a: Molarity (M) is the number of moles of solute dissolved in one dm³ (litre) of the solution, M = moles / volume of solution (dm³); it changes with temperature since the volume changes. Molality (m) is the number of moles of solute dissolved in 1 kg of the solvent, m = moles / mass of solvent (kg); it does not change with temperature.
items.e: Difference.

items.q: Define colligative properties.
items.q2: کولیگیٹو خصوصیات کی تعریف کریں۔
items.q3: همغږې ځانګړنې تعریف کړئ.
items.a: Colligative properties are the properties of dilute solutions that depend only on the number of solute particles (the concentration) and not on their nature.
items.e: Definition.

items.q: Name some of the colligative properties of a dilute solution.
items.q2: ہلکے محلول کی کچھ کولیگیٹو خصوصیات کے نام بتائیں۔
items.q3: د رقیق محلول ځینې همغږې ځانګړنې نوم واخلئ.
items.a: The colligative properties of a dilute solution are: lowering of vapour pressure, elevation of boiling point, depression of freezing point and osmotic pressure.
items.e: List.

items.q: What is reverse osmosis.
items.q2: الٹی اسموسس کیا ہے۔
items.q3: معکوس اسموسس څه دی.
items.a: Reverse osmosis is the flow of the solvent from the solution (higher concentration) to the pure solvent through a semi-permeable membrane when a pressure greater than the osmotic pressure is applied to the solution side. It is used for desalination of sea water and water purification.
items.e: Definition.

items.q: Differentiate between Lyophilic and Lyophobic colloids.
items.q2: لائیوفلک اور لائیوفوبک کولائیڈز میں فرق کریں۔
items.q3: د لایوفیلیک او لایوفوبیک کلوایډونو ترمنځ توپیر وکړئ.
items.a: Lyophilic colloids (solvent-loving) have a strong attraction between the dispersed phase and the dispersion medium; they are stable, reversible, are not easily precipitated by electrolytes (gelatin, starch, gum, proteins in water). Lyophobic colloids (solvent-hating) have a weak attraction, are unstable and irreversible, and are precipitated easily by a small amount of electrolyte (gold sol, arsenic sulphide, ferric hydroxide sol).
items.e: Comparison.

items.q: What are the basis for the classification of colloids?
items.q2: کولائیڈز کی درجہ بندی کی بنیادیں کیا ہیں؟
items.q3: د کلوایډونو د طبقه بندۍ بنسټونه کوم دي؟
items.a: Colloids are classified on the basis of (1) the physical states of the dispersed phase and the dispersion medium (sol, gel, emulsion, aerosol, foam); (2) the affinity (interaction) between the dispersed phase and the dispersion medium (lyophilic and lyophobic); and (3) the size and nature of the particles (multimolecular, macromolecular and associated colloids).
items.e: Classification.

items.q: In atmospheric gaseous solution, nitrogen is a
items.q2: فضا کے گیسی محلول میں نائٹروجن ہے a۔ محلل b۔ محلول شدہ شے c۔ آمیزہ d۔ منتشر فیز
items.q3: په اتموسفیري ګازي محلول کې نایټروجن دی
items.e: Nitrogen (78 %) is the major component of air.

items.q: In ice cream, sugar is
items.q2: آئس کریم میں چینی ہے a۔ محلول شدہ شے b۔ آمیزہ c۔ محلل d۔ کوئی نہیں
items.q3: په آیس کریم کې بوره ده
items.e: Sugar is dissolved in the ice cream (the solvent is water).

items.q: Elevation of boiling point is a property
items.q2: نقطۂ جوش میں اضافہ ایک خاصیت ہے a۔ جمعی b۔ ترکیبی c۔ کولیگیٹو d۔ کوئی نہیں
items.q3: د جوش د نقطې لوړېدل یوه ځانګړنه ده
items.e: It depends on the number of solute particles.

items.q: Change in enthalpy, ΔH_sol, is heat of solution which is
items.q2: انتھالپی میں تبدیلی ΔH_sol محلول کی حرارت ہے جو ہے a۔ مثبت b۔ منفی c۔ صفر d۔ مثبت یا منفی ہو سکتی ہے۔
items.q3: د انتالپي بدلون ΔH_sol د محلول تودوخه ده چې ده
items.e: The heat of solution is endothermic for some solutes (NH₄NO₃) and exothermic for others (NaOH).

items.q: Define the following concentration units: i) ppm ii) ppb iii) ppt iv) mole fraction

items.q3: د لاندې غلظت واحدونه تعریف کړئ: i) ppm ii) ppb iii) ppt iv) مول برخه
items.a: i) ppm (parts per million) = (mass of solute / mass of solution) × 10⁶, i.e. mg of solute per kg (or per dm³) of solution. ii) ppb (parts per billion) = (mass of solute / mass of solution) × 10⁹. iii) ppt (parts per trillion) = (mass of solute / mass of solution) × 10¹². iv) Mole fraction = moles of a component / total moles of all components.
items.e: Concentration units.

items.a: Molarity depends on temperature because it is defined per unit volume of solution, and the volume changes with temperature; molality is based on the mass of solvent, which does not change with temperature.

items.q: Prove mathematically that sum of the mole fractions of all the components of a solution is equal to one.
items.q2: ریاضیاتی طور پر ثابت کریں کہ محلول کے تمام اجزاء کے مول اجزاء کا مجموعہ ایک کے برابر ہوتا ہے۔
items.q3: ریاضیاتي ډول ثابته کړئ چې د یو محلول د ټولو اجزاوو د مول برخو مجموعه له یو سره مساوي ده.
items.a: Let a solution contain n₁, n₂, n₃ ... moles of components. The mole fractions are x₁ = n₁/(n₁ + n₂ + n₃ + ...), x₂ = n₂/(n₁ + n₂ + n₃ + ...), and so on. Adding: x₁ + x₂ + x₃ + ... = (n₁ + n₂ + n₃ + ...)/(n₁ + n₂ + n₃ + ...) = 1. For a binary solution x₁ + x₂ = 1.
items.e: Proof.

items.q: Define and name four colligative properties.

items.a: Colligative properties are the properties of dilute solutions that depend on the number of solute particles and not on their nature. Four colligative properties: (1) lowering of vapour pressure; (2) elevation of boiling point; (3) depression of freezing point; (4) osmotic pressure.
items.e: Definition and list.

items.q: Define osmosis and give its applications in daily life.
items.q2: اسموسس کی تعریف کریں اور روزمرہ زندگی میں اس کے اطلاقات دیں۔
items.q3: اسموسس تعریف کړئ او په ورځني ژوند کې د هغه کارونې ورکړئ.
items.a: Osmosis is the spontaneous flow of solvent molecules through a semi-permeable membrane from a dilute solution (or pure solvent) to a more concentrated solution. Applications: absorption of water by plant roots; preservation of meat, fish and pickles by salt/sugar; swelling of raisins in water; intravenous solutions are made isotonic with blood; desalination (reverse osmosis); movement of water in cells.
items.e: Osmosis.

items.q: Calculate mole fraction of each component in the following solutions. i) 2.5 moles of water (H₂O)+1.5 moles of NaCl. ii) 500 g of water (H₂O)+600 g of glucose (C₆H₁₂O₆). iii) 800 g of water (H₂O)+120 g of acetone (CH₃)₂CO. Ans. (0.625, 0.375), (0.89, 0.11), (0.955, 0.044)

items.q3: په لاندې محلولونو کې د هر جز مول برخه محاسبه کړئ. i) 2.5 مول اوبه (H₂O)+1.5 مول NaCl. ii) 500 g اوبه (H₂O)+600 g ګلوکوز (C₆H₁₂O₆). iii) 800 g اوبه (H₂O)+120 g اسیټون (CH₃)₂CO. ځواب: (0.625، 0.375)، (0.89، 0.11)، (0.955، 0.044)
items.a: i) n(H₂O) = 2.5, n(NaCl) = 1.5, total 4.0: x(H₂O) = 0.625, x(NaCl) = 0.375. ii) 500 g H₂O = 27.8 mol; 600 g glucose = 3.33 mol; total 31.1: x(H₂O) = 0.89, x(glucose) = 0.11. iii) 800 g H₂O = 44.4 mol; 120 g acetone (58 g/mol) = 2.07 mol; total 46.5: x(H₂O) = 0.955, x(acetone) = 0.044.

items.q: A 3.0 cm³ cylinder contains a mixture of oxygen, nitrogen, and chlorine gases. If their amounts are 4.64×10⁻⁵g, 3.5×10⁻⁴ g and 2.3×10⁻⁵g respectively. Calculate the concentration of each in i) Parts per million (ppm)

items.q3: په یو 3.0 cm³ سلنډر کې د اکسیجن، نایټروجن او کلورین ګازونو مخلوط شته. که د هغوی مقدارونه په ترتیب سره 4.64×10⁻⁵g، 3.5×10⁻⁴ g او 2.3×10⁻⁵g وي نو د هر یوه غلظت محاسبه کړئ i) په ملیون برخو (ppm) کې
items.a: ppm = (mass of gas / volume of mixture in cm³) × 10⁶ as in the book (mass in g per 3.0 cm³): O₂ = 4.64 × 10⁻⁵/3.0 × 10⁶ = 15.46 ppm; N₂ = 3.5 × 10⁻⁴/3.0 × 10⁶ = 116.6 ppm; Cl₂ = 2.3 × 10⁻⁵/3.0 × 10⁶ = 7.7 ppm.

items.q: In an experiment 6.4g of an organic compound was dissolved in 25.6g of benzene and 1.0 °C depression of freezing point was observed. Calculate the molecular weight of the substance. (k_f of benzene=5.12) Ans. 1280 g/mol
items.q2: ایک تجربے میں 6.4g نامیاتی مرکب 25.6g بینزین میں حل کیا گیا اور نقطۂ انجماد میں 1.0 °C کمی دیکھی گئی۔ مادے کا سالماتی وزن معلوم کریں۔ (بینزین کا k_f=5.12) جواب: 1280 g/mol
items.q3: په یوه تجربه کې 6.4g عضوي مرکب په 25.6g بنزین کې حل شو او د ځمبېدو د نقطې 1.0 °C ښکته کېدل ولیدل شول. د مادې مالیکولي وزن محاسبه کړئ. (د بنزین k_f=5.12) ځواب: 1280 g/mol
items.a: ΔT_f = K_f × m, so m = 1.0/5.12 = 0.195 mol kg⁻¹. Moles of solute = 0.195 × 0.0256 kg = 5.0 × 10⁻³ mol. M = 6.4 g / 5.0 × 10⁻³ mol = 1280 g/mol.
items.e: Answer 1280 g/mol.

items.q: Calculate molecular weight of Iodine (I₂) when a solution containing 1.19 g of I₂ in 35.0 grams of ether shows a raise in boiling point by 0.296 °C (k_b for ether: 2.22) (Ans. M.Wt of I₂ = 254g mol⁻¹)
items.q2: آیوڈین (I₂) کا سالماتی وزن معلوم کریں جب ایتھر کے 35.0 گرام میں 1.19 g I₂ پر مشتمل محلول نقطۂ جوش میں 0.296 °C اضافہ دکھائے (ایتھر کے لیے k_b: 2.22) (جواب: I₂ کا سالماتی وزن = 254g mol⁻¹)
items.q3: د آیوډین (I₂) مالیکولي وزن محاسبه کړئ کله چې په 35.0 ګرامو ایتر کې 1.19 g I₂ لرونکی محلول د جوش په نقطه کې 0.296 °C لوړوالی وښيي (د ایتر لپاره k_b: 2.22) (ځواب: د I₂ مالیکولي وزن = 254g mol⁻¹)
items.a: ΔT_b = K_b × (w₂ × 1000)/(M₂ × w₁), so M₂ = (2.22 × 1.19 × 1000)/(0.296 × 35.0) = 2641.8/10.36 = 255 g/mol (printed answer 254 g/mol, the molar mass of I₂ = 254).
items.e: Rounding differences.

items.q: How a given mixture can be differentiated into a true solution or coarse suspension.
items.q2: کسی دیے گئے آمیزے کو حقیقی محلول یا موٹے معلق میں کیسے ممیز کیا جا سکتا ہے۔
items.q3: یو ورکړل شوی مخلوط څنګه په حقیقي محلول یا غټ معلق کې توپیر کېدای شي.
items.a: A true solution is clear, the particles cannot be seen, it does not settle, does not scatter a beam of light and passes through filter paper. A coarse suspension is cloudy, the particles are visible, they settle on standing, they are removed by filtration and may scatter light. (A colloid shows the Tyndall effect.)
items.e: Tests of a mixture.

items.q: Define solubility, what are the factors that affect the solubility of substances?
items.q2: حلالیت کی تعریف کریں، وہ کون سے عوامل ہیں جو مادوں کی حلالیت کو متاثر کرتے ہیں؟
items.q3: حلالیت تعریف کړئ، هغه کوم فکتورونه دي چې د موادو په حلالیت اغېز کوي؟
items.a: Solubility is the maximum amount of a solute that dissolves in a given amount of solvent (usually 100 g) at a given temperature to form a saturated solution. Factors: (1) nature of the solute and solvent (like dissolves like); (2) temperature; (3) pressure (for gases, Henry's law); (4) the size of the particles and stirring, which affect the rate of dissolving; (5) presence of other (common) ions.
items.e: Solubility.

items.q: Classify colloids on the basis of their behaviour towards medium and the physical states of matter.
items.q2: کولائیڈز کی درجہ بندی منتشر واسطے کی طرف ان کے رویے اور مادے کی طبعی حالتوں کی بنیاد پر کریں۔
items.q3: کلوایډونه د منځګړي په لور د هغوی د چلند او د مادې د فزیکي حالتونو په بنسټ طبقه بندي کړئ.
items.a: On the basis of behaviour towards the medium: lyophilic (solvent-loving, e.g. starch in water) and lyophobic colloids (e.g. gold sol). On the basis of the physical states: solid in liquid (sol, e.g. paint), liquid in liquid (emulsion, e.g. milk), gas in liquid (foam, e.g. whipped cream), liquid in gas (aerosol, e.g. fog, mist), solid in gas (smoke), liquid in solid (gel, e.g. butter, cheese), gas in solid (solid foam, e.g. pumice).
items.e: Classification.

items.q: Give the statement of Raoult's law. Explain the lowering of vapour pressure of a solution based on this law.
items.q2: راؤلٹ کے قانون کا بیان دیں۔ اس قانون کی بنیاد پر محلول کے بخارات دباؤ میں کمی کی وضاحت کریں۔
items.q3: د راؤلټ د قانون بیان ورکړئ. د دې قانون پر بنسټ د محلول د بخار فشار کمښت تشریح کړئ.
items.a: Raoult's law: the lowering of the vapour pressure of a solvent by a non-volatile solute is directly proportional to the mole fraction of the solute: (P° − P)/P° = x(solute), where P° is the vapour pressure of the pure solvent and P of the solution. The solute particles occupy some places on the surface of the liquid and reduce the number of solvent molecules which escape, so the vapour pressure is lowered.
items.e: Raoult's law.

items.q: Explain the phenomenon of osmosis.
items.q2: اسموسس کے مظہر کی وضاحت کریں۔
items.q3: د اسموسس پدیده تشریح کړئ.
items.a: Osmosis is the flow of solvent molecules through a semi-permeable membrane from a solution of lower concentration (or pure solvent) to a solution of higher concentration until equilibrium. The pressure that must be applied to stop the flow is the osmotic pressure π, given by π = MRT. Example: water enters a raisin or potato slice placed in water.
items.e: Osmosis.

items.q: Explain the phenomenon of depression of freezing point. How molecular mass of solute can be calculated on the basis of depression in freezing point?
items.q2: نقطۂ انجماد میں کمی کے مظہر کی وضاحت کریں۔ نقطۂ انجماد میں کمی کی بنیاد پر محلول شدہ شے کی سالماتی کمیت کیسے معلوم کی جا سکتی ہے؟
items.q3: د ځمبېدو د نقطې د ښکته کېدو پدیده تشریح کړئ. د ځمبېدو د نقطې د ښکته کېدو پر بنسټ د محلول شوې مادې مالیکولي کتله څنګه محاسبه کېدای شي؟
items.a: When a non-volatile solute is dissolved in a solvent, the freezing point of the solution is lower than that of the pure solvent, because solute particles interfere with the formation of the solid. ΔT_f = K_f × m, where m is the molality and K_f the molal depression constant. The molar mass is M = (K_f × w₂ × 1000)/(ΔT_f × w₁), where w₂ is the mass of the solute and w₁ that of the solvent in g.
items.e: Depression of freezing point.

items.q: Explain the elevation of boiling point, how molecular mass of solute can be calculated on the basis of elevation of boiling point?
items.q2: نقطۂ جوش میں اضافے کی وضاحت کریں، نقطۂ جوش میں اضافے کی بنیاد پر محلول شدہ شے کی سالماتی کمیت کیسے معلوم کی جا سکتی ہے؟
items.q3: د جوش د نقطې لوړېدل تشریح کړئ، د جوش د نقطې د لوړېدو پر بنسټ د محلول شوې مادې مالیکولي کتله څنګه محاسبه کېدای شي؟
items.a: The boiling point of a solution of a non-volatile solute is higher than that of the pure solvent because the vapour pressure is lowered, so a higher temperature is needed to equal the external pressure. ΔT_b = K_b × m. The molar mass is M = (K_b × w₂ × 1000)/(ΔT_b × w₁), where w₂ is the mass of the solute and w₁ that of the solvent in g.
items.e: Elevation of boiling point.

items.q: Define exothermic and endothermic processes.
items.q2: حرارت خارج اور حرارت جذب کرنے والے عملوں کی تعریف کریں۔
items.q3: تودوخه خوشې کوونکې او تودوخه جذبوونکې پروسې تعریف کړئ.
items.a: An exothermic process is one in which heat is given out by the system to the surroundings (ΔH negative), e.g. combustion, neutralisation. An endothermic process is one in which heat is absorbed from the surroundings (ΔH positive), e.g. melting of ice, photosynthesis, dissolving NH₄Cl.
items.e: Definitions.

items.q: Explain the terms: (i) system and surrounding (ii) state and state function.
items.q2: اصطلاحات کی وضاحت کریں: (i) نظام اور ماحول (ii) حالت اور حالت کا تفاعل۔
items.q3: اصطلاحات تشریح کړئ: (i) سیسټم او شاوخوا (ii) حالت او د حالت تابع.
items.a: (i) System is the part of the universe under study; surroundings is everything else that can exchange energy or matter with it. (ii) State of a system is its condition, described by properties such as temperature, pressure, volume and composition; a state function is a property that depends only on the initial and final state and not on the path (e.g. enthalpy, internal energy, pressure, temperature).
items.e: Thermodynamic terms.

items.q: What are the consequences of an increase in internal energy of a chemical system.
items.q2: کیمیائی نظام کی اندرونی توانائی میں اضافے کے نتائج کیا ہیں۔
items.q3: د یو کيمياوي سیسټم په داخلي انرژۍ کې د زیاتوالي پایلې څه دي.
items.a: An increase in the internal energy of a chemical system (by absorbing heat or doing work on it) raises the kinetic energy of molecules and so the temperature; it may cause a change of state (melting, boiling), increase the volume or pressure of a gas, or make the reaction proceed.
items.e: Internal energy.

items.q: Define first law of thermodynamics.
items.q2: تھرموڈائنامکس کے پہلے قانون کی تعریف کریں۔
items.q3: د ترموډینامیکس لومړی قانون تعریف کړئ.
items.a: First law of thermodynamics (law of conservation of energy): energy can neither be created nor destroyed, it can only be converted from one form into another. Mathematically ΔE = q + w, where ΔE is the change of internal energy, q is the heat absorbed and w is the work done on the system.
items.e: Definition.

items.q: Define the following: Standard enthalpy change ΔH°; Standard enthalpy of formation ΔH°f; Standard enthalpy of reaction ΔH°r; Standard enthalpy of combustion ΔH°c.
items.q2: درج ذیل کی تعریف کریں: معیاری انتھالپی تبدیلی ΔH°؛ تشکیل کی معیاری انتھالپی ΔH°f؛ تعامل کی معیاری انتھالپی ΔH°r؛ احتراق کی معیاری انتھالپی ΔH°c۔
items.q3: لاندې تعریف کړئ: معیاري د انتالپي بدلون ΔH°؛ د جوړېدو معیاري انتالپي ΔH°f؛ د تعامل معیاري انتالپي ΔH°r؛ د سوځېدو معیاري انتالپي ΔH°c.
items.a: Standard enthalpy change (ΔH°) is the heat change of a reaction at 25 °C (298 K) and 1 atm pressure. Standard enthalpy of formation (ΔH°f) is the heat change when one mole of a compound is formed from its elements in their standard states. Standard enthalpy of reaction (ΔH°r) is the heat change for the reaction (in moles as in the balanced equation) with all substances in their standard states. Standard enthalpy of combustion (ΔH°c) is the heat change when one mole of a substance is completely burnt in excess of oxygen under standard conditions.
items.e: Definitions.

items.q: Define calorimetry and how to measure enthalpy change with the help of calorimeter.
items.q2: کیلوری میٹری کی تعریف کریں اور کیلوری میٹر کی مدد سے انتھالپی تبدیلی کیسے ناپی جاتی ہے۔
items.q3: کیلوري میټري تعریف کړئ او د کیلوري میټر په مرسته د انتالپي بدلون څنګه اندازه کېږي.
items.a: Calorimetry is the measurement of the heat absorbed or released in a chemical or physical change. In a calorimeter, the reaction is carried out in an insulated vessel containing water; from the rise in temperature the heat is calculated by q = m × c × ΔT (or C × ΔT), and ΔH is q per mole; a bomb calorimeter measures ΔE at constant volume.
items.e: Calorimetry.

items.q: State the Hess's law.
items.q2: ہیس کا قانون بیان کریں۔
items.q3: د هېس قانون بیان کړئ.
items.a: Hess's law of constant heat summation: the total enthalpy change of a reaction is the same whether the reaction takes place in one step or in several steps, since it depends only on the initial and the final states.
items.e: Definition.

items.q: On which principle Born Harber cycle is based?
items.q2: بورن ہیبر چکر کس اصول پر مبنی ہے؟
items.q3: بورن-هابر دوره په کوم اصل ولاړه ده؟
items.a: The Born-Haber cycle is based on Hess's law of constant heat summation: the enthalpy of formation of an ionic compound equals the sum of the enthalpy changes of the individual steps (sublimation, ionization, dissociation, electron affinity and lattice energy), because enthalpy is a state function.
items.e: Principle.

items.q: ΔH per mole is expressed in the units of
items.q2: ΔH فی مول کن اکائیوں میں ظاہر کی جاتی ہے a۔ kJ b۔ °F c۔ °C d۔ K
items.q3: ΔH په هر مول په کومو واحدونو کې ښودل کېږي
items.e: The enthalpy change per mole is expressed in kJ (kJ mol⁻¹).

items.q: Which one of the following is NOT a state function?
items.q2: درج ذیل میں سے کون سا حالت کا تفاعل نہیں ہے؟ a۔ انتھالپی b۔ حرارت c۔ درجہ حرارت d۔ دباؤ
items.q3: له لاندې څخه کوم یو د حالت تابع نه دی؟
items.e: Heat depends on the path; enthalpy, temperature and pressure are state functions.

items.q: Standard enthalpy (ΔH°) for 1 mole of a substance, which exists in its natural state, at 1 atm. pressure is measured at
items.q2: معیاری انتھالپی (ΔH°) کسی مادے کے 1 مول کے لیے، جو اپنی قدرتی حالت میں موجود ہو، 1 atm دباؤ پر ناپی جاتی ہے a۔ 0 K b۔ 298 K c۔ 273 K d۔ 0 °C
items.q3: معیاري انتالپي (ΔH°) د یوې مادې د 1 مول لپاره، چې په خپل طبیعي حالت کې شتون ولري، په 1 atm فشار کې اندازه کېږي په
items.e: Standard enthalpy is measured at 298 K (25 °C) and 1 atm.

items.q: ΔH can be measured indirectly by applying
items.q2: ΔH کو بالواسطہ ناپا جا سکتا ہے اطلاق سے a۔ ایووگیڈرو کا قانون b۔ گیسی قوانین c۔ ہیس کا قانون d۔ فیراڈے کا قانون
items.q3: ΔH په غیر مستقیم ډول اندازه کېدای شي د تطبیق په واسطه
items.e: ΔH is calculated indirectly from the sum of the enthalpies of other reactions.

items.q: Enthalpy means
items.q2: انتھالپی کا مطلب ہے a۔ بے ترتیبی b۔ عبوری حالت c۔ شرحی مستقلہ d۔ حرارتی مواد
items.q3: انتالپي معنا لري
items.e: Enthalpy H = E + PV is the heat content of a system.

items.q: No work is done at constant
items.q2: کوئی کام نہیں ہوتا مستقل پر a۔ دباؤ b۔ حجم c۔ درجہ حرارت d۔ کمیت
items.q3: هېڅ کار نه ترسره کېږي په ثابت
items.e: Work (PΔV) is zero at constant volume.

items.q: Heat capacity depends on
items.q2: حرارتی گنجائش منحصر ہے a۔ دباؤ b۔ حجم c۔ ترکیب d۔ کمیت
items.q3: د تودوخې ظرفیت پورې اړه لري
items.e: Heat capacity is an extensive property, proportional to the mass of the substance.

items.q: Which one of the following reactions is spontaneous?
items.q2: درج ذیل میں سے کون سا تعامل خودبخود ہوتا ہے؟ a۔ حرارت جذب کرنے والا b۔ حرارت خارج کرنے والا c۔ الٹنے والا d۔ نہ الٹنے والا
items.q3: له لاندې تعاملاتو څخه کوم یو ځانګړی (ځانله) دی؟
items.e: Reactions which release energy (negative ΔH) are generally spontaneous (a spontaneous process is also irreversible; the answer printed in the book should be checked).

items.q: The energy possessed by water in a dam is
items.q2: ڈیم میں پانی کی توانائی ہے a۔ مخفی توانائی b۔ حرکی توانائی c۔ برقی توانائی d۔ حرارتی توانائی
items.q3: په بند کې د اوبو انرژي ده
items.e: Water stored at a height has gravitational potential energy.

items.q: When heat is absorbed from the surrounding, the process is
items.q2: جب ماحول سے حرارت جذب ہو تو عمل ہے a۔ الٹنے والا b۔ میکانی c۔ حرارت خارج کرنے والا d۔ حرارت جذب کرنے والا
items.q3: کله چې له شاوخوا څخه تودوخه جذب شي نو پروسه ده
items.e: The system absorbs heat from the surroundings.

items.q: The sum of all the energies of all the molecules or atoms of a substance is called its:
items.q2: کسی مادے کے تمام سالموں یا ایٹموں کی تمام توانائیوں کا مجموعہ اس کی کہلاتا ہے: a۔ مخصوص حرارت b۔ حرارتی گنجائش c۔ نہفتہ حرارت d۔ اندرونی توانائی
items.q3: د یوې مادې د ټولو مالیکولونو یا اتومونو د ټولو انرژیو مجموعه د هغې بلل کېږي:
items.e: The total energy of all the particles of a substance.

items.q: Which one of the following processes has ΔH positive
items.q2: درج ذیل میں سے کس عمل کا ΔH مثبت ہے a۔ آئنائزیشن توانائی b۔ الیکٹران رغبت c۔ احتراق d۔ حرارت خارج کرنے والا تعامل
items.q3: له لاندې پروسو څخه د کومې ΔH مثبت دی
items.e: It is always endothermic (energy is absorbed).

items.q: Total energy of the system and its surroundings remains constant.
items.q2: نظام اور اس کے ماحول کی کل توانائی مستقل رہتی ہے۔
items.q3: د سیسټم او د هغه د شاوخوا ټوله انرژي ثابته پاتې کېږي.
items.a: Energy can neither be created nor destroyed but only transferred or changed from one form to another (first law of thermodynamics), so the energy lost by the system is gained by the surroundings and the total energy of the system plus surroundings (the universe) remains constant.
items.e: First law.

items.q: Ionic reactions are very fast.
items.q2: آئنی تعاملات بہت تیز ہوتے ہیں۔
items.q3: آیوني تعاملات ډېر ګړندي دي.
items.a: Ionic reactions are very fast because the ions are already present in solution and only combine by electrostatic attraction (no bonds are broken), so the activation energy is very small and the reaction is almost instantaneous.
items.e: Ionic reactions.

items.q: The work done has positive and negative values.
items.q2: کیے گئے کام کی مثبت اور منفی قیمتیں ہوتی ہیں۔
items.q3: ترسره شوی کار مثبت او منفي ارزښتونه لري.
items.a: The work done is positive when work is done on the system (compression, the energy of the system increases) and negative when work is done by the system (expansion). It is defined by the sign convention (w = −PΔV): in expansion ΔV is positive so w is negative.
items.e: Sign convention.

items.q: Heat of combustion is always negative.
items.q2: احتراق کی حرارت ہمیشہ منفی ہوتی ہے۔
items.q3: د سوځېدو تودوخه تل منفي وي.
items.a: The heat of combustion is always negative because combustion is exothermic: the heat is evolved to the surroundings, so the enthalpy of the system decreases (ΔH < 0).
items.e: Combustion.

items.q: Enthalpy change is a state function but heat is not.
items.q2: انتھالپی تبدیلی حالت کا تفاعل ہے لیکن حرارت نہیں۔
items.q3: د انتالپي بدلون د حالت تابع ده خو تودوخه نه ده.
items.a: Enthalpy change depends only on the initial and final states of the system and not on the path, so it is a state function. Heat is a form of energy in transit that depends on the path taken (for example, the reaction in an open vessel or at constant volume), so it is not a state function.
items.e: State functions.

items.q: ΔH for solids and liquids becomes equal to ΔE.
items.q2: ٹھوس اور مائعات کے لیے ΔH، ΔE کے برابر ہو جاتا ہے۔
items.q3: د جامداتو او مایعاتو لپاره ΔH له ΔE سره مساوي کېږي.
items.a: ΔH = ΔE + PΔV. In solids and liquids the volume change ΔV is negligible, so PΔV ≈ 0 and ΔH ≈ ΔE.
items.e: Enthalpy and internal energy.

items.q: Enthalpy of neutralization of strong acids and strong bases has always the same value.
items.q2: مضبوط تیزابوں اور مضبوط اساسوں کی تعدیل کی انتھالپی ہمیشہ ایک ہی قیمت رکھتی ہے۔
items.q3: د قوي اسیدونو او قوي القليو د خنثی کېدو انتالپي تل یو شان ارزښت لري.
items.a: The neutralization of a strong acid with a strong base is essentially H⁺ + OH⁻ → H₂O, since both are completely ionized, so the heat released per mole of water formed (about −57.3 kJ mol⁻¹) is the same for every strong acid and strong base.
items.e: Heat of neutralization.

items.q: What do you mean by state of a system? What are state functions?
items.q2: نظام کی حالت سے آپ کیا مراد لیتے ہیں؟ حالت کے تفاعل کیا ہیں؟
items.q3: د سیسټم له حالت څخه تاسو څه مراد اخلئ؟ د حالت تابع څه دي؟
items.a: The state of a system is the condition of the system described by its measurable properties (temperature, pressure, volume, composition). State functions are properties that depend only on the present state of the system and not on how it reached that state, e.g. internal energy, enthalpy, entropy, pressure, temperature and volume.
items.e: State functions.

items.q: State and explain Hess's law of constant heat summation. Show that it is a direct consequence of the first law of thermodynamics.
items.q2: ہیس کے مستقل حرارتی مجموعے کے قانون کو بیان کریں اور وضاحت کریں۔ ثابت کریں کہ یہ تھرموڈائنامکس کے پہلے قانون کا براہِ راست نتیجہ ہے۔
items.q3: د هېس د ثابت تودوخې د مجموعې قانون بیان او تشریح کړئ. وښیئ چې دا د ترموډینامیکس د لومړي قانون مستقیمه پایله ده.
items.a: Hess's law: the heat change of a reaction is the same whether it takes place in one step or in several steps. It is a consequence of the first law: since energy is conserved and ΔH is a state function, if two paths between the same reactants and products had different ΔH, energy could be created or destroyed by going around the cycle, which is impossible. So ΔH(one step) = ΔH₁ + ΔH₂ + ΔH₃ ... Example: C + O₂ → CO₂ (−393.5) equals C + ½O₂ → CO (−110.5) plus CO + ½O₂ → CO₂ (−283).
items.e: Hess's law.

items.q: How does Born Haber cycle help in calculating lattice energy?
items.q2: بورن ہیبر چکر جالی توانائی کا حساب لگانے میں کیسے مدد دیتا ہے؟
items.q3: بورن-هابر دوره د جالۍ د انرژۍ په محاسبه کې څنګه مرسته کوي؟
items.a: In the Born-Haber cycle, the formation of an ionic solid from its elements is split into steps: sublimation of the metal, ionization of the metal atom, dissociation of the non-metal molecule into atoms, electron affinity of the non-metal atom and the lattice energy. By Hess's law, ΔH°f = ΔH(sub) + IE + ½ΔH(diss) + EA + U. Knowing all the other quantities, the lattice energy U can be calculated.
items.e: Born-Haber cycle (e.g. NaCl).

items.q: What is meant by heat of a reaction? Explain how the heat of a reaction at constant volume differs from the heat of a reaction at constant pressure?
items.q2: تعامل کی حرارت سے کیا مراد ہے؟ وضاحت کریں کہ مستقل حجم پر تعامل کی حرارت مستقل دباؤ پر تعامل کی حرارت سے کیسے مختلف ہے؟
items.q3: د تعامل له تودوخې څخه څه مراد دی؟ تشریح کړئ چې په ثابت حجم کې د تعامل تودوخه په ثابت فشار کې د تعامل له تودوخې څخه څنګه توپیر لري؟
items.a: The heat of a reaction is the amount of heat absorbed or evolved when the reaction takes place under given conditions. At constant volume the heat change equals the change in internal energy (q_v = ΔE), because no work is done; at constant pressure it equals the enthalpy change (q_p = ΔH = ΔE + PΔV), which includes the work of expansion. The two are different when the number of moles of gas changes (ΔH = ΔE + ΔnRT).
items.e: Heat of reaction.

items.q: What is meant by pressure volume work? How it is related to the first law of thermodynamics?
items.q2: دباؤ حجم کام سے کیا مراد ہے؟ اس کا تھرموڈائنامکس کے پہلے قانون سے کیا تعلق ہے؟
items.q3: د فشار حجم کار څخه څه مراد دی؟ دا د ترموډینامیکس له لومړي قانون سره څنګه اړوند دی؟
items.a: Pressure-volume work is the work done when a gas expands or is compressed against an external pressure: w = −P ΔV. By the first law ΔE = q + w = q − PΔV, so at constant pressure q_p = ΔE + PΔV = ΔH.
items.e: PV work.

items.q: Apply Hess's law to calculate ΔH° for the sublimation of one mole of iodine from the following equations. (i) H₂(g) + I₂(s) → 2HI(g) ΔH° = 51.8 kJ mol⁻¹ (ii) H₂(g) + I₂(g) → 2HI(g) ΔH° = −10.5 kJ mol⁻¹ (Ans. 62.3 kJ mol⁻¹)
items.q2: درج ذیل مساواتوں سے آیوڈین کے ایک مول کی تصعید کے لیے ΔH° معلوم کرنے کے لیے ہیس کا قانون لاگو کریں۔ (i) H₂(g) + I₂(s) → 2HI(g) ΔH° = 51.8 kJ mol⁻¹ (ii) H₂(g) + I₂(g) → 2HI(g) ΔH° = −10.5 kJ mol⁻¹ (جواب: 62.3 kJ mol⁻¹)
items.q3: د لاندې معادلو څخه د آیوډین د یو مول د تصعید لپاره ΔH° د محاسبې لپاره د هېس قانون تطبیق کړئ. (i) H₂(g) + I₂(s) → 2HI(g) ΔH° = 51.8 kJ mol⁻¹ (ii) H₂(g) + I₂(g) → 2HI(g) ΔH° = −10.5 kJ mol⁻¹ (ځواب: 62.3 kJ mol⁻¹)
items.a: Sublimation: I₂(s) → I₂(g). Subtract equation (ii) from (i): ΔH° = 51.8 − (−10.5) = 62.3 kJ mol⁻¹.
items.e: Answer 62.3 kJ mol⁻¹.

items.q: Calculate heat of formation of an aqueous solution of NH₄Cl from the following data. (i) NH₃(g) + aq → NH₃(aq) ΔH° = −35.16 kJ mol⁻¹ (ii) HCl(g) + aq → HCl(aq) ΔH° = −72.41 kJ mol⁻¹ (iii) NH₃(aq) + HCl(aq) → NH₄Cl(aq) ΔH° = −51.48 kJ mol⁻¹ (Ans. −159.08 kJ mol⁻¹)
items.q2: درج ذیل اعداد و شمار سے NH₄Cl کے آبی محلول کی تشکیل کی حرارت معلوم کریں۔ (i) NH₃(g) + aq → NH₃(aq) ΔH° = −35.16 kJ mol⁻¹ (ii) HCl(g) + aq → HCl(aq) ΔH° = −72.41 kJ mol⁻¹ (iii) NH₃(aq) + HCl(aq) → NH₄Cl(aq) ΔH° = −51.48 kJ mol⁻¹ (جواب: −159.08 kJ mol⁻¹)
items.q3: د لاندې معلوماتو څخه د NH₄Cl د اوبیز محلول د جوړېدو تودوخه محاسبه کړئ. (i) NH₃(g) + aq → NH₃(aq) ΔH° = −35.16 kJ mol⁻¹ (ii) HCl(g) + aq → HCl(aq) ΔH° = −72.41 kJ mol⁻¹ (iii) NH₃(aq) + HCl(aq) → NH₄Cl(aq) ΔH° = −51.48 kJ mol⁻¹ (ځواب: −159.08 kJ mol⁻¹)
items.a: Adding equations (i), (ii) and (iii): NH₃(g) + HCl(g) + aq → NH₄Cl(aq), ΔH = −35.16 − 72.41 − 51.48 = −159.05 kJ mol⁻¹ (about −159.08 as printed in the book; the small difference is rounding).
items.e: Hess's law.

items.q: Liquid ethanol when burnt in oxygen at 25°C liberates heat i.e. ΔH°=−1402.14 kJ mol⁻¹. The heats of formation of CO₂ and H₂O are −393.50 and −285.81 kJ mol⁻¹, respectively, at the same temperature. Calculate the heat of formation of ethanol at 25°C. (Ans. −242.37 kJ mol⁻¹)
items.q2: مائع ایتھانول 25°C پر آکسیجن میں جلنے پر حرارت خارج کرتا ہے یعنی ΔH°=−1402.14 kJ mol⁻¹۔ اسی درجہ حرارت پر CO₂ اور H₂O کی تشکیل کی حرارتیں بالترتیب −393.50 اور −285.81 kJ mol⁻¹ ہیں۔ 25°C پر ایتھانول کی تشکیل کی حرارت معلوم کریں۔ (جواب: −242.37 kJ mol⁻¹)
items.q3: مایع ایتانول کله چې په 25°C کې په اکسیجن کې وسوځي تودوخه خوشې کوي یعنې ΔH°=−1402.14 kJ mol⁻¹. په همدې تودوخه کې د CO₂ او H₂O د جوړېدو تودوخې په ترتیب سره −393.50 او −285.81 kJ mol⁻¹ دي. په 25°C کې د ایتانول د جوړېدو تودوخه محاسبه کړئ. (ځواب: −242.37 kJ mol⁻¹)
items.a: C₂H₅OH + 3O₂ → 2CO₂ + 3H₂O: ΔH°c = Σ ΔH°f(products) − ΔH°f(ethanol). −1402.14 = [2(−393.50) + 3(−285.81)] − ΔH°f(ethanol) = −1644.43 − ΔH°f; so ΔH°f(ethanol) = −1644.43 + 1402.14 = −242.29 kJ mol⁻¹ (the book gives −242.37; the difference is rounding).
items.e: Heat of formation of ethanol.

items.q: A chemical reaction takes place in a container of cross sectional area of 0.01 m², fitted with a weightless and frictionless piston. The piston is moved up through 0.01m against an external pressure of 101325 Pa as a result of the reaction. Calculate the work done by the system. (Ans. 101.3 J)
items.q2: ایک کیمیائی تعامل 0.01 m² رقبۂ عمودی والے برتن میں ہوتا ہے جس میں بے وزن اور بے رگڑ پسٹن لگا ہے۔ تعامل کے نتیجے میں پسٹن 101325 Pa کے بیرونی دباؤ کے خلاف 0.01m اوپر حرکت کرتا ہے۔ نظام کے ذریعے کیا گیا کام معلوم کریں۔ (جواب: 101.3 J)
items.q3: یو کيمياوي تعامل په یو لوښي کې پېښېږي چې مقطعي ساحه یې 0.01 m² ده او بې وزنه او بې رګړه پسټن لري. د تعامل په پایله کې پسټن د 101325 Pa د بهرني فشار په وړاندې 0.01m پورته حرکت کوي. د سیسټم په واسطه ترسره شوی کار محاسبه کړئ. (ځواب: 101.3 J)
items.a: Work done by the system = P × ΔV, where ΔV = area × displacement = 0.01 m² × 0.01 m = 1.0 × 10⁻⁴ m³, so W = 101325 Pa × 1.0 × 10⁻⁴ m³ = 10.13 J. (The book prints 101.3 J, which would correspond to a displacement of 0.1 m: please check the printed data with the teacher.)
items.e: w = −PΔV in the sign convention, the system does work 10.13 J.

items.q: Determine ΔH° for the following reaction with the help of given data. 2C(s) + 2H₂(g) → C₂H₄(g) ΔH° = ? i) C(s) + O₂(g) → CO₂(g) ΔH°₁ = −393.5 kJ mol⁻¹ ii) H₂(g) + ½O₂(g) → H₂O(g) ΔH°₂ = −285.7 kJ mol⁻¹ iii) C₂H₄(g) + 3O₂(g) → 2CO₂(g) + 2H₂O(g) ΔH°₃ = −1430.9 kJ mol⁻¹ (Ans 72.8 kJ mol⁻¹)
items.q2: دیے گئے اعداد و شمار کی مدد سے درج ذیل تعامل کے لیے ΔH° معلوم کریں۔ 2C(s) + 2H₂(g) → C₂H₄(g) ΔH° = ؟ i) C(s) + O₂(g) → CO₂(g) ΔH°₁ = −393.5 kJ mol⁻¹ ii) H₂(g) + ½O₂(g) → H₂O(g) ΔH°₂ = −285.7 kJ mol⁻¹ iii) C₂H₄(g) + 3O₂(g) → 2CO₂(g) + 2H₂O(g) ΔH°₃ = −1430.9 kJ mol⁻¹ (جواب: 72.8 kJ mol⁻¹)
items.q3: د ورکړل شویو معلوماتو په مرسته د لاندې تعامل لپاره ΔH° وټاکئ. 2C(s) + 2H₂(g) → C₂H₄(g) ΔH° = ؟ i) C(s) + O₂(g) → CO₂(g) ΔH°₁ = −393.5 kJ mol⁻¹ ii) H₂(g) + ½O₂(g) → H₂O(g) ΔH°₂ = −285.7 kJ mol⁻¹ iii) C₂H₄(g) + 3O₂(g) → 2CO₂(g) + 2H₂O(g) ΔH°₃ = −1430.9 kJ mol⁻¹ (ځواب: 72.8 kJ mol⁻¹)
items.a: Required: 2C + 2H₂ → C₂H₄. ΔH = 2ΔH₁ + 2ΔH₂ − ΔH₃ = 2(−393.5) + 2(−285.7) − (−1430.9) = −787.0 − 571.4 + 1430.9 = +72.5 kJ mol⁻¹ (the book's answer is 72.8 kJ mol⁻¹; the small difference arises from rounding of the data).
items.e: Hess's law.

items.q: Differentiate between oxidising agent and reducing agent with examples.
items.q2: تکسیدی ایجنٹ اور تخفیفی ایجنٹ میں مثالوں کے ساتھ فرق کریں۔
items.q3: د اکسیډېزنګ اجنټ او ریډیوسینګ اجنټ ترمنځ په بېلګو سره توپیر وکړئ.
items.a: An oxidising agent accepts electrons and is itself reduced (O₂, Cl₂, KMnO₄, Na⁺ in Na⁺ + e⁻ → Na). A reducing agent donates electrons and is itself oxidised (Na, Zn, H₂, Fe²⁺ → Fe³⁺ + e⁻). Example: Zn + Cu²⁺ → Zn²⁺ + Cu: Cu²⁺ is the oxidising agent and Zn is the reducing agent.
items.e: Difference.

items.q: Define electrodes, electrode potential and oxidation number.
items.q2: الیکٹروڈز، الیکٹروڈ پوٹینشل اور تکسیدی عدد کی تعریف کریں۔
items.q3: الکترودونه، د الکترود پوټنشیل او د اکسیډیشن شمېره تعریف کړئ.
items.a: Electrode: a metal or conductor (rod or plate) through which current enters or leaves an electrolyte. Electrode potential: the potential developed by a metal in contact with a solution of its ions, measured against the standard hydrogen electrode (SHE). Oxidation number: the charge which an atom would have if all the bonds were completely ionic.
items.e: Definitions.

items.q: Name the two types of electrodes and the ions discharged on them.
items.q2: دو اقسام کے الیکٹروڈز کے نام بتائیں اور ان پر خارج ہونے والے آئنوں کے نام بتائیں۔
items.q3: د دوو ډولونو الکترودونو نومونه واخلئ او په هغو باندې خوشې شوي آیونونه نوم واخلئ.
items.a: The two types of electrodes are the cathode (the negative electrode in electrolysis, where reduction occurs and cations are discharged, e.g. Na⁺ + e⁻ → Na, Cu²⁺ + 2e⁻ → Cu) and the anode (the positive electrode in electrolysis, where oxidation occurs and anions are discharged, e.g. 2Cl⁻ → Cl₂ + 2e⁻).
items.e: Electrodes.

items.q: Calculate E°cell from the following half-cell reactions.
items.q2: درج ذیل نیم خلوی تعاملات سے E°cell کا حساب لگائیں۔
items.q3: د لاندې نیمه حجروي تعاملاتو څخه E°cell محاسبه کړئ.

Write the two half-cell reactions as reductions, identify the one with the higher (more positive) reduction potential as the cathode, subtract the other and give the answer in volts; the cell is spontaneous if E°cell is positive. The equations and potentials are not legible in the scan.

items.q3: د لاندې دوو نیمو حجرو لرونکې ګلوانیک حجرې د حجرې پوټنشیل محاسبه کړئ. د هغو نیمه حجروي تعاملات ولیکئ [scan obscured].

The half cells are written as: at the cathode, M^n+ + ne⁻ → M; at the anode, M → M^n+ + ne⁻ (the reverse of the reduction). The data of the two half cells are not legible in the scan.

items.q: Differentiate between oxidation and reduction potential with an example.
items.q2: مثال کے ساتھ تکسیدی اور تخفیفی پوٹینشل میں فرق کریں۔
items.q3: په بېلګې سره د اکسیډیشن او ریډکشن پوټنشیل ترمنځ توپیر وکړئ.
items.a: Oxidation potential is the tendency of an electrode to lose electrons (be oxidised): Zn → Zn²⁺ + 2e⁻, E°ox = +0.76 V. Reduction potential is the tendency to gain electrons (be reduced): Zn²⁺ + 2e⁻ → Zn, E°red = −0.76 V. The oxidation potential of an electrode is equal in magnitude but opposite in sign to its reduction potential.
items.e: Difference.

items.q: How reduction potential value effect the position of elements in the electrochemical series.
items.q2: تخفیفی پوٹینشل کی قیمت برق کیمیائی سلسلے میں عناصر کی پوزیشن پر کیسے اثر انداز ہوتی ہے۔
items.q3: د ریډکشن پوټنشیل ارزښت په الکتروکيمياوي لړۍ کې د عناصرو په موقعیت څنګه اغېز کوي.
items.a: The elements are arranged in the electrochemical series in the order of their standard reduction potentials. The element with a more negative (lower) reduction potential is placed at the top (strong reducing agent, loses electrons easily, e.g. Li, K, Na, Zn) and the element with a more positive reduction potential is at the bottom (strong oxidising agent, e.g. F₂, Au).
items.e: Electrochemical series.

items.q: A certain amount of current is passed through AgNO₃ solution for three hours. The net amount of Ag deposited was found to be 60.8 g. Calculate the current when gram equivalents (e) of Ag is 107.8.

items.q3: د AgNO₃ محلول له لارې د جریان یو ټاکلی مقدار درې ساعته تېر شو. د ترسب شوي Ag خالص مقدار 60.8 g وموندل شو. جریان محاسبه کړئ کله چې د Ag ګرام معادل (e) 107.8 وي.

items.q: Define electroplating.
items.q2: برق ملمع کاری کی تعریف کریں۔
items.q3: برېښنایي پوښښ تعریف کړئ.
items.a: Electroplating is the process of depositing a thin layer of a metal (e.g. silver, gold, nickel or chromium) on the surface of another object (the cathode) by electrolysis, to protect it from corrosion or to improve its appearance.
items.e: Definition.

items.q: Explain three ways for prevention of corrosion.
items.q2: سنکنرن کی روک تھام کے تین طریقے بیان کریں۔
items.q3: د زنګ وهلو د مخنیوي درې لارې تشریح کړئ.
items.a: Three ways of prevention of corrosion: (1) coating the surface with paint, oil or grease to keep out air and moisture; (2) electroplating or galvanising with a protective metal (zinc, tin, chromium, nickel); (3) cathodic protection: connecting the iron to a more active metal (sacrificial anode, e.g. magnesium or zinc), or using alloys such as stainless steel.
items.e: Corrosion prevention.

items.q: Name the major types of batteries.
items.q2: بیٹریوں کی بڑی اقسام کے نام بتائیں۔
items.q3: د بیټریو د لویو ډولونو نومونه واخلئ.
items.a: The major types of batteries are primary batteries (not rechargeable, e.g. dry cell or Leclanché cell, alkaline battery, mercury cell) and secondary batteries (rechargeable, e.g. lead storage battery, nickel-cadmium and lithium-ion batteries), plus fuel cells.
items.e: Types.

items.q: Give few advantages of the electrolytic cell.
items.q2: برق پاشی خلیے کے چند فوائد بتائیں۔
items.q3: د الکترولایټیک حجرې څو ګټې ورکړئ.
items.a: Advantages of the electrolytic cell: it is used for the extraction of reactive metals (Na, Al, Mg) from their ores, for the purification (refining) of metals such as copper, for electroplating and anodising, for the production of chemicals (Cl₂, NaOH, H₂) and for the production of hydrogen and oxygen from water.
items.e: Uses.

items.q3: له لاندې څخه کوم ریډکشن تعامل دی

items.q3: کیتوډ ریډکشن پوټنشیل لري
