items.q: What is guided media? Explain different types of guided media.
items.q2: رہنمائی یافتہ وسائط کیا ہیں؟ رہنمائی یافتہ وسائط کی مختلف اقسام بیان کریں۔
items.q3: لارښوونه شوې رسنۍ څه دي؟ د لارښوونه شویو رسنیو مختلف ډولونه تشریح کړئ.
items.a: Model answer: Guided media (bounded media) carry the signal along a physical cable. Types: (1) Twisted pair cable: two insulated copper wires twisted together to reduce interference; UTP (unshielded) and STP (shielded); cheap, used in telephone and LAN cables (CAT5). (2) Coaxial cable: a central copper conductor with insulation and a metal shield; carries higher frequencies, used for TV and older LANs. (3) Fibre optic cable: thin glass or plastic strands that carry light signals; very high speed and bandwidth, no electrical interference, secure, but costly and difficult to install.
items.e: Unit 5 guided media.
items.h: Q3. Give detailed answers to the following questions.

items.q: Explain Radio wave and Microwave communications.
items.q2: ریڈیو ویو اور مائیکرو ویو مواصلات کی وضاحت کریں۔
items.q3: د راډیو څپې او مایکرو څپې اړیکې تشریح کړئ.
items.a: Model answer: Radio waves are electromagnetic waves with frequency from about 3 KHz to 1 GHz; they travel in all directions (omnidirectional), can pass through walls, and are used for radio, TV, cordless phones and mobile phones. Microwaves have higher frequencies (above 1 GHz), travel in a straight narrow beam (unidirectional) and need line of sight, so transmitting and receiving towers or satellite dishes must face each other; they are used for long-distance telephone links, satellite and mobile networks.
items.e: Unit 5 unguided media.
items.h: Q3. Give detailed answers to the following questions.

items.q: Write notes on switch, router and gateway.
items.q2: سوئچ، راؤٹر اور گیٹ وے پر نوٹس لکھیں۔
items.q3: د سویچ، روټر او ګیټ وې په اړه یادښتونه ولیکئ.
items.a: Model answer: A switch connects devices inside one network (LAN) and sends the data only to the port of the device it is meant for, using MAC addresses; it reduces traffic and collisions. A router connects different networks (for example a LAN to the Internet) and finds the best path for each data packet using IP addresses. A gateway connects networks that use different protocols and translates between them; it works as an entry and exit point of a network.
items.e: Unit 5 network devices.
items.h: Q3. Give detailed answers to the following questions.

items.q: Explain in detail Client/Server and Peer-to-Peer networks.
items.q2: کلائنٹ/سرور اور پیئر ٹو پیئر نیٹ ورکس کی تفصیل سے وضاحت کریں۔
items.q3: د پېرېدونکي/خدمتګار او همتا-په-همتا شبکې په تفصیل تشریح کړئ.
items.a: Model answer: In a client/server network one or more powerful computers (servers) provide files, printers, email or applications to many client computers; the server controls security, backup and users, so it is easy to manage and secure but costs more and depends on the server. In a peer-to-peer network all computers are equal; each can share its own files and devices with the others, with no dedicated server, so it is cheap and easy to set up for small groups but is less secure, harder to manage and slower with many users.
items.e: Unit 5 network models.
items.h: Q3. Give detailed answers to the following questions.

items.q: Define network topology and explain its types.
items.q2: نیٹ ورک ٹوپولوجی کی تعریف کریں اور اس کی اقسام بیان کریں۔
items.q3: د شبکې توپولوژي تعریف کړئ او ډولونه یې تشریح کړئ.
items.a: Model answer: Network topology is the physical or logical arrangement of the devices (nodes) and links of a network. Types: (1) Bus: all nodes on one common cable; cheap, but a break stops the network. (2) Star: all nodes connect to a central hub or switch; easy to manage and fault-finding is easy, but the centre is a single point of failure. (3) Ring: each node connects to two neighbours in a closed loop; data moves in one direction. (4) Mesh: every device is connected to every other; very reliable but most expensive. (5) Tree (hybrid): star networks connected to a bus backbone.
items.e: Unit 5 topologies.
items.h: Q3. Give detailed answers to the following questions.

items.q: Describe the seven layers of OSI Model.
items.q2: او ایس آئی ماڈل کی سات تہوں کو بیان کریں۔
items.q3: د OSI ماډل اوه طبقې بیان کړئ.
items.a: Model answer: The seven OSI layers (top to bottom): (7) Application: gives network services to the user (email, file transfer, web). (6) Presentation: translates, encrypts and compresses data. (5) Session: opens, manages and closes sessions between applications; security, name recognition and logging. (4) Transport: end-to-end delivery, error recovery and flow control (TCP, UDP). (3) Network: logical addressing and choosing the path (routing). (2) Data Link: forms frames, physical addressing (MAC), error detection on a link. (1) Physical: sends raw bits over the cable or air; cables, voltages, connectors.
items.e: Unit 5 OSI layers.

items.q: What is TCP/IP? Explain TCP/IP Protocol Suite.
items.q2: ٹی سی پی / آئی پی کیا ہے؟ ٹی سی پی / آئی پی پروٹوکول سوئٹ کی وضاحت کریں۔
items.q3: TCP/IP څه دی؟ د TCP/IP پروتوکول ټولګه تشریح کړئ.
items.a: Model answer: TCP/IP (Transmission Control Protocol / Internet Protocol) is the suite of protocols used on the Internet. Its layers: (1) Application: protocols used by programs: HTTP, FTP, SMTP, POP3, DNS, Telnet. (2) Transport: TCP gives reliable, connection-oriented delivery; UDP is fast and connectionless. (3) Internet: IP addresses and routes packets (IP, ICMP, ARP). (4) Network access: sends the frames over the physical network (Ethernet, Wi-Fi).
items.e: Unit 5 TCP/IP.

items.a: Model answer: Short-distance wireless communication works over a few centimetres to about 100 metres, for example Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, infrared and NFC, and is used inside a room, a building or a campus. Long-distance wireless communication covers many kilometres up to the whole world, for example cellular (GSM/CDMA) networks, WiMAX, microwave links and satellite communication.
items.e: Unit 6 types of wireless communication.

items.q3: نړیوال موقعیت سیسټم (GPS) څه دی؟
items.a: Model answer: The Global Positioning System (GPS) is a satellite-based navigation system made of 24 satellites operated by the U.S. Department of Defense. A GPS receiver gets signals from several satellites and calculates its exact position, speed and time. It is used for land, sea and air navigation, maps, tracking vehicles and ships, and works in any weather.
items.e: Unit 6 GPS.

items.a: Model answer: Wireless Markup Language (WML) is a markup language based on XML made for devices that use the Wireless Application Protocol, such as mobile phones. Like HTML, it supports text and image presentation, hyperlinks, forms and data input, and navigation, and it was the first markup language standard for wireless devices.
items.e: Unit 6 WML.

items.a: Model answer: The Wireless Application Protocol (WAP) is an open standard protocol that gives Internet access and information services to mobile users of wireless phones, pagers and PDAs. A WAP gateway connects the wireless network to the Internet, and pages are written in WML.
items.e: Unit 6 WAP.

items.q2: ویب پروٹوکول اسٹیک پر مختصر نوٹ لکھیں۔
items.q3: د ویب پروتوکول ټولګې په اړه لنډ یادښت ولیکئ.
items.a: Model answer: The Web (WAP) protocol stack is the group of layers used for web communication from a wireless device: Application layer (WAE, the environment with WML and scripts), Session layer (WSP), Transaction layer (WTP), Security layer (WTLS, encryption), Transport layer (WDP, datagrams) and the bearer networks (GSM, CDMA, SMS) at the bottom. It is similar to the TCP/IP and OSI stacks but made for low bandwidth and small devices.

items.q: What are the advantages and disadvantages of wireless networks?
items.q2: وائرلیس نیٹ ورکس کے فوائد اور نقصانات کیا ہیں؟
items.q3: د بې سیمو شبکو ګټې او زیانونه څه دي؟
items.a: Model answer: Advantages of wireless networks: no cables, so easy and cheap installation; mobility and anywhere access; easy to add new devices; useful in places where cabling is difficult; quick set-up for temporary networks. Disadvantages: lower speed than wired networks; interference from other devices and walls; weaker security (signals can be intercepted); limited range; affected by weather and obstacles; health concerns about radiation are discussed.
items.e: Unit 6 wireless networks.

items.q3: د لنډ واټن اړیکو ټکنالوجیو مختلف ډولونه تشریح کړئ.
items.a: Model answer: Short-distance technologies: (1) Bluetooth: low-power radio, about 10 metres, connects phones, headsets and keyboards. (2) Wi-Fi: IEEE 802.11 standard, about 100 metres, wireless LAN and Internet access through access points. (3) Infrared (IrDA): light signals, a few metres, line of sight, for remote controls and file exchange. (4) Others: NFC for a few centimetres (contactless payment) and ZigBee for low-power sensors.
items.e: Unit 6 short-distance communication.

items.q2: طویل فاصلے کی مواصلاتی ٹیکنالوجیز کو تفصیل سے بیان کریں۔
items.q3: د اوږد واټن اړیکو ټکنالوجۍ په تفصیل بیان کړئ.
items.a: Model answer: Long-distance technologies: (1) Cellular mobile networks (GSM, CDMA, 3G, 4G, 5G): divide an area into cells, each with a base station; voice, SMS and data for mobile users over wide areas. (2) WiMAX: high-speed broadband wireless over several kilometres. (3) Microwave links: towers in line of sight, up to about 50 km each. (4) Satellite communication: signals pass through a satellite for TV, telephone, Internet and GPS anywhere on Earth.
items.e: Unit 6 long-distance communication.

items.q: Explain different classifications of Satellite Systems.
items.q2: سیٹلائٹ سسٹمز کی مختلف درجہ بندیوں کی وضاحت کریں۔
items.q3: د سپوږمکیو سیسټمونو مختلفې طبقه بندۍ تشریح کړئ.
items.a: Model answer: Satellite systems are classified by their orbit: (1) LEO (Low Earth Orbit), about 160 to 2,000 km, fast moving, short delay, used for imaging, Iridium phones and Starlink. (2) MEO (Medium Earth Orbit), about 2,000 to 35,000 km, used for navigation (GPS). (3) GEO (Geostationary Earth Orbit), about 35,800 km (22,000 miles) above the equator, moves with the Earth so it stays over one spot, used for TV broadcast and communication. (HEO, the highly elliptical orbit, is used for coverage near the poles.)
items.e: Unit 6 satellites.

items.q: What are the Requirements of Mobile Communication System?
items.q2: موبائل مواصلاتی نظام کی ضروریات کیا ہیں؟
items.q3: د ګرځنده اړیکو سیسټم اړتیاوې څه دي؟
items.a: Model answer: Requirements of a mobile communication system: (1) Mobile terminals (phones, laptops) small, light and low in power use. (2) Wireless link with enough bandwidth and a reliable radio channel. (3) Base stations or access points to cover the area (cells). (4) Handoff/handover: keep the call when a user moves from one cell to another. (5) Roaming and location tracking, so the user can be reached anywhere. (6) Security and authentication of users. (7) Interconnection with wired networks and the Internet.
items.e: Unit 6 mobile communication systems.

items.q: Give important features and limitations of Mobile Communication System.
items.q2: موبائل مواصلاتی نظام کی اہم خصوصیات اور حدود بیان کریں۔
items.q3: د ګرځنده اړیکو سیسټم مهمې ځانګړتیاوې او محدودیتونه ورکړئ.
items.a: Model answer: Features of mobile communication: mobility and portability (use anywhere), wireless connection, voice, text and data services, wide coverage through cells, roaming, low cost compared with fixed lines. Limitations: limited battery life, lower bandwidth and speed than wired links, signal loss and interference in some places, dropped calls during handoff, security risks, limited coverage in remote areas, and small screens on devices.
items.e: Unit 6 mobile communication systems.

items.a: Model answer: A database is an organised collection of related data stored together so that it can be easily accessed, managed and updated, for example the records of students of a college. A DBMS (database management system) is the software that creates, stores, manages and controls access to the database, and lets users add, change, delete and search data, for example MS Access, MySQL, Oracle.

items.a: Model answer: Data is raw facts and figures with no meaning by themselves; information is data that has been processed and has meaning. Examples: (1) data: 45, 78, 90 (marks) → information: the average marks of the class is 71. (2) data: "Ali", "Class 11", "A" → information: Ali of Class 11 got grade A. (3) data: 1500, 2300, 1800 (daily sales) → information: total sales of the week or the best sale day.

items.h: Q2. Give short answers to the following questions.

items.q: Write three disadvantages of file management system.
items.q2: فائل مینجمنٹ سسٹم کے تین نقصانات لکھیں۔
items.q3: د فایل مدیریت سیسټم درې زیانونه ولیکئ.
items.a: Model answer: Disadvantages of a file management system: (1) Data redundancy and inconsistency: the same data is stored in many files, wasting space, and the copies may disagree. (2) Difficulty in accessing data: a new query needs a new program. (3) Data isolation and dependence: data is in different files and formats, and programs depend on the file structure. (Also: weak security, no control of concurrent access, integrity problems and no backup/recovery.)
items.e: Unit 7 file system.

items.q: Give any four advantages of database system.
items.q2: ڈیٹا بیس سسٹم کے کوئی چار فوائد بیان کریں۔
items.q3: د ډېټابېس سیسټم هر څلور ګټې ورکړئ.
items.a: Model answer: Advantages of a database system: (1) Reduced data redundancy and better consistency, because data is stored once. (2) Data sharing: many users and applications use the same data. (3) Data security and integrity: access can be controlled and rules enforced. (4) Easy and fast access to data with query languages. (5) Data independence, and backup and recovery facilities.
items.e: Unit 7 database advantages; any four.

items.a: Model answer: DDL (Data Definition Language) defines and changes the structure of the database: CREATE, ALTER, DROP, TRUNCATE; it deals with tables, fields and keys. DML (Data Manipulation Language) works on the data inside the structure: SELECT (retrieve), INSERT (add), UPDATE (change) and DELETE (remove records).

items.a: Model answer: A data model is a set of rules or a specification that defines how data is stored, organised and manipulated in a database system, and how the data items are related. Common models: hierarchical, network, relational and object-oriented.
items.e: Unit 7 data models.
items.h: Q2. Give short answers to the following questions.

items.q: Differentiate between cardinality and modality.
items.q2: کارڈینالٹی اور موڈیلٹی میں فرق کریں۔
items.q3: په کارډینالټي او موډالټي کې توپیر وکړئ.
items.a: Model answer: Cardinality is the maximum number of times an instance (record) of one entity can be related to instances of another entity: one-to-one (1:1), one-to-many (1:M) or many-to-many (M:N). Modality is the minimum number: it says whether the relationship is optional (0, an instance may exist without a related one) or mandatory (1, at least one related instance must exist). For example, a customer may place many orders (cardinality 1:M); an order must belong to a customer (modality 1).
items.e: Unit 7 ERD.

items.q: What is primary key and foreign key?
items.q2: پرائمری کی اور فارن کی کیا ہیں؟
items.q3: لومړنۍ کیلي او بهرنۍ کیلي څه دي؟
items.a: Model answer: A primary key is a field (or combination of fields) whose value is unique for every row of a table and is never empty, so it identifies each record (for example Roll_No in a Student table). A foreign key is a field in one table that refers to the primary key of another table and so links the two tables (for example Roll_No in the Marks table that refers to Student).
items.e: Unit 7 keys.
items.h: Q2. Give short answers to the following questions.

items.q: What is Relation?
items.q2: ریلیشن کیا ہے؟
items.q3: اړیکه څه ده؟
items.a: Model answer: A relation is a table of data in a relational database, made of rows (tuples/records) and columns (attributes/fields). Each column has a unique name and holds one type of data, and each row holds the data of one entity instance.
items.e: Unit 7 relational model terms.

items.q: What is the role of DBA?
items.q2: ڈی بی اے کا کردار کیا ہے؟
items.q3: د DBA رول څه دی؟
items.a: Model answer: The database administrator (DBA) has central control over the data and programs. Roles: designs and creates the database structure, gives access rights to users and keeps it secure, monitors performance and tunes it, takes backups and recovers data after failure, keeps data integrity, and trains and helps users and programmers.
items.e: Unit 7 DBA.
items.h: Q2. Give short answers to the following questions.

items.q: Explain different types of database models.
items.q2: ڈیٹا بیس ماڈلز کی مختلف اقسام بیان کریں۔
items.q3: د ډېټابېس ماډلونو مختلف ډولونه تشریح کړئ.
items.a: Model answer: Database models: (1) Hierarchical model: data in a tree of parent and child segments, one parent for each child (fast but rigid). (2) Network model: records linked in a graph, a child may have many parents. (3) Relational model: data in tables (relations) related through keys; the most widely used (Oracle, MS Access, MySQL). (4) Object-oriented model: data stored as objects with attributes and methods, used for multimedia and complex data.
items.e: Unit 7 database models.
items.h: Q3. Give detailed answers of the following questions.

items.q: What is SQL? Explain its types.
items.q2: ایس کیو ایل کیا ہے؟ اس کی اقسام بیان کریں۔
items.q3: SQL څه دی؟ ډولونه یې تشریح کړئ.
items.a: Model answer: SQL (Structured Query Language) is the standard language used to create, manage and query relational databases. Types of SQL commands: DDL (Data Definition Language): CREATE, ALTER, DROP. DML (Data Manipulation Language): SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE. DCL (Data Control Language): GRANT, REVOKE (access rights). TCL (Transaction Control Language): COMMIT, ROLLBACK.
items.e: Unit 7 SQL.

items.q: Explain various steps of planning a database.
items.q2: ڈیٹا بیس کی منصوبہ بندی کے مختلف مراحل بیان کریں۔
items.q3: د ډېټابېس د پلانولو مختلف ګامونه تشریح کړئ.
items.a: Model answer: Steps in planning a database: (1) Decide the purpose of the database and what information it must give. (2) Collect and study the data and find the entities (tables). (3) Decide the fields (attributes) of each table. (4) Choose the primary key of each table. (5) Find the relationships between the tables (1:1, 1:M, M:N) and add foreign keys. (6) Normalise the design to remove redundancy. (7) Create the database, enter sample data, test it and refine.
items.e: Unit 7 database planning.

items.q: What is a relation? Explain the degree of relationships with examples.
items.q2: ریلیشن کیا ہے؟ ریلیشن شپس کی ڈگری مثالوں کے ساتھ بیان کریں۔
items.q3: اړیکه څه ده؟ د اړیکو درجه په بېلګو سره تشریح کړئ.
items.a: Model answer: A relation (relationship) is an association between entities, for example Teacher teaches Student. Degree of a relationship is the number of entity types that take part: (1) Unary (degree 1): an entity related to itself, e.g. an Employee manages Employee. (2) Binary (degree 2): two entities, e.g. Student enrols in Course. (3) Ternary (degree 3): three entities, e.g. Doctor prescribes Medicine to Patient.
items.e: Unit 7 relationships; the degree examples can be changed.

items.a: Model answer: An ERD (entity relationship diagram) is a picture of a database design: rectangles are entities, ovals are attributes (the primary key underlined), diamonds are relationships, and lines with 1, M or N show cardinality. It shows the entities and how they are connected before the tables are made. The ERDs of the hospital and airline systems are described in the next two answers.

items.q: Describe different steps of Transformation of E-R Model into Relational Schema.
items.q2: ای-آر ماڈل کی ریلیشنل اسکیما میں تبدیلی کے مختلف مراحل بیان کریں۔
items.q3: د E-R ماډل اړوندې طرحې ته د بدلولو مختلف ګامونه بیان کړئ.
items.a: Model answer: Transformation of the E-R model into a relational schema: (1) Each strong entity becomes a table; its attributes become columns and its key attribute the primary key. (2) A weak entity becomes a table that includes the key of its owner entity as a foreign key and as part of its primary key. (3) A one-to-one relationship: put the primary key of one table as a foreign key in the other. (4) A one-to-many relationship: put the primary key of the "one" side as a foreign key in the "many" side table. (5) A many-to-many relationship becomes a new table whose primary key is made of the two foreign keys, plus any attributes of the relationship. (6) A multi-valued attribute becomes a separate table linked by a foreign key.
items.e: Unit 7 ER to relational.

items.q: What is Normalization? Explain the following Normal Forms 1NF, 2NF, 3NF.
items.q2: نارملائزیشن کیا ہے؟ درج ذیل نارمل فارمز ۱ این ایف، ۲ این ایف، ۳ این ایف کی وضاحت کریں۔
items.q3: نورمال کول څه دی؟ لاندې نورمال بڼې 1NF، 2NF، 3NF تشریح کړئ.
items.a: Model answer: Normalization is the process of organising the tables of a database to remove redundancy and avoid insertion, update and deletion anomalies by splitting big tables into smaller related ones. 1NF (first normal form): every field holds only a single (atomic) value, no repeating groups, and each row is unique. 2NF: the table is in 1NF and every non-key attribute depends on the whole primary key (no partial dependency on a part of a composite key). 3NF: the table is in 2NF and no non-key attribute depends on another non-key attribute (no transitive dependency).
items.e: Unit 7 normalization.

items.a: Model answer: Creating a form in Access: (1) Select the table or query in the navigation pane. (2) On the Create tab click Form for an automatic form, or Form Wizard for a guided one. (3) In the wizard choose the fields to display, the layout (columnar, tabular, datasheet or justified) and the style, and give the form a title. (4) Click Finish. The form opens in Form view to enter data, and Design view can be used to change the layout.
items.e: Unit 8 forms.

items.q: Write the steps for creating relationships between tables.
items.q2: ٹیبلز کے درمیان تعلقات بنانے کے اقدامات لکھیں۔
items.q3: د جدولونو ترمنځ د اړیکو د جوړولو ګامونه ولیکئ.
items.a: Model answer: Steps to create a relationship between tables: (1) Close all open tables. (2) On the Database Tools tab click Relationships. (3) In the Show Table box select the tables and click Add, then Close. (4) Drag the primary key field of one table onto the matching foreign key field of the other table. (5) In the Edit Relationships box check the fields and tick Enforce Referential Integrity if wanted. (6) Click Create; a join line appears. Save the relationships.
items.e: Unit 8 relationships.

items.q: Explain different types of queries used in Access.
items.q2: ایکسیس میں استعمال ہونے والی کوئریز کی مختلف اقسام کی وضاحت کریں۔
items.q3: په Access کې کارېدونکې د پوښتنو مختلف ډولونه تشریح کړئ.
items.a: Model answer: Types of queries in Access: (1) Select query: gets data from one or more tables and shows it (the most common). (2) Parameter query: asks for a value when it is run. (3) Crosstab query: shows summarised data in rows and columns like a spreadsheet. (4) Action queries change data: Make-Table, Append, Update and Delete queries.
items.e: Unit 8 queries.

items.q: How can one-to-many relationship can be created between two tables? Give example.
items.q2: دو ٹیبلز کے درمیان ایک سے کئی تعلق کیسے بنایا جا سکتا ہے؟ مثال دیں۔
items.q3: د دوو جدولونو ترمنځ د یو-ته-ډیر اړیکه څنګه جوړېدای شي؟ بېلګه ورکړئ.
items.a: Model answer: A one-to-many relationship is created by taking the primary key of the "one" table as a foreign key in the "many" table and joining them in the Relationships window (drag the key field from the "one" table to the foreign key field of the "many" table). Example: Customer (CustomerID primary key) and Orders (OrderID primary key, CustomerID foreign key): one customer can have many orders, but each order belongs to only one customer.
items.e: Unit 8 relationships.

items.q: What is a query? How query is created using wizard option in Access 2007?
items.q2: کوئری کیا ہے؟ ایکسیس ۲۰۰۷ میں ویزرڈ آپشن استعمال کر کے کوئری کیسے بنائی جاتی ہے؟
items.q3: پوښتنه څه ده؟ په Access 2007 کې د مرستندوي اختیار په کارولو پوښتنه څنګه جوړېږي؟
items.a: Model answer: A query is a database object that asks a question of the database: it searches one or more tables for records that satisfy given conditions and shows the result, and it can also sort data or perform calculations. Using the Simple Query Wizard in Access 2007: (1) Create > Query Wizard > Simple Query Wizard > OK. (2) Choose the table or query and move the wanted fields to the Selected Fields list. (3) Click Next, choose Detail or Summary. (4) Give the query a title. (5) Click Finish; the result opens as a datasheet.
items.e: Unit 8 queries.

items.q: Why does the Quaid stress on youth to be continuously vigilant?
items.q2: قائد نوجوانوں پر مسلسل چوکس رہنے پر کیوں زور دیتے ہیں؟
items.q3: قایدِ اعظم ولې پر ځوانانو ټینګار کوي چې تل هوښیار اوسي؟
items.a: Model answer: The Quaid tells the youth to stay vigilant because the enemies of Pakistan, who failed to stop its birth, kept trying to weaken and destroy it: the Punjab and Delhi killings and the refugee crisis, India withholding Pakistan's cash balances and share of military equipment, and an economic blockade. The young must watch for such dangers, beware of fifth columnists and selfish exploiters, and judge honest servants of the State.
items.e: The speech, Dhaka University Convocation, 24 March 1948.

items.q: What, according to the Quaid, is the prime responsibility of youth?
items.q2: قائد کے مطابق نوجوانوں کی بنیادی ذمہ داری کیا ہے؟
items.q3: د قاید په وینا د ځوانانو لومړنۍ مسؤولیت څه دی؟
items.a: Model answer: According to the Quaid, the main responsibility of the youth is to devote their attention solely to their studies, in fairness to themselves, their parents and the State, so that they can equip themselves for the battle of life and become an asset and source of strength for Pakistan.
items.e: "Your main occupation should be ... to devote your attention solely to your studies."

items.q: Having read the text of the Quaid's speech, what traits of character the Quaid wants to see in the educated youth?
items.q2: قائد کی تقریر کا متن پڑھنے کے بعد، قائد تعلیم یافتہ نوجوانوں میں کردار کی کون سی خصوصیات دیکھنا چاہتے ہیں؟
items.q3: د قاید د وینا متن لوستلو وروسته، قاید په زده‌کړیالو ځوانانو کې د کردار کومې ځانګړتیاوې لیدل غواړي؟
items.a: Model answer: He wants educated youth who are honest, selfless and dedicated to serving the people; disciplined and united; hard-working and constructive rather than merely militant; vigilant against selfish and disloyal people; independent and self-reliant, not looking only for government jobs; and proud of their country.
items.e: Based on the speech.

items.q: What advice does the Quaid give to the youth about the choice of career?
items.q2: قائد نوجوانوں کو پیشے کے انتخاب کے بارے میں کیا مشورہ دیتے ہیں؟
items.q3: قاید ځوانانو ته د مسلک د غوراولو په اړه کوم مشوره ورکوي؟
items.a: Model answer: The Quaid advises the youth to get out of the old rut of seeking only government service, which the colonial system produced (well-trained clerks), and to take up other careers such as trade, commerce, industry, agriculture, science and technology, so that they can build the economy of the new country.
items.e: "Hitherto, you have been following the rut ... get out of that rut." Other careers are also acceptable.

items.q: Compare and contrast the youth of today with ideal youth of Quaid -e- Azam as described in his speech.
items.q2: آج کے نوجوانوں کا قائدِ اعظم کی تقریر میں بیان کیے گئے مثالی نوجوانوں سے موازنہ اور تضاد کریں۔
items.q3: نن ورځې ځوانان د قایدِ اعظم له هغو مثالي ځوانانو سره پرتله کړئ او توپیر یې ښودل چې په وینا کې بیان شوي دي.
items.a: Model answer: The ideal youth of the Quaid's speech are disciplined, united, honest, serious about their studies, alert to the nation's enemies and ready to serve with heart and soul, and they look beyond clerical jobs to build the country. Many young people today are often distracted by social media, entertainment and shortcuts, run after degrees and jobs instead of skills and service, and are less united or disciplined; but there are many hard-working students today too. To match the ideal, today's youth should combine study, character and national service.
items.e: Open-ended; other valid comparisons are possible.

items.q: Having read the text of ‘Responsibilities of Youth’, what, in your view could be the possible role of youth in crisis management of the country?
items.q2: ‘نوجوانوں کی ذمہ داریاں’ کا متن پڑھنے کے بعد آپ کی رائے میں ملک کے بحران کے انتظام میں نوجوانوں کا ممکنہ کردار کیا ہو سکتا ہے؟
items.q3: د ‘د ځوانانو مسؤولیتونه’ متن لوستلو وروسته ستاسو په نظر د هېواد د بحران په مدیریت کې د ځوانانو ممکن رول څه کېدای شي؟
items.a: Model answer: In a crisis the youth can help by staying calm and informed, avoiding rumours and panic, volunteering in relief work (first aid, blood donation, collecting and distributing supplies), using technology to share correct information, keeping unity and discipline, helping the elderly and the needy, and preparing themselves with skills so they can help rebuild afterwards.
items.e: Open-ended; other valid answers are possible.

items.q: Quaid says “Not only has Pakistan survived the shock of that upheaval [scan obscured] than ever.” Which upheaval is he talking about?
items.q2: قائد کہتے ہیں “پاکستان نہ صرف اس اتھل پتھل کے صدمے سے بچ نکلا ہے [scan obscured] پہلے سے زیادہ۔” وہ کس اتھل پتھل کی بات کر رہے ہیں؟
items.q3: قاید وايي “پاکستان نه یوازې د هغې ګډوډۍ له ټکان څخه ژوندی پاتې شو [scan obscured] تر پخوا.” هغه د کومې ګډوډۍ خبره کوي؟
items.a: Model answer: He is talking about the upheaval of the Partition of 1947: the Punjab and Delhi holocaust in which thousands of men, women and children were killed and millions were uprooted, and over fifty lakh refugees came into the Punjab within weeks.
items.e: Pakistan survived that shock and "emerged stronger".

items.q: a. “beware of the fifth columnist among ourselves.”
items.q2: الف. “اپنے درمیان پانچویں کالم والے سے ہوشیار رہیں۔”
items.q3: a. “زموږ په منځ کې له پنځم کالم والا څخه خبر اوسئ.”
items.a: Model answer: A fifth columnist is a person inside a country who secretly helps its enemies. The Quaid warns the youth to beware of such traitors, who pose as friends but weaken the nation from within by spreading rumours, division and disloyalty.
items.e: Open-ended interpretation; other valid wording is possible.

items.q: b. “guard against and weed out selfish who only wish to exploit you so that they may swim.”
items.q2: ب. “ان خود غرضوں سے بچیں اور انہیں اکھاڑ پھینکیں جو صرف آپ کا استحصال کرنا چاہتے ہیں تاکہ وہ تیر سکیں۔”
items.q3: b. “له هغو ځان‌غوښتونکو ځان وساتئ او هغوی لرې کړئ چې یوازې غواړي تاسو استفاده کړي ترڅو ځان لامبو وهي.”
items.a: Model answer: The Quaid warns that some selfish people use others for their own gain ("swim" means they prosper at others' expense). The youth should recognise such exploiters, avoid being used by them and remove them from public life, and instead support the honest and unselfish servants of the State.
items.e: Open-ended interpretation.

items.q: “Hitherto, you have been following the rut… . All you think and hanker for is government service… .Now I want you to get out of that rut and that mentality specially now that we are in free Pakistan.”
items.q2: ج. “اب تک آپ پرانی لکیر پر چلتے رہے ہیں…۔ آپ جو کچھ سوچتے اور جس کی خواہش کرتے ہیں وہ سرکاری ملازمت ہے…۔ اب میں چاہتا ہوں کہ آپ اس لکیر اور اس ذہنیت سے نکلیں خاص طور پر اب جب کہ ہم آزاد پاکستان میں ہیں۔”
items.q3: “تر اوسه تاسو د زړې لارې تعقیب کړی دی… . هرڅه چې تاسو یې فکر کوئ او تږي یاست هغه دولتي دنده ده… . اوس زه غواړم چې تاسو له دې لارې او دې ذهنیت څخه وځئ په ځانګړې توګه اوس چې موږ په آزاد پاکستان کې یو.”
items.a: Model answer: In the colonial system education aimed at producing clerks, so graduates only wanted government service. The Quaid says this rut and mentality must be left behind because the new State needs people in all fields (business, industry, science, agriculture), and young people should become independent and creative builders, not job-seekers only.
items.e: Open-ended interpretation.

items.a: Model answer: The young seagull was the only one of the family who had not yet flown. His brothers and sister had already flown away, but he was afraid, so he stayed alone on the ledge. Hunger and the call of his family made him join them, because it was time for him to learn to fly.

items.q: Why don't his parents, his brothers and sister give him food?
items.q2: اس کے والدین، بھائی اور بہن اسے کھانا کیوں نہیں دیتے؟

items.a: Model answer: His parents, brothers and sister did not give him food because they wanted to force him to fly. They knew his hunger would push him to overcome his fear, so they ate in front of him and left him hungry.

items.q: What was the attitude of the family towards the young Seagull? Was it agreeable to you or not? Explain

items.a: Model answer: The family was strict and harsh: they mocked him, scolded him, ignored him and kept food from him because they wanted him to learn to fly. Their aim was good, but I do not fully agree with the method: encouragement and patience would have been kinder, though a little pressure can help a frightened learner to try.
items.e: Open-ended; other valid opinions are possible if explained.

items.q3: د ځوان سمندري ټوپک د غورځېدو سمدستي وروسته احساسات، عملونه او فکرونه په خپلو کلمو کې بیان کړئ.

Then, to his surprise, he found that his wings supported him; he floated and glided, felt joy and wonder, and flew down to the sea and the others. He realised he could fly and that his fear had been unnecessary.

items.q: What could be the author's purpose behind writing the story 'His First Flight'?
items.q2: کہانی ‘اس کی پہلی پرواز’ لکھنے کے پیچھے مصنف کا مقصد کیا ہو سکتا ہے؟

items.a: Model answer: The author wants to show that fear is often greater than the danger and that we discover our strength only when we try. It also shows how parents' firm guidance, and the push of necessity (hunger), help the young to become independent.
items.e: Open-ended; other valid purposes are possible.

items.q3: په ‘د هغه لومړنۍ الوتنه’ کې د ځوان سمندري ټوپک له الوتنې مخکې او وروسته د کورنۍ د غړو چلند پرتله کړئ او توپیر یې ښودل.
items.a: Model answer: Before the flight the family were harsh: they shouted, taunted, ignored him and starved him. After he flew, they were proud and joyful: they praised him, flew around him and gave him food. Their goal throughout was to make him independent, but their treatment changed from pressure to celebration.

items.a: Model answer: "He felt certain that his wings would never support him; so he bent his head and ran away back to the little hole under the ledge." The cause is his certainty (fear) that his wings would fail; the effect is that he ran away and did not fly.

items.q: What is the significance of the title of the poem 'Good Timber'?
items.q2: نظم ‘اچھی لکڑی’ کے عنوان کی کیا اہمیت ہے؟
items.q3: د نظم ‘ښه لرګی’ د سرلیک اهمیت څه دی؟
items.a: Model answer: "Good timber" is strong, useful wood. The title is a metaphor: just as a tree becomes strong timber only by fighting wind, storm, cold and shade, a person becomes strong in character only by facing difficulties. The title therefore sums up the poet's message that hardship and struggle build strength.
items.e: Good Timber by Douglas Malloch.

items.q: What is good timber? How does tree grow into good timber?
items.q2: اچھی لکڑی کیا ہے؟ درخت اچھی لکڑی میں کیسے بدلتا ہے؟
items.q3: ښه لرګی څه دی؟ ونه څنګه په ښه لرګي بدلېږي؟
items.a: Model answer: Good timber is strong, sound wood from a tree that has grown tall and firm. A tree grows into good timber not with ease but through struggle: it must fight for sun, sky, air and light, and face strong winds, storms, snow, rain and cold. The harder the wind, the stronger the tree grows.
items.e: "Good timber does not grow with ease; the stronger wind, the stronger trees."

items.a: Model answer: According to the poet, people who never work hard or struggle never grow into strong, capable persons. Like the tree that stands alone in the open plain and never has to fight for light and rain, they stay weak and unimportant: they "live and die as they began" without achieving anything.
items.e: The tree that never fights remains "a scrubby thing"; the man who never toils never becomes "a manly man".

items.a: Model answer: A person can reach his true potential by working hard, facing difficulties bravely and not avoiding struggle. In the poem, the tree that has fought sun, wind and storm becomes a forest king, while the tree in the open plain that gets everything easily stays a scrubby thing. In the same way, a man who has to toil, to earn his share and overcome hardship becomes a strong, manly person.
items.e: "The more the storm, the more the strength."

items.a: Model answer: The whole poem is an extended metaphor comparing a tree with a man. The tree that struggles against wind, rain and shade becomes strong timber just as a man who toils and overcomes hardship becomes a strong, successful person: "In trees and men good timbers grow."

items.q: How is the theme of ‘From Mother . . . With Love’ a universal theme present in literature across all cultures?
items.q2: ‘ماں کی طرف سے . . . محبت کے ساتھ’ کا موضوع تمام ثقافتوں کے ادب میں موجود عالمگیر موضوع کیسے ہے؟
items.q3: د ‘له مور څخه . . . په مینه’ موضوع څنګه په ټولو کلتورونو کې په ادب کې شته نړیوال موضوع دی؟
items.a: Model answer: The central theme is a parent's selfless love and the way a family faces death with courage. Every culture knows the love of mothers and fathers, the pain of losing someone and the idea of loving someone enough to protect them from pain, so readers everywhere can relate to Minta's story. Themes of love, sacrifice, loss and growing up are universal.
items.e: Story by Zoa Sherburne.
items.h: Answer the following questions.

items.q: Comment on the plot of the story ‘From Mother . . . With Love’.
items.q2: کہانی ‘ماں کی طرف سے . . . محبت کے ساتھ’ کے پلاٹ پر تبصرہ کریں۔
items.q3: د کیسې ‘له مور څخه . . . په مینه’ پر پلاټ تبصره وکړئ.
items.a: Model answer: Minta Hawley, a teenage girl, learns from her father at the beach that her mother is going to die within three months. They decide not to tell the mother and to keep the family happy. Minta hides her pain and carries on, until her mother dies. While clearing her clothes, Minta finds suitcases full of Christmas gifts that her mother had prepared for everyone: the mother knew all along and kept up the pretence too. Moved, Minta accepts her loss, takes her mother's place (vitamin pills, blue chair) and begins to grow up.
items.e: Plot: exposition, rising action (secret), climax (gifts), resolution (blue chair).

items.q3: د کیسې ‘له مور څخه . . . په مینه’ راوي یا خبرې کوونکی وپېژنئ.
items.a: Model answer: The story is told by an unnamed third-person narrator who knows Minta's thoughts and feelings (limited omniscient point of view), so we see events through Minta's eyes.
items.e: It is not told by Minta herself in the first person.

items.a: Model answer: Minta is loving, sensitive, mature and strong. She has a close bond with her parents; she keeps her grief hidden to protect her mother and father, and stays home to help, putting the family before her own wish to go to school. She is also lively and humorous (teasing her mother), observant, and capable of change: after discovering her mother's gifts she grows from a girl into a responsible young woman.

items.q: What is the conflict in the story? How is it resolved?
items.q2: کہانی میں تنازع کیا ہے؟ وہ کیسے حل ہوتا ہے؟
items.q3: په کیسه کې شخړه څه ده؟ دا څنګه حل کېږي؟
items.a: Model answer: The main conflict is internal and emotional: Minta struggles between her grief at the coming death of her mother and her need to behave normally so that her mother is not distressed. There is also the conflict between truth and pretence in the family. It is resolved when Minta discovers the prepared Christmas gifts, understands that her mother knew the truth and accepted it, and she then finds peace and takes up her mother's role.
items.e: Conflict: person vs self/circumstance.

items.q: Which approach would you have preferred — deception or honesty — if you had to deal with similar circumstances like Minta’s mother ? Give reasons for your choice.

items.q3: که تاسو باید د منټا د مور په څېر شرایطو سره معامله کړې وای نو کوم طریقه به مو خوښه کړې وای — دوکه که صداقت؟ د خپل انتخاب دلایل ورکړئ.
items.a: Model answer: I would prefer honesty, because a person has the right to know the truth about her own life and to say goodbye, settle her affairs and spend the last days as she wishes. Pretending causes loneliness for everyone and prevents sharing grief. However, deception can protect someone from fear, and in the story it let the family enjoy a happy last season. Therefore I would tell the truth gently and with love.
items.e: Open-ended; the opposite choice with good reasons is also acceptable.

items.q: How did the vitamin pills become the symbol of responsibility?
items.q2: وٹامن کی گولیاں ذمہ داری کی علامت کیسے بن گئیں؟
items.q3: د ویټامین ګولۍ د مسؤولیت نښه څنګه شوې؟
items.a: Model answer: Before going to hospital Mother asked Minta to see that Father took his vitamin pills because he was careless. After her death, Minta tidies the house and puts the pills where she will see them. The pills thus become a symbol of care and responsibility passing from mother to daughter: Minta now looks after her father as her mother did.

items.q3: د کیسې په اوږدو کې منټا څنګه بدله شوه؟ خپل ځواب یوازې پنځو جملو ته محدود کړئ.
items.a: Model answer: At the start Minta is a carefree girl looking forward to boarding school. After learning the truth she becomes serious and quietly strong, hiding her sorrow. After her mother's death she is numb and cannot cry, avoiding people. Finding the hidden gifts breaks her shell and she cries and understands her mother's courage. At the end she takes over her mother's role and smiles at her father, showing she has grown up.

items.q3: شین چوکۍ ولې مهمه وه؟ تشریح کړئ.
items.a: Model answer: The blue chair by the fireplace was her mother's place, so when it is empty it reminds the family of her absence. At the end Minta sits in the chair "as if she belonged there", which shows that she accepts her mother's death and takes her place as the heart of the home, comforting her father and moving on to a new life.

items.a: Model answer: Minta finds suitcases full of Christmas gifts, each tagged in her mother's writing ("To Minta from Mother ... with love"), which Mother had prepared for everyone before dying. This shows that she knew she was dying, faced it calmly, and still loved and cared for her family. This comforts Minta because her mother was not afraid or alone, and had peace and prepared the family with love.

items.a: Model answer: Character sketch of Minta: Minta Hawley is a loving, thoughtful teenage girl, with her father's dark eyes and her mother's nature. She is playful with her mother and father, ready to give up her plan for school to stay with her family, and brave enough to hide her sorrow. She shows great self-control and patience, then emotional depth when she finally cries. By the end she is mature, responsible and caring, taking on her mother's duties and bringing hope to her father.

items.q: What is the dominant theme of the poem ‘Mother to Son’?
items.q2: نظم ‘ماں کا بیٹے کے نام’ کا غالب موضوع کیا ہے؟
items.q3: د نظم ‘مور له زوی ته’ غالب موضوع څه دی؟
items.a: Model answer: The dominant theme is perseverance in the face of hardship. A mother tells her son that her life has not been easy ("no crystal stair") but she kept climbing, and she urges him not to give up or turn back, whatever difficulties he faces. It also shows a mother's love, wisdom and hope.
items.e: 'Mother to Son' by Langston Hughes.

items.q: What are some of the literary techniques used in the poem ‘Mother to Son’?
items.q2: نظم ‘ماں کا بیٹے کے نام’ میں استعمال ہونے والی کچھ ادبی تکنیکیں کیا ہیں؟
items.q3: په نظم ‘مور له زوی ته’ کې کارېدونکې ځینې ادبي تخنیکونه کوم دي؟
items.a: Model answer: The poem uses extended metaphor (life as a staircase), imagery (tacks, splinters, boards torn up, bare floors), repetition ("And ... And ..."), direct address (the mother speaking to "son"), symbolism (stairs/landings = progress and rest), dialect (non-standard speech) to give authenticity, free verse with irregular line length, and a conversational, dramatic-monologue tone.
items.e: Langston Hughes, 'Mother to Son'.
items.h: Answer the following questions.

items.q: What is an extended metaphor? How does Hughes use this literary technique to illustrate the consistent struggle of mother in her life? Give examples from the poem.
items.q2: توسیع شدہ استعارہ کیا ہے؟ ہیوز اس ادبی تکنیک کو ماں کی زندگی میں مسلسل جدوجہد کو واضح کرنے کے لیے کیسے استعمال کرتے ہیں؟ نظم سے مثالیں دیں۔
items.q3: غځېدلې استعاره څه ده؟ هیوز دا ادبي تخنیک د مور په ژوند کې د دوامدارې مبارزې د روښانه کولو لپاره څنګه کاروي؟ له نظم څخه بېلګې ورکړئ.
items.a: Model answer: An extended metaphor compares two unlike things throughout the whole poem. Hughes compares the mother's life to a staircase: it is not a "crystal stair" (smooth and luxurious) but has "tacks", "splinters", "boards torn up" and places with "no carpet on the floor", which stand for pain, poverty and obstacles. Yet she keeps "reachin' landin's, turnin' corners", meaning she has made progress; she is still climbing, showing her constant struggle.
items.e: 'Mother to Son'.

items.q: In the poem ‘Mother to Son’, Hughes repeats some lines. What function does it serve in poem? Explain.
items.q2: نظم ‘ماں کا بیٹے کے نام’ میں ہیوز کچھ مصرعے دہراتے ہیں۔ نظم میں اس کا کیا کام ہے؟ وضاحت کریں۔
items.q3: په نظم ‘مور له زوی ته’ کې هیوز ځینې کرښې تکراروي. په نظم کې دا کومه دنده ترسره کوي؟ تشریح کړئ.
items.a: Model answer: Repetition of lines such as "I'se been a-climbin' on" and of "And" at the start of lines creates rhythm and a sense of continuous effort, imitating the steady climb. It stresses the mother's persistence and emphasises her advice not to stop or sit down on the steps. It also gives the poem the feeling of spoken speech.

items.q: What type of imagery is used in the poem ‘Mother to Son’? What does it suggest?
items.q2: نظم ‘ماں کا بیٹے کے نام’ میں کس قسم کی پیکر تراشی استعمال ہوئی ہے؟ یہ کیا ظاہر کرتی ہے؟
items.q3: په نظم ‘مور له زوی ته’ کې کوم ډول انځورګري کارول شوې؟ دا څه ښيي؟
items.a: Model answer: The poem mainly uses visual and tactile imagery: tacks, splinters, torn boards, bare floors, dark stairs with no light ("it's dark"). This imagery suggests a hard, painful and uncertain life full of obstacles, but also an endless, upward journey in which the mother moves ahead in the dark.

items.q2: نظم ‘ماں کا بیٹے کے نام’ کا لہجہ کیا ہے؟ نظم سے مثالوں کے ساتھ اپنی رائے کی تائید کریں۔
items.q3: د نظم ‘مور له زوی ته’ لهجه څه ده؟ له نظم څخه د مثالونو سره خپل نظر ملاتړ کړئ.
items.a: Model answer: The tone is serious, honest and encouraging: the mother speaks frankly ("Life for me ain't been no crystal stair"), but also firmly and lovingly urges her son: "So boy, don't you turn back. Don't you set down on the steps." The tone is also determined and hopeful.

items.a: Reference to the context: These lines are taken from the poem 'Mother to Son' written by Langston Hughes. They are the opening lines of this dramatic monologue, in which a mother speaks to her son. Explanation: The mother tells her son that her life has not been easy or smooth like a "crystal stair"; it has had "tacks" (small sharp problems), "splinters" (small hurts) and "boards torn up" (breaks and failures), and places with no carpet, that is, bare, poor and uncomfortable. The staircase is an extended metaphor for life, and the mother wants to say honestly that life is full of difficulty, so that her son will understand that struggle is normal and that she has survived it.

items.a: Model answer: The choice is the toughest because it affects the whole of one's life: we spend about 25% of each year, roughly 11½ of 35 working years, at work; many people choose careers that only look secure or well-paid and end up unhappy; interests also change over time, and a person needs to know himself, the occupations and their requirements.

items.q2: خود جائزہ کیا ہے؟ یہ پیشے کے انتخاب میں کس حد تک مددگار ہے؟
items.q3: ځان‌ارزونه څه ده؟ دا د مسلک په غوراوي کې تر کومې کچې ګټوره ده؟
items.a: Model answer: Self-assessment means knowing yourself: your skills, interests, likes and dislikes, values and needs, including your hobbies. It is helpful because it shows which occupations suit you, keeps you from choosing a career for the wrong reasons (money, security), and helps you to find satisfaction in your work.

items.q: Summarize the text of the lesson and extract the main points of the process of career choice. Now transfer the salient points of the process of career choice into flow chart and critically analyze the process.
items.q2: سبق کے متن کا خلاصہ کریں اور پیشے کے انتخاب کے عمل کے اہم نکات نکالیں۔ اب پیشے کے انتخاب کے عمل کے نمایاں نکات کو بہاؤ کے چارٹ میں منتقل کریں اور عمل کا تنقیدی تجزیہ کریں۔
items.q3: د درس متن لنډ کړئ او د مسلک د غوراوي د پروسې مهم ټکي را وباسئ. اوس د مسلک د غوراوي د پروسې مهم ټکي په فلوچارټ کې ولیږدوئ او پروسه په انتقادي ډول تحلیل کړئ.
items.a: Model answer: Summary: choosing a career is vital; the writer advises (1) self-assessment of skills, interests and values; (2) reflecting on likes and dislikes and on hobbies; (3) searching for occupations that match the interests (e.g. teaching, medicine, accounting); (4) finding out the education, certification and skills needed; (5) making a plan and following it. Flow chart: Self-assessment -> Reflect on likes/dislikes -> Search occupations -> Check requirements -> Plan & decide -> Review. Critical analysis: the process is logical and practical, but it should also include advice from family and mentors, real work experience (internships), job market demand and the ability to change later.
items.e: Open-ended; other flow charts are acceptable.

items.q: Evaluate the steps of career choice and tell how effective or otherwise they are for your choice of career.
items.q2: پیشے کے انتخاب کے مراحل کا جائزہ لیں اور بتائیں کہ آپ کے پیشے کے انتخاب کے لیے وہ کتنے مؤثر ہیں یا نہیں۔
items.q3: د مسلک د غوراوي مرحلې ارزونه وکړئ او ووايئ چې ستاسو د مسلک د غوراوي لپاره دوی څومره اغېزمن دي یا نه.
items.a: Model answer: The steps are effective because they begin with me (my abilities and interests), then move to options and requirements. For my own career choice, self-assessment shows that I like problem solving and helping others, so I can explore medicine or engineering; the requirement step tells me which subjects and degrees are needed. A weakness is that the steps do not mention the job market and finance, so I would add counselling and internships.

items.q: What is the thesis statement of Mannes’ essay ‘Wasteland’?
items.q2: مینس کے مضمون ‘بنجر زمین’ کا مرکزی دعویٰ (تھیسس اسٹیٹمنٹ) کیا ہے؟
items.q3: د مانس د مقالې ‘ویجاړه ځمکه’ مرکزي ادعا (تیسس) څه ده؟
items.a: Model answer: The thesis of the essay is that modern society, in its greed and love of convenience, wastes and litters the earth with cans, bottles, plastic, cars and other rubbish. This is destroying nature and beauty, and in the end our heritage will be a heap of waste, so people must stop being wasteful.
items.e: 'Wasteland' by Marya Mannes.
items.h: Answer the following questions.

items.q: How many examples of waste does Mannes cite? What do they have in common?
items.q2: مینس کچرے کی کتنی مثالیں پیش کرتی ہے؟ ان میں کیا چیز مشترک ہے؟
items.q3: مانس د کثافاتو څو بېلګې وړاندې کوي؟ دوی کې څه ګډ دي؟
items.a: Model answer: Mannes cites many examples of waste: cans, bottles and polybags lying along roads; the steel and horsepower used to carry one person; packaging and paper wasted from cut forests; neon lights and roadside signs; heaps of rusting cars; rubbish dumped in ravines and rat-infested refuse mountains; and rivers, streams and lakes poisoned by factory waste. What they have in common is that they are all products of human greed and convenience that are carelessly thrown away and damage the natural environment.
items.e: Based on the essay.
items.h: Answer the following questions.

items.q: What purpose does Mannes want to achieve? Does it work?
items.q2: مینس کون سا مقصد حاصل کرنا چاہتی ہے؟ کیا یہ کامیاب ہوتا ہے؟
items.q3: مانس کومه موخه ترلاسه کول غواړي؟ ایا دا کار کوي؟
items.a: Model answer: Mannes wants to shock readers into seeing their own wastefulness and to change their behaviour so that they protect the land and its beauty. It works because of its powerful images, bitter rhetorical questions and the final warning about what we will leave behind; the reader feels shame and responsibility.
items.e: Open-ended evaluation; other valid views are possible.
items.h: Answer the following questions.

items.q: In what way is Mannes’ essay persuasive and how does it differ from a formal argument?
items.q2: مینس کا مضمون کس طرح قائل کرنے والا ہے اور یہ رسمی دلیل سے کیسے مختلف ہے؟
items.q3: د مانس مقاله په کومه توګه قانع کوونکې ده او دا له رسمي استدلال څخه څنګه توپیر لري؟
items.a: Model answer: The essay is persuasive because it appeals to emotions and conscience through vivid images, repeated rhetorical questions ("Who are these men ...?"), loaded words ("savages", "wasters", "despoilers") and a warning about the future. It differs from a formal argument, which proceeds logically with premises, evidence and counter-arguments in an objective tone, while Mannes mostly accuses and appeals.
items.e: Based on the essay.
items.h: Answer the following questions.

items.q: In paragraph number five, Mannes writes: “There will not be one beach, one hill, one lane, one meadow, one forest free from the debris of man and the stigma of his improvidence.” Is it an accurate statement or exaggerated? Explain.
items.q2: پیراگراف نمبر پانچ میں مینس لکھتی ہے: “ایک بھی ساحل، ایک بھی پہاڑی، ایک بھی گلی، ایک بھی چراگاہ، ایک بھی جنگل انسان کے ملبے اور اس کی بے فکری کے داغ سے پاک نہیں رہے گا۔” کیا یہ درست بیان ہے یا مبالغہ؟ وضاحت کریں۔
items.q3: په پنځم پراګراف کې مانس لیکي: “یو ساحل، یوه غونډۍ، یوه کوڅه، یو څړ‌ځای، یو ځنګل د انسان له پاتې شونو او د هغه د بې‌پروایۍ له داغ څخه پاک پاتې نه شي.” ایا دا سم بیان دی که مبالغه؟ تشریح کړئ.
items.a: Model answer: The statement is an exaggeration (hyperbole): there are still beaches, hills and forests free from debris. However, it is accurate in showing the direction in which careless waste is leading, and Mannes uses it deliberately to dramatise the danger and to warn that if nothing is done, no place will be left clean.
items.e: Open-ended; other valid views are possible.
items.h: Answer the following questions.

items.q: Who is Mannes’s audience? What assumptions does she make of it?
items.q2: مینس کے سامعین کون ہیں؟ وہ ان کے بارے میں کیا مفروضے قائم کرتی ہے؟
items.q3: د مانس لیدونکي څوک دي؟ هغه د هغوی په اړه کوم انګېرنې کوي؟
items.a: Model answer: Her audience is the ordinary, prosperous American consumer of the 1950s, and by extension all readers who are wasteful. She assumes that they are rich enough to waste, that they are careless and selfish, but also that they have a conscience and love their land, so they can be shamed into change.
items.e: Based on the essay.
items.h: Answer the following questions.

items.q: Why does Mannes use such a short paragraph (paragraph No.7)? Why does she not merge it with the longer paragraph that follows?
items.q2: مینس اتنا مختصر پیراگراف (پیراگراف نمبر 7) کیوں استعمال کرتی ہے؟ وہ اسے اگلے لمبے پیراگراف کے ساتھ ضم کیوں نہیں کرتی؟
items.q3: مانس ولې داسې لنډ پراګراف (۷ شمېره پراګراف) کاروي؟ هغه ولې دا له وروسته اوږد پراګراف سره نه یوځای کوي؟
items.a: Model answer: The short paragraph is meant to give emphasis: a single striking idea or question stands out and makes the reader pause and think, like a dramatic effect. If it were merged into the long paragraph, the force and the impact of the point would be lost.
items.e: Open-ended; the style point is the same for any very short paragraph.

items.q: Is Mannes argument based on emotion or factual evidence? Illustrate.
items.q2: کیا مینس کی دلیل جذبات پر مبنی ہے یا حقائق پر؟ وضاحت کریں۔
items.q3: ایا د مانس استدلال په احساساتو والړ دی که واقعي شواهدو؟ روښانه یې کړئ.
items.a: Model answer: Her argument depends mainly on emotion (pathos): vivid pictures of rubbish, harsh words like "savages" and "wasters", and rhetorical questions. Some factual evidence is present (a million tons of metal thrown away, forests cut for paper, rivers poisoned) but she gives no statistics or sources, so the appeal is chiefly emotional.
items.e: Based on the essay.

items.q3: په کمپس یا ښار کې یو داسې ځای وټاکئ چې د مانس د وینا اغېز ښيي. د مدیر ته په لیک کې هغه ځای د دې موخې سره بیان کړئ چې خپل لوستونکي د ککړتیا په اړه د څه کولو لپاره قانع کړئ. خو د موضوع د ټاکلو دمخه یوه ورځ د خپل چاپېریال د کثافاتو د ډولونو د بېلګو په لټولو تېره کړئ. کله چې تاسو په خپل کمپس یا ګاونډ کې ګرځئ نو څه وینئ؟ یادښتونه واخلئ.
items.a: Model answer: To the Editor: On my walk around our campus I found that the area behind the cafeteria has become a garbage dump. Empty bottles, plastic bags, food wrappers and broken chairs lie in the open, flies gather over them and the smell reaches the classrooms. I urge the administration to place more bins, to organise regular cleaning and recycling, and I request every student to use them. Let us keep our campus clean. Yours sincerely, a student.

items.q: What arrangements were made by Navasard for the coming home Arshak?
items.q2: نواسرد نے ارشک کے گھر آنے کے لیے کیا انتظامات کیے؟
items.q3: نواسرد د ارشک د کور ته د راتګ لپاره کوم تدارک وکړ؟
items.a: Model answer: Navasard cleaned the yard and swept the dirt, hammered in a protruding nail, fetched water and sprinkled the yard and floor, cut the biggest watermelon and picked ripe figs and other fruit, borrowed a new tablecloth, covered the table and the couch, and brought kindling for the fire. He kept the white lamb to be killed for shashlyk (roast meat) and waited for Arshak all night.
items.e: 'The White Lamb' by Sero Khanzadian.
items.h: Answer the following questions.

items.q: Why was Navasard so excited at the arrival of Arshak?
items.q2: نواسرد ارشک کی آمد پر اتنا پرجوش کیوں تھا؟
items.q3: نواسرد د ارشک په راتګ ولې دومره په ولوله کې و؟
items.a: Model answer: Navasard was excited because he had not seen Arshak for ten years, he loved him like his own son (he had brought him up after his parents died), he had sold his belongings to send him to study, and he was proud of the important man Arshak had become. He believed the long wait was finally over.
items.e: Based on the story.

items.q: Describe the plight of Navasard after the departure of Arshak without meeting him.
items.q2: ارشک کے اس سے ملے بغیر چلے جانے کے بعد نواسرد کی حالتِ زار بیان کریں۔
items.q3: د ارشک له هغه سره له لیدلو پرته د تللو وروسته د نواسرد حال بیان کړئ.
items.a: Model answer: After Arshak left without meeting him, Navasard was heartbroken and ashamed. He had waited all night with the food and the lamb prepared, he fell asleep at the table, and when he woke the neighbour told him Arshak was leaving. He climbed to the roof and watched the car vanish, then walked slowly with sunken eyes and a more stooped back, the white lamb following him. His plight shows bitter loneliness and disappointment.
items.e: Based on the end of the story.

items.q: What is the central idea of the story ‘The White Lamb’. Is this theme relevant to our culture as well?
items.q2: کہانی ‘سفید برہ’ کا مرکزی خیال کیا ہے؟ کیا یہ موضوع ہماری ثقافت سے بھی متعلق ہے؟
items.q3: د کیسې ‘سپینه وری’ مرکزي مفکوره څه ده؟ ایا دا موضوع زموږ له کلتور سره هم تړاو لري؟
items.a: Model answer: The central idea is the ingratitude and neglect of a successful child toward an elderly guardian who sacrificed everything, and the pain of the old man's love going unanswered. It is also relevant to our culture, where many young people go to cities or abroad for success, forget their rural parents and elders, and leave them lonely, although our religion and culture teach respect for parents and elders.
items.e: Open-ended; other valid views are possible.
items.h: Answer the following questions.

items.q: Write down the plot of the story ‘The White Lamb’.
items.q2: کہانی ‘سفید برہ’ کا پلاٹ لکھیں۔
items.q3: د کیسې ‘سپینه وری’ پلاټ ولیکئ.
items.a: Model answer: Exposition: old gardener Navasard hears from the team leader that his nephew Arshak, whom he raised, has come back after ten years. Rising action: he joyfully prepares gifts, melons, figs and a white lamb, cleans the house and waits. Climax: Arshak does not come but stays with the chairman, and Navasard waits all night. Falling action and resolution: in the morning he finds that Arshak is leaving in his car. The old man walks sadly down the path, the lamb following him.
items.e: Plot of 'The White Lamb'.
items.h: Answer the following questions.

items.q: Is there any conflict in the story ‘The White Lamb’? If yes, how is it resolved?
items.q2: کیا کہانی ‘سفید برہ’ میں کوئی تنازع ہے؟ اگر ہاں تو وہ کیسے حل ہوتا ہے؟
items.q3: ایا په کیسه ‘سپینه وری’ کې کومه شخړه شته؟ که هو، نو څنګه حل کېږي؟
items.a: Model answer: Yes. The conflict is between Navasard's deep love and expectation and Arshak's indifference (and pride in his social status). It is also an internal conflict of the old man between hope and disappointment. The conflict is not resolved happily: Arshak leaves without meeting him and Navasard is left alone with his sorrow, which makes the story tragic.
items.e: Conflict type: person vs person and person vs self.
items.h: Answer the following questions.

items.q: How would you resolve the conflict if you were the author of ‘The White Lamb’.
items.q2: اگر آپ ‘سفید برہ’ کے مصنف ہوتے تو آپ تنازع کو کیسے حل کرتے؟
items.q3: که ته د ‘سپینه وری’ لیکوال وای نو دې شخړه به دې څنګه حل کړې وای؟
items.a: Model answer: I would end the story with Arshak realising his duty. After the chairman's meeting he would hurry to the village, embrace his uncle, eat the shashlyk and promise to visit often or take him to the city. The lamb would be saved as a symbol of love. This resolution would show gratitude and reward the uncle's sacrifice.
items.e: Open-ended; other resolutions are possible.

items.q: Compare and contrast the character of Navasard and Arshak.
items.q2: نواسرد اور ارشک کے کردار کا موازنہ اور تقابل کریں۔
items.q3: د نواسرد او ارشک کرکټر پرتله او توپیر وکړئ.
items.a: Model answer: Navasard is simple, poor, loving, selfless, patient, humble and loyal; he sacrifices everything for Arshak and finds happiness in giving. Arshak is educated, successful and prosperous, but proud, selfish and ungrateful; he neglects the uncle who raised him. Both are connected by family, but Navasard is rich in feeling, Arshak is rich only in wealth.
items.e: Based on the story.

items.q: ‘How sharper than a serpent’s tooth it is to have thankless child.’ (Shakespeare). Critically evaluate this statement in the light of the text of lesson ‘The White Lamb’.
items.q2: ‘ناشکرا اولاد رکھنا سانپ کے دانت سے کتنا زیادہ تیز ہے۔’ (شیکسپیئر)۔ سبق ‘سفید برہ’ کے متن کی روشنی میں اس بیان کا تنقیدی جائزہ لیں۔
items.q3: ‘ناشکره اولاد لرل د مار د غاښ نه څومره تېز دی.’ (شکسپیر). د درس ‘سپینه وری’ د متن په رڼا کې دا بیان په انتقادي ډول وارزوئ.
items.a: Model answer: Shakespeare's line (King Lear) means that the hurt caused by a thankless child is sharper than a snake's bite. The story proves it: Navasard gave all he had, sold his things for Arshak's education and waited ten years, yet Arshak did not even visit his home, and the old man was crushed. The statement is largely true for this story, though we should remember that Arshak's reasons are not given and that ingratitude is one among many human responses.
items.e: Open-ended critical evaluation.

items.q: What is the theme of ‘The World is Too Much With Us’? And how is it developed in the poem?
items.q2: ‘دنیا ہم پر بہت حاوی ہے’ کا موضوع کیا ہے؟ اور نظم میں اسے کیسے آگے بڑھایا گیا ہے؟
items.q3: د ‘نړۍ پر موږ ډېره غالبه ده’ موضوع څه ده؟ او په نظم کې دا څنګه پرمختللې ده؟
items.a: Model answer: The theme is that people have become too absorbed in materialism ("getting and spending") and so have lost their connection with nature and its beauty. Wordsworth develops it by first stating the problem (we waste our powers and give our hearts away), then describing nature's beauty (the sea, the winds) to which we are insensitive, and finally wishing that he were a pagan who could feel nature's presence (Proteus and Triton).
items.e: William Wordsworth, 'The World is Too Much With Us'.
items.h: Answer the following questions.

items.q: What is the tone of the poem ‘The World is Too Much With Us’?
items.q2: نظم ‘دنیا ہم پر بہت حاوی ہے’ کا لہجہ کیا ہے؟
items.q3: د نظم ‘نړۍ پر موږ ډېره غالبه ده’ لهجه څه ده؟
items.a: Model answer: The tone is regretful, critical and passionate: the poet laments and condemns the materialism of his age, expresses despair ("we are out of tune") in the opening, and ends with an anguished, almost rebellious wish ("Great God! I'd rather be a Pagan").
items.e: Supported by the lines "Little we see in Nature that is ours" and "Great God!".
items.h: Answer the following questions.

items.q: What has made people insensitive to the beauty of nature?
items.q2: کس چیز نے لوگوں کو فطرت کی خوبصورتی کے لیے بے حس بنا دیا ہے؟
items.q3: څه شی خلک د طبیعت د ښکلا په وړاندې بې‌حسه کړي دي؟
items.a: Model answer: Greed and materialism, the constant "getting and spending", have made people insensitive to nature. They are so busy earning and consuming that they have given their hearts away ("a sordid boon") and no longer feel the beauty of the sea, the moon and the winds.
items.e: From the poem.
items.h: Answer the following questions.

items.q: What literary devices have been used by Wordsworth that give richness to the meaning of the poem?
items.q2: ورڈز ورتھ نے کون سے ادبی حربے استعمال کیے ہیں جو نظم کے معنی کو ثروت بخشتے ہیں؟
items.q3: ورډزورت کوم ادبي وسایل کارولي دي چې د نظم معنا ته بډاینه ورکوي؟
items.a: Model answer: Wordsworth uses personification ("the Sea that bares her bosom to the moon"), metaphor ("a sordid boon"), allusion (to the Greek sea gods Proteus and Triton), apostrophe ("Great God!"), alliteration ("getting and spending", "sleeping flowers"), imagery of the sea and the winds, and enjambment. The poem is a Petrarchan (Italian) sonnet, with an octave stating the problem and a sestet giving the wish.
items.e: These devices give richness and emotion to the meaning.
items.h: Answer the following questions.

items.q: What is personification? Pick out some examples of it from the poem ‘The World is Too Much With Us’.
items.q2: تشخیص (جان ڈالنا) کیا ہے؟ نظم ‘دنیا ہم پر بہت حاوی ہے’ سے اس کی کچھ مثالیں چنیں۔
items.q3: شخصیت‌بخښنه څه ده؟ د نظم ‘نړۍ پر موږ ډېره غالبه ده’ څخه یې څو بېلګې وټاکئ.
items.a: Model answer: Personification is giving human qualities or actions to non-human things. Examples from the poem: "This Sea that bares her bosom to the moon", where the sea is a woman who bares her bosom; and "The winds that will be howling at all hours ... up-gathered now like sleeping flowers", where the winds are like living creatures that howl and sleep.
items.e: 'The World is Too Much With Us'.
items.h: Answer the following questions.

items.q: Write down the rhyme scheme of the poem “The World is Too Much With Us”.
items.q2: نظم “دنیا ہم پر بہت حاوی ہے” کی قافیہ بندی لکھیں۔
items.q3: د نظم “نړۍ پر موږ ډېره غالبه ده” د قافیې ترتیب ولیکئ.
items.a: Model answer: The poem is a Petrarchan sonnet of 14 lines with the rhyme scheme abbaabba cdcdcd (octave abbaabba: a = soon, boon, moon, tune; b = powers, ours, hours, flowers; sestet cdcdcd: be/lea/sea and outworn/forlorn/horn).
items.e: Octave and sestet.

items.q: What is the central idea of Keen’s essay and how is it related to the title?
items.q2: کین کے مضمون کا مرکزی خیال کیا ہے اور اس کا عنوان سے کیا تعلق ہے؟
items.q3: د کین د مقالې مرکزي مفکوره څه ده او د سرلیک سره یې څه اړیکه ده؟
items.a: Model answer: Keen's central idea is that the strength of the family is essential for a free civilization: it is the first line of defence against dehumanisation, it teaches love, values and freedom, and it must be put back at the centre of our lives. The title "The Importance of Family" states exactly this subject.
items.e: Essay by Sam Keen.
items.h: Answer the following questions.

items.q: Analyze any two paragraphs of the essay ‘The Importance of Family’ and classify the sentences that support the main idea under the headings of definition, example, cause and effect, facts and opinions.
items.q2: مضمون ‘خاندان کی اہمیت’ کے کوئی دو پیراگراف تجزیہ کریں اور مرکزی خیال کی تائید کرنے والے جملوں کو تعریف، مثال، سبب اور اثر، حقائق اور آراء کے عنوانات کے تحت درجہ بند کریں۔
items.q3: د مقالې ‘د کورنۍ اهمیت’ کوم دوه پاراګرافونه وڅېړئ او هغه جملې چې اصلي مفکوره ملاتړ کوي د تعریف، بېلګې، لامل او اغېز، حقایقو او نظرونو په سرلیکونو لاندې طبقه‌بندي کړئ.
items.a: Model answer: Paragraph 1 (main idea: the family is essential to a free civilization). Definition/explanation: tyrants and utopian thinkers have always attacked the family. Examples: Plato, Marx and Mao tried to replace it with state institutions. Cause and effect: because the family trains free persons, tyrants first target it. Paragraph 4 (main idea: the word "economics" tells a parable). Fact: "economics" originally meant the management of a household. Cause and effect: after the industrial revolution, factories and banks took over loyalties and displaced the home. Opinion: the loss of home values harmed freedom.
items.e: Open-ended; any two paragraphs analysed correctly are acceptable.
items.h: Answer the following questions.

items.q: What according to Keen is the ‘only revolution’ that will heal the ills of our society?
items.q2: کین کے مطابق وہ ‘واحد انقلاب’ کون سا ہے جو ہمارے معاشرے کی بیماریوں کا علاج کرے گا؟
items.q3: د کین په وینا هغه ‘یوازېنی انقلاب’ کوم دی چې زموږ د ټولنې ناروغۍ ښه کوي؟
items.a: Model answer: According to Keen, the only revolution that will heal our society is one in which men and women together put the creation of a rich family life back at the centre of their values, and men realise that they are equally responsible with women for creating and nurturing the family and children.
items.e: Paragraph 5 of the essay.

items.q: Is the thesis of the essay ‘The Importance of Family’ implicitly or explicitly stated? Explain.
items.q2: کیا مضمون ‘خاندان کی اہمیت’ کا مرکزی دعویٰ (تھیسس) ضمنی طور پر بیان کیا گیا ہے یا صریح طور پر؟ وضاحت کریں۔
items.q3: ایا د مقالې ‘د کورنۍ اهمیت’ مرکزي ادعا ضمني ډول بیان شوې که په څرګند ډول؟ تشریح یې کړئ.
items.a: Model answer: The thesis is explicitly stated at the beginning of the essay: Keen says that "the strength of the family is essential to a civilization of free people", and the rest of the essay supports it with explanations, history and advice.
items.e: Paragraph 1.
items.h: Answer the following questions.

items.q: What is the point of the 4th paragraph? What does its contents have to do with thesis of the essay?
items.q2: چوتھے پیراگراف کا نکتہ کیا ہے؟ اس کے مندرجات کا مضمون کے مرکزی دعوے سے کیا تعلق ہے؟
items.q3: د ۴ پاراګراف ټکی څه دی؟ د هغه منځپانګه د مقالې د مرکزي ادعا سره څه اړیکه لري؟
items.a: Model answer: The fourth paragraph explains the history of the word "economics": it originally meant the art of managing a household with thrift and simplicity, but after the industrial revolution it came to mean the production and consumption system. When factory, store and bank took over men's loyalties, the home was displaced. This supports the thesis by showing how the modern economic order has weakened the family and how we have shifted our values.
items.e: Paragraph 4.

items.q: Keen says, “We heal ourselves by learning to give to our children what we did not receive.” What does he mean? Do you agree?
items.q2: کین کہتا ہے، “ہم اپنے بچوں کو وہ دینا سیکھ کر شفا پاتے ہیں جو ہمیں نہیں ملا۔” اس کا کیا مطلب ہے؟ کیا آپ متفق ہیں؟
items.q3: کین وايي، “موږ ځان ښه کوو د دې زده کړې سره چې خپلو ماشومانو ته هغه ورکړو چې موږ نه دي ترلاسه کړي.” د هغه مطلب څه دی؟ ایا تاسو موافق یاست؟
items.a: Model answer: He means that the best way to heal our childhood wounds (for example, absent or uncaring parents) is to give our own children the love, time and care we did not get; turning pain into care. I agree, because people who were neglected often become better parents when they decide to break the cycle.

items.q: How significant is the title of the story ‘The Blanket’?

items.a: Model answer: The title is significant because the blanket is the central symbol of the story. At first it is a "going-away gift" for Granddad, showing the father's plan to send his father to a home. When the girl calls it too expensive and Peter proposes to cut it in half and keep the other half for his father's old age, it becomes the means by which Peter makes his father realise how cruel it is to abandon an old parent.

items.q: Analyze the conflict in the story ‘The Blanket’? How is it resolved?
items.q2: کہانی ‘کمبل’ میں تنازع کا تجزیہ کریں۔ یہ کیسے حل ہوتا ہے؟

items.a: Model answer: The conflict is between Peter's father, who is sending Granddad away to a government home, and Peter, who loves his grandfather; it is also the father's conflict between duty and the pressure of his fiancée. It is resolved when Peter offers to cut the blanket in two and keep half for his father when he is old; the father feels shame, goes to his own father in silence and is forgiven, so Granddad stays.
items.e: Conflict: person vs person.

items.a: Model answer: The tone is mainly sorrowful and tender: sad at the start (the going-away gift, the last evening with the harmonica), then tense with the cold remarks of the girl, and finally emotionally moving and hopeful as the three cry together; the ending is bittersweet rather than joyous.
items.e: Based on the story.

items.q: What attitude does Peter show towards his Dad and Granddad?
items.q2: پیٹر اپنے ڈیڈ اور دادا کے ساتھ کیسا رویہ ظاہر کرتا ہے؟
items.q3: پېټر د خپل پلار او نیکه په وړاندې کوم چلند ښيي؟
items.a: Model answer: Peter loves and respects his Granddad deeply; he is sad at his leaving, and he is hurt by his Dad's decision but does not shout; he is respectful but firm with Dad, and by his sharp remark about the blanket he teaches his father a lesson in kindness and in compassion, making him realise the consequences of his action.

items.q: How is the theme of ‘The Blanket’ the theme of our disintegration of society as well?
items.q2: ‘کمبل’ کا موضوع ہمارے معاشرے کے بکھراؤ کا موضوع بھی کیسے ہے؟
items.q3: د ‘کمبله’ موضوع زموږ د ټولنې د ړنګېدو موضوع هم څنګه ده؟
items.a: Model answer: The story shows families abandoning old parents in order to please a new partner or because the elders are a burden, which is also a problem in our society today: nuclear families, old-age homes, neglect of the elderly, individualism, social media and the loss of the respect and time that join the generations. The theme warns that every child will one day grow old and that kindness to parents is a duty.

items.a: Model answer: The theme of 'Ozymandias' is the impermanence of power and human pride: even the greatest king and empire fade away with time, and only the ruins of a statue are left in the desert. The poem also shows the triumph of time over all human works and the irony of boasting about greatness.
items.e: 'Ozymandias' by Percy Bysshe Shelley.

items.q3: د شیلي لخوا انځور شوي د پاچا اوزیمنډیاس د مجسمې بدني حالت په خپلو الفاظو بیان کړئ.
items.a: Model answer: The statue has been reduced to ruins: two huge stone legs stand in the desert without a body ("trunkless"), and near them on the sand lies a shattered head half buried, with a frown, a wrinkled lip and a sneer of cold command. The face still shows the king's proud and cruel character, but the body is missing and the stone is broken.

items.q: What is the tone of the poem ‘Ozymandias’?
items.q2: نظم ‘اوزیمنڈیاس’ کا لہجہ کیا ہے؟
items.q3: د نظم ‘اوزیمنډیاس’ لهجه څه ده؟
items.a: Model answer: The tone is ironic, mocking and reflective: the poet shows the mighty king as helpless in ruins, with a quiet scorn for his arrogance, and a sense of the emptiness left by all human greatness.
items.e: Shelley mocks the king's boast "Look on my Works, ye Mighty, and despair!".

items.q: Throughout the poem ‘Ozymandias’, Shelly uses alliteration. Give some examples and show what purpose do they serve?
items.q2: نظم ‘اوزیمنڈیاس’ میں شیلی تکرارِ حروف (alliteration) استعمال کرتا ہے۔ کچھ مثالیں دیں اور بتائیں کہ وہ کیا مقصد پورا کرتی ہیں؟
items.q3: د نظم ‘اوزیمنډیاس’ په اوږدو کې شیلي alliteration کاروي. څو بېلګې ورکړئ او وښیئ چې دوی کومه موخه پوره کوي؟
items.a: Model answer: Examples of alliteration: "sneer of cold command", "boundless and bare", "lone and level sands", "shattered visage", "stamped on these lifeless things". The repetition of consonant sounds produces rhythm, emphasises the key images of the ruins, and creates a sense of desolation and of the vast, endless sand.
items.e: Alliteration gives musicality and emphasis.

items.q2: نظم کی قافیہ بندی بیان کریں۔
items.q3: د نظم د قافیې ترتیب بیان کړئ.
items.a: Model answer: The poem is a sonnet of 14 lines with an unusual, interlocking rhyme scheme: ababacdcedefef (land/sand/command = a; stone/frown = b; read/fed = c; things/kings = d; appear/despair/bare = e; decay/away = f). Shelley mixes features of the Petrarchan and Shakespearean forms.
items.e: Check against the printed poem.

items.q3: د نظم ‘اوزیمنډیاس’ انځورګري بیان کړئ. دا کوم ډول انځور راپورته کوي؟ انځورګري د نظم په لهجه کې څومره ونډه لري؟
items.a: Model answer: The imagery is visual: two vast stone legs, a shattered face half sunk in the sand, a frown and sneer, an inscription on the pedestal, and a boundless lonely desert. It evokes a picture of ruin, loneliness and emptiness. This imagery supports the ironic and reflective tone, because the broken statue in the endless desert contradicts the king's proud words.

items.a: Model answer: The inscription "My name is Ozymandias, King of Kings; Look on my Works, ye Mighty, and despair!" was meant to make other rulers despair at his greatness.
