items.q: Find the sum of all the numbers divisible by 5 from 25 through 350.
items.q2: 25 سے 350 تک 5 سے تقسیم ہونے والے تمام اعداد کا مجموعہ معلوم کریں۔
items.q3: له 25 څخه تر 350 پورې د 5 په وېش وړ ټولو عددونو مجموعه پیدا کړئ.
items.e: Use the arithmetic term and sum formulas. $a_n=a_1+(n-1)d,\quad S_n=\frac n2(a_1+a_n)=\frac n2[2a_1+(n-1)d]$ Substitute and simplify. $n=\frac{350-25}5+1=66,\quad S=\frac{66}2(25+350)=12375$

items.q: The sum of three numbers in an arithmetic sequence is 36 and the sum of their cubes is 6336. Find them. [Hint: suppose the numbers are $a-d, a, a+d$]
items.q2: حسابی ترتیب میں تین اعداد کا مجموعہ 36 اور ان کے مکعبوں کا مجموعہ 6336 ہے۔ انہیں معلوم کریں۔ [اشارہ: فرض کریں اعداد $a-d, a, a+d$ ہیں]
items.q3: په حسابي ترتیب کې د درې عددونو مجموعه 36 او د مکعبونو مجموعه یې 6336 ده. هغه پیدا کړئ. [اشاره: فرض کړئ عددونه $a-d, a, a+d$ دي]
items.a: 8,12,16, or the reverse order.
items.e: Use three equally spaced numbers centred at a. $(a-d)+a+(a+d)=36\Rightarrow a=12$ Substitute and simplify. $(a-d)^3+a^3+(a+d)^3=3a^3+6ad^2=6336\Rightarrow5184+72d^2=6336\Rightarrow d=\pm4$

items.q: Find four numbers in arithmetic sequence, whose sum is 20 and the sum of whose squares is 120. [Hint: suppose the numbers are $a-3d, a-d, a+d, a+3d$]
items.q2: حسابی ترتیب میں چار اعداد معلوم کریں جن کا مجموعہ 20 اور جن کے مربعوں کا مجموعہ 120 ہو۔ [اشارہ: فرض کریں اعداد $a-3d, a-d, a+d, a+3d$ ہیں]
items.q3: په حسابي ترتیب کې څلور عددونه پیدا کړئ چې مجموعه یې 20 او د مربعونو مجموعه یې 120 وي. [اشاره: فرض کړئ عددونه $a-3d, a-d, a+d, a+3d$ دي]
items.a: 2,4,6,8, or the reverse order.
items.e: Use the suggested symmetric terms; their common difference is 2d. $4a=20\Rightarrow a=5,\quad4a^2+20d^2=120\Rightarrow d=\pm1$

items.q2: $x_1, x_2, x_3,\ldots$ ، A.P. میں ہیں۔ اگر $x_1+x_7+x_{10}=-6$ اور $x_3+x_8+x_{12}=-11$ ہوں تو $x_3+x_8+x_{22}$ معلوم کریں۔
items.e: Use the arithmetic term and sum formulas. $a_n=a_1+(n-1)d,\quad S_n=\frac n2(a_1+a_n)=\frac n2[2a_1+(n-1)d]$ Substitute and simplify. $3a+15d=-6,\quad3a+20d=-11\Rightarrow5d=-5\Rightarrow d=-1,\ a=3$ Substitute and simplify. $x_3+x_8+x_{22}=3a+(2+7+21)d=9-30=-21$

items.q2: معلوم کریں: $1+3-5+7+9-11+13+15-17+\cdots$ ، $3n$ ارکان تک۔
items.q3: پیدا کړئ: $1+3-5+7+9-11+13+15-17+\cdots$ تر $3n$ حدونو پورې.
items.e: Group each consecutive three terms. The jth group is (6j−5)+(6j−3)−(6j−1)=6j−7. $S=\sum_{j=1}^n(6j-7)=6\frac{n(n+1)}2-7n=n(3n-4)$

items.q: Show that the sum of the first n positive odd integers is $n^2$.
items.q2: دکھائیں کہ پہلے n مثبت طاق صحیح اعداد کا مجموعہ $n^2$ ہے۔
items.q3: وښایئ چې د لومړیو n مثبتو طاق صحیح عددونو مجموعه $n^2$ ده.
items.e: Use the arithmetic term and sum formulas. $a_n=a_1+(n-1)d,\quad S_n=\frac n2(a_1+a_n)=\frac n2[2a_1+(n-1)d]$ Substitute and simplify. $1+3+\cdots+(2n-1)=\frac n2[1+(2n-1)]=n^2$

items.q: Find the sum of all multiples of 9 between 300 and 700.
items.q2: 300 اور 700 کے درمیان 9 کے تمام مضربوں کا مجموعہ معلوم کریں۔
items.q3: د 300 او 700 ترمنځ د 9 د ټولو مضربونو مجموعه پیدا کړئ.
items.e: Use the arithmetic term and sum formulas. $a_n=a_1+(n-1)d,\quad S_n=\frac n2(a_1+a_n)=\frac n2[2a_1+(n-1)d]$ Substitute and simplify. $9(34)=306,\quad9(77)=693,\quad n=77-34+1=44,\quad S=\frac{44}2(306+693)=21978$

items.q: The sum of Rs.1000 is distributed among four people so that each person after the first receives Rs. 20 less than the preceding person. How much does each person receive?
items.q2: 1000 روپے چار افراد میں اس طرح تقسیم کیے جاتے ہیں کہ پہلے کے بعد ہر شخص کو اپنے سے پہلے والے سے 20 روپے کم ملیں۔ ہر شخص کو کتنی رقم ملتی ہے؟
items.q3: 1000 روپۍ په څلورو کسانو داسې وېشل کېږي چې له لومړي وروسته هر کس له مخکیني کس څخه 20 روپۍ لږ ترلاسه کړي. هر کس څومره ترلاسه کوي؟
items.e: Use the arithmetic term and sum formulas. $a_n=a_1+(n-1)d,\quad S_n=\frac n2(a_1+a_n)=\frac n2[2a_1+(n-1)d]$ Substitute and simplify. $1000=\frac42[2a+3(-20)]\Rightarrow a=280$

items.q: The distance which an object dropped from a cliff will fall 16ft the first second, 48 ft the next second, 80 ft the third second and so on. What is the total distance the object will fall in six seconds?
items.q2: چٹان سے گرائی گئی شے پہلے سیکنڈ میں 16ft، اگلے سیکنڈ میں 48 ft، تیسرے سیکنڈ میں 80 ft وغیرہ گرتی ہے۔ چھ سیکنڈ میں شے کل کتنا فاصلہ گرے گی؟
items.q3: له یوې ډبرې غورځول شوی شی په لومړۍ ثانیه کې 16ft، په راتلونکې ثانیه کې 48 ft، په دریمه ثانیه کې 80 ft او داسې نور لوېږي. په شپږو ثانیو کې به شی ټول څومره واټن ولوېږي؟
items.a: 576 feet.
items.e: Use the arithmetic term and sum formulas. $a_n=a_1+(n-1)d,\quad S_n=\frac n2(a_1+a_n)=\frac n2[2a_1+(n-1)d]$ Substitute and simplify. $S_6=\frac62[2(16)+5(32)]=576$

items.q: Afzal Khan saves Rs.1 the first day, Rs.2 the second, Rs.3 the third and Rs. N on the nth day for thirty days. How much does he save at the end of the thirtieth day?
items.q2: افضل خان پہلے دن 1 روپیہ، دوسرے دن 2 روپے، تیسرے دن 3 روپے اور nویں دن N روپے تیس دن تک بچاتا ہے۔ تیسویں دن کے آخر تک وہ کتنی رقم بچاتا ہے؟
items.q3: افضل خان لومړۍ ورځ 1 روپۍ، دویمه ورځ 2، دریمه ورځ 3 او په nمه ورځ N روپۍ تر دېرشو ورځو سپموي. د دېرشمې ورځې په پای کې څومره سپموي؟
items.e: Use the arithmetic term and sum formulas. $a_n=a_1+(n-1)d,\quad S_n=\frac n2(a_1+a_n)=\frac n2[2a_1+(n-1)d]$ Substitute and simplify. $S_{30}=\frac{30}2(1+30)=465$

items.q: A theater has 40 rows with 20 seats in the first row, 23 in the second row, 26 in the third row and so forth. How many seats are in the theater?
items.q2: ایک تھیٹر میں 40 قطاریں ہیں جن میں پہلی قطار میں 20 نشستیں، دوسری میں 23، تیسری میں 26 وغیرہ ہیں۔ تھیٹر میں کتنی نشستیں ہیں؟
items.q3: یو تیاتر 40 قطارونه لري چې په لومړي قطار کې 20 څوکۍ، په دویم کې 23، په دریم کې 26 او داسې نور دي. په تیاتر کې څو څوکۍ دي؟
items.a: 3140 seats.
items.e: Use the arithmetic term and sum formulas. $a_n=a_1+(n-1)d,\quad S_n=\frac n2(a_1+a_n)=\frac n2[2a_1+(n-1)d]$ Substitute and simplify. $S_{40}=\frac{40}2[2(20)+39(3)]=3140$

items.q: Insert enough arithmetic means between 1 and 50 so that the sum of the resulting series will be 459.
items.q2: 1 اور 50 کے درمیان اتنے حسابی اوسط داخل کریں کہ حاصل سلسلے کا مجموعہ 459 ہو۔
items.q3: د 1 او 50 ترمنځ دومره حسابي منځني ورګډ کړئ چې د لاسته راغلې لړۍ مجموعه 459 شي.
items.e: Use the arithmetic term and sum formulas. $a_n=a_1+(n-1)d,\quad S_n=\frac n2(a_1+a_n)=\frac n2[2a_1+(n-1)d]$ Include both endpoints in the resulting series, so n terms contain n−2 inserted means. $459=\frac n2(1+50)\Rightarrow n=18,\quad m=16,\quad d=\frac{49}{17}$

items.q: Write the first five terms of a geometric sequence given that: (i) $a_1=5;\ r=3$ (ii) $a_1=8;\ r=-\frac{1}{2}$ (iii) $a_1=-\frac{9}{16};\ r=-\frac{2}{3}$ (iv) $a_1=\frac{x}{y};\ r=-\frac{y}{x}$
items.q2: ہندسی ترتیب کے پہلے پانچ ارکان لکھیں جبکہ دیا گیا ہو: (i) $a_1=5;\ r=3$ (ii) $a_1=8;\ r=-\frac{1}{2}$ (iii) $a_1=-\frac{9}{16};\ r=-\frac{2}{3}$ (iv) $a_1=\frac{x}{y};\ r=-\frac{y}{x}$
items.q3: د هندسي ترتیب لومړي پنځه حدونه ولیکئ کله چې ورکړل شوي وي: (i) $a_1=5;\ r=3$ (ii) $a_1=8;\ r=-\frac{1}{2}$ (iii) $a_1=-\frac{9}{16};\ r=-\frac{2}{3}$ (iv) $a_1=\frac{x}{y};\ r=-\frac{y}{x}$
items.e: Use the geometric term formula with its constant ratio. $a_n=a_1r^{n-1}$ Multiply by r four times after the first term. In (iv), x and y must be nonzero. $\begin{aligned}(1)\quad 5,\ 15,\ 45,\ 135,\ 405\\(2)\quad 8,\ -4,\ 2,\ -1,\ \frac{1}{2}\\(3)\quad - \frac{9}{16},\ \frac{3}{8},\ - \frac{1}{4},\ \frac{1}{6},\ - \frac{1}{9}\\(4)\quad \frac{x}{y},\ -1,\ \frac{y}{x},\ - \frac{y^{2}}{x^{2}},\ \frac{y^{3}}{x^{3}}\end{aligned}$

items.q: Suppose that the third term of a geometric sequence is 27 and the fifth term is 243. Find the first term and common ratio of the sequence.
items.q2: فرض کریں ہندسی ترتیب کا تیسرا رکن 27 اور پانچواں رکن 243 ہے۔ ترتیب کا پہلا رکن اور مشترک نسبت معلوم کریں۔
items.q3: فرض کړئ د هندسي ترتیب دریم حد 27 او پنځم حد 243 دی. د ترتیب لومړی حد او ګډ نسبت پیدا کړئ.
items.a: $a_1=3,\quad r=\pm3$
items.e: Use the geometric term formula with its constant ratio. $a_n=a_1r^{n-1}$ Substitute and simplify. $a_1r^2=27,\quad a_1r^4=243\Rightarrow r^2=9,\quad r=\pm3,\quad a_1=27/9=3$

items.q: Find the seventh term of a geometric sequence that has 2 and $-\sqrt{2}$ for its second and third terms respectively.
items.q2: اس ہندسی ترتیب کا ساتواں رکن معلوم کریں جس کے دوسرے اور تیسرے ارکان بالترتیب 2 اور $-\sqrt{2}$ ہیں۔
items.q3: د هغه هندسي ترتیب اووم حد پیدا کړئ چې دویم او دریم حد یې په ترتیب سره 2 او $-\sqrt{2}$ دي.
items.a: $-\frac{\sqrt2}4$
items.e: Use the geometric term formula with its constant ratio. $a_n=a_1r^{n-1}$ Substitute and simplify. $r=\frac{-\sqrt2}2,\quad a_7=a_2r^5=2\left(-\frac{\sqrt2}2\right)^5=-\frac{\sqrt2}4$

items.q: How many terms are there in a geometric sequence in which the first and the last terms are 16 and $\frac{1}{64}$ respectively and $r=\frac{1}{2}$?
items.q2: اس ہندسی ترتیب میں کتنے ارکان ہیں جس کا پہلا اور آخری رکن بالترتیب 16 اور $\frac{1}{64}$ اور $r=\frac{1}{2}$ ہو؟
items.q3: په هغه هندسي ترتیب کې څو حدونه دي چې لومړی او وروستی حد یې په ترتیب سره 16 او $\frac{1}{64}$ او $r=\frac{1}{2}$ وي؟
items.e: Use the geometric term formula with its constant ratio. $a_n=a_1r^{n-1}$ Substitute and simplify. $\frac1{64}=16\left(\frac12\right)^{n-1}\Rightarrow2^{-6}=2^{5-n}\Rightarrow n=11$

items.q: Find $x$ so that $x+7, x-3, x-8$ form a three term geometric sequence in the given order. Also give the sequence.
items.q2: $x$ معلوم کریں تاکہ $x+7, x-3, x-8$ دی گئی ترتیب میں تین ارکان کی ہندسی ترتیب بنائیں۔ ترتیب بھی لکھیں۔
items.q3: $x$ پیدا کړئ چې $x+7, x-3, x-8$ په ورکړل شوي ترتیب کې د درې حدونو هندسي ترتیب جوړ کړي. ترتیب هم ولیکئ.
items.e: Substitute and simplify. $(x-3)^2=(x+7)(x-8)\Rightarrow x^2-6x+9=x^2-x-56\Rightarrow x=13,\quad r=\frac12$

items.q2: اگر $a_{10}=l,\ a_{13}=m,\ a_{16}=n$ ہوں تو دکھائیں کہ $ln=m^2$
items.q3: که $a_{10}=l,\ a_{13}=m,\ a_{16}=n$ وي، وښایئ چې $ln=m^2$
items.e: Use the geometric term formula with its constant ratio. $a_n=a_1r^{n-1}$ Substitute and simplify. $l=a_1r^9,\quad m=a_1r^{12},\quad n=a_1r^{15}\Rightarrow ln=a_1^2r^{24}=m^2$

items.q: Show that the reciprocals of the terms of a geometric sequence also form a geometric sequence.
items.q2: دکھائیں کہ ہندسی ترتیب کے ارکان کے معکوس بھی ہندسی ترتیب بناتے ہیں۔
items.q3: وښایئ چې د هندسي ترتیب د حدونو معکوسونه هم هندسي ترتیب جوړوي.
items.a: Common ratio $1/r$.
items.e: Nonzero terms have reciprocals; the ratio of consecutive reciprocals is constant. $\frac{1/a_{n+1}}{1/a_n}=\frac{a_n}{a_{n+1}}=\frac1r$

items.q: Find the geometric mean of the following: (i) 3.14 and 2.71 (ii) $-6$ and $-216$ (iii) $x+y$ and $x-y$ (iv) $\sqrt{2}+3$ and $\sqrt{2}-3$
items.q2: درج ذیل کا ہندسی اوسط معلوم کریں: (i) 3.14 اور 2.71 (ii) $-6$ اور $-216$ (iii) $x+y$ اور $x-y$ (iv) $\sqrt{2}+3$ اور $\sqrt{2}-3$
items.q3: د لاندې هندسي منځنی پیدا کړئ: (i) 3.14 او 2.71 (ii) $-6$ او $-216$ (iii) $x+y$ او $x-y$ (iv) $\sqrt{2}+3$ او $\sqrt{2}-3$
items.a: $(i)\ \pm\sqrt{8.5094};\ (ii)\ \pm36;\ (iii)\ \pm\sqrt{x^2-y^2};\ (iv)\ \pm i\sqrt7$.
items.e: An inserted geometric middle term satisfies G²=ab, so retain both algebraic signs. For positive numbers, the conventional geometric mean is the positive root. $G^2=ab$ Substitute and simplify. $3.14(2.71)=8.5094,\quad(-6)(-216)=1296,\quad(x+y)(x-y)=x^2-y^2,\quad(\sqrt2+3)(\sqrt2-3)=-7$ In (iii) a real middle term requires x²≥y²; nonzero endpoints are required for a nonzero-ratio G.P. In (iv) there is no real geometric mean; the displayed roots are complex.

items.q: (i) Insert 5 geometric means between $3\frac{5}{9}$ and $40\frac{1}{2}$. (ii) Insert 6 geometric means between 14 and $-\frac{7}{64}$.
items.q2: (i) $3\frac{5}{9}$ اور $40\frac{1}{2}$ کے درمیان 5 ہندسی اوسط داخل کریں۔ (ii) 14 اور $-\frac{7}{64}$ کے درمیان 6 ہندسی اوسط داخل کریں۔
items.q3: (i) د $3\frac{5}{9}$ او $40\frac{1}{2}$ ترمنځ 5 هندسي منځني ورګډ کړئ. (ii) د 14 او $-\frac{7}{64}$ ترمنځ 6 هندسي منځني ورګډ کړئ.
items.e: Use the geometric term formula with its constant ratio. $a_n=a_1r^{n-1}$ For m inserted means use b=arᵐ⁺¹ and include all real ratios. $(i)\ r^6=\frac{81/2}{32/9}=\frac{729}{64}\Rightarrow r=\pm\frac32;\qquad(ii)\ r^7=\frac{-7/64}{14}=-\frac1{128}\Rightarrow r=-\frac12$

items.q: Find two numbers if the difference between them is 48 and their A.M. exceeds their G.M. by 18.
items.q2: دو اعداد معلوم کریں اگر ان کا فرق 48 ہو اور ان کا حسابی اوسط ہندسی اوسط سے 18 زیادہ ہو۔
items.q3: دوه عددونه پیدا کړئ که توپیر یې 48 وي او حسابي منځنی یې له هندسي منځني څخه 18 زیات وي.
items.e: For positive numbers write them as A+24 and A−24, where A is their arithmetic mean. Take the conventional nonnegative geometric mean G. $G=A-18,\quad G^2=A^2-24^2\Rightarrow(A-18)^2=A^2-576\Rightarrow A=25,\ G=7$

items.q: Prove that the product of n geometric means between $a$ and $b$ is equal to the nth power of the single geometric mean between them.
items.q2: ثابت کریں کہ $a$ اور $b$ کے درمیان n ہندسی اوسطوں کا حاصلِ ضرب ان کے درمیان ایک ہندسی اوسط کی nویں قوت کے برابر ہے۔
items.q3: ثابت کړئ چې د $a$ او $b$ ترمنځ د n هندسي منځنیو حاصل ضرب د هغوی ترمنځ د یو هندسي منځني له nم توان سره برابر دی.
items.a: $\prod_{j=1}^nG_j=(\sqrt{ab})^n$ for positive means.
items.e: Assume positive endpoints and positive inserted means, so r>0. Multiply the terms and use b=arⁿ⁺¹. $\prod_{j=1}^n ar^j=a^nr^{n(n+1)/2}=(a^2r^{n+1})^{n/2}=(ab)^{n/2}=(\sqrt{ab})^n$ If negative-ratio branches are allowed, the sign of the single geometric mean must be chosen consistently. The claim with a fixed positive square root is not universal: between 1 and 4, the inserted mean −2 has product −2, not 2.

items.q: For what value of $n$, $\dfrac{a^{n+1}+b^{n+1}}{a^n+b^n}$ is the geometric mean between $a$ and $b$?
items.q2: $n$ کی کس قیمت کے لیے $\dfrac{a^{n+1}+b^{n+1}}{a^n+b^n}$ ، $a$ اور $b$ کے درمیان ہندسی اوسط ہے؟
items.q3: د $n$ په کوم قیمت $\dfrac{a^{n+1}+b^{n+1}}{a^n+b^n}$ د $a$ او $b$ ترمنځ هندسي منځنی دی؟
items.a: $n=-\frac12$ for distinct positive $a,b$.
items.e: For a,b>0 set a=x² and b=y² with x,y>0. Multiply by the denominator and factor. $x^{2n+2}+y^{2n+2}=xy(x^{2n}+y^{2n})\iff(x-y)(x^{2n+1}-y^{2n+1})=0$ Distinct positive x,y imply 2n+1=0. If a=b, every defined exponent works. $\frac{a^{1/2}+b^{1/2}}{a^{-1/2}+b^{-1/2}}=\sqrt{ab}$

items.q: Compute the sum: (i) $3+6+12+\cdots+3\cdot2^9$ (ii) $8+4+2+1+\cdots+\frac{1}{16}$ (iii) $2^4+2^5+2^6+\cdots+2^{10}$ (iv) $\frac{8}{5}, -1, \frac{5}{8},\ldots$ (v) $2, \frac{2}{\sqrt{2}}, 1, \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}, \frac{1}{2},\ldots$ (vi) $\frac{1}{3}, -\frac{1}{2}, \frac{3}{4},\ldots$ to 7 terms.
items.q2: مجموعہ معلوم کریں: (i) $3+6+12+\cdots+3\cdot2^9$ (ii) $8+4+2+1+\cdots+\frac{1}{16}$ (iii) $2^4+2^5+2^6+\cdots+2^{10}$ (iv) $\frac{8}{5}, -1, \frac{5}{8},\ldots$ (v) $2, \frac{2}{\sqrt{2}}, 1, \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}, \frac{1}{2},\ldots$ (vi) $\frac{1}{3}, -\frac{1}{2}, \frac{3}{4},\ldots$ 7 ارکان تک۔
items.q3: مجموعه محاسبه کړئ: (i) $3+6+12+\cdots+3\cdot2^9$ (ii) $8+4+2+1+\cdots+\frac{1}{16}$ (iii) $2^4+2^5+2^6+\cdots+2^{10}$ (iv) $\frac{8}{5}, -1, \frac{5}{8},\ldots$ (v) $2, \frac{2}{\sqrt{2}}, 1, \frac{1}{\sqrt{2}}, \frac{1}{2},\ldots$ (vi) $\frac{1}{3}, -\frac{1}{2}, \frac{3}{4},\ldots$ تر 7 حدونو.
items.e: Use the geometric term and sum formulas. $a_n=a_1r^{n-1},\quad S_n=\frac{a_1(1-r^n)}{1-r}\ (r\ne1),\quad S_\infty=\frac{a_1}{1-r}\ (|r|<1)$ Substitute and simplify. $\text{(i) }a=3,r=2,n=10:\ S=3(2^{10}-1)=3069$ Substitute and simplify. $\text{(ii) }r=\frac12,\ \frac1{16}=8\left(\frac12\right)^{n-1}\Rightarrow n=8:\ S=\frac{8(1-2^{-8})}{1/2}=\frac{255}{16}$ Substitute and simplify. $\text{(iii) }a=2^4,r=2,n=7:\ S=16(2^7-1)=2032$ In (iv) and (v) the list continues without end and |r|<1, so the infinite sum is used. $\text{(iv) }r=-\frac58:\ \frac{8/5}{1+5/8}=\frac{64}{65};\quad\text{(v) }r=\frac1{\sqrt2}:\ \frac{2}{1-1/\sqrt2}=4+2\sqrt2$ Substitute and simplify. $\text{(vi) }a=\frac13,r=-\frac32,n=7:\ S_7=\frac13\cdot\frac{1-(-3/2)^7}{1+3/2}=\frac{463}{192}$

items.q: Some of the components $a_1, a_n, n, r$ and $S_n$ of a geometric sequence are given. Find the ones that are missing. (i) $a_1=1, r=-2, a_n=64$ (ii) $r=\frac{1}{2}, a_9=1$ (iii) $r=-2, S_n=-63, a_n=-96$
items.q2: ہندسی ترتیب کے کچھ اجزاء $a_1, a_n, n, r$ اور $S_n$ دیے گئے ہیں۔ باقی معلوم کریں۔ (i) $a_1=1, r=-2, a_n=64$ (ii) $r=\frac{1}{2}, a_9=1$ (iii) $r=-2, S_n=-63, a_n=-96$
items.q3: د هندسي ترتیب ځینې اجزا $a_1, a_n, n, r$ او $S_n$ ورکړل شوي. پاتې شوي پیدا کړئ. (i) $a_1=1, r=-2, a_n=64$ (ii) $r=\frac{1}{2}, a_9=1$ (iii) $r=-2, S_n=-63, a_n=-96$
items.e: Use the geometric term and sum formulas. $a_n=a_1r^{n-1},\quad S_n=\frac{a_1(1-r^n)}{1-r}\ (r\ne1),\quad S_\infty=\frac{a_1}{1-r}\ (|r|<1)$ Substitute and simplify. $\text{(i) }(-2)^{n-1}=64=(-2)^6\Rightarrow n=7,\ S_7=\frac{1-(-2)^7}{1+2}=43$ Substitute and simplify. $\text{(ii) }a_9=a_1\left(\frac12\right)^8=1\Rightarrow a_1=256,\ S_9=\frac{256(1-2^{-9})}{1/2}=511$ Substitute and simplify. $\text{(iii) }S_n=\frac{a_1-ra_n}{1-r}=\frac{a_1-192}{3}=-63\Rightarrow a_1=3;\ 3(-2)^{n-1}=-96\Rightarrow(-2)^{n-1}=-32\Rightarrow n=6$

items.q: Find the first five terms and the sum of an infinite geometric sequence having $a_2=2$ and $a_3=1$
items.q2: اس لامتناہی ہندسی ترتیب کے پہلے پانچ ارکان اور مجموعہ معلوم کریں جس میں $a_2=2$ اور $a_3=1$
items.q3: د هغه نامحدود هندسي ترتیب لومړي پنځه حدونه او مجموعه پیدا کړئ چې $a_2=2$ او $a_3=1$ لري
items.a: $4,2,1,\frac12,\frac14;\quad S_\infty=8$
items.e: Use the geometric term and sum formulas. $a_n=a_1r^{n-1},\quad S_n=\frac{a_1(1-r^n)}{1-r}\ (r\ne1),\quad S_\infty=\frac{a_1}{1-r}\ (|r|<1)$ Substitute and simplify. $r=\frac{a_3}{a_2}=\frac12,\ a_1=\frac{a_2}r=4,\quad S_\infty=\frac{4}{1-1/2}=8$

items.q: Find the value of: (i) $0.\overline{8}$ (ii) $1.\overline{63}$ (iii) $2.1\overline{5}$ (iv) $0.\overline{123}$
items.q2: قیمت معلوم کریں: (i) $0.\overline{8}$ (ii) $1.\overline{63}$ (iii) $2.1\overline{5}$ (iv) $0.\overline{123}$
items.q3: قیمت پیدا کړئ: (i) $0.\overline{8}$ (ii) $1.\overline{63}$ (iii) $2.1\overline{5}$ (iv) $0.\overline{123}$
items.a: $\text{(i) }\frac89;\ \text{(ii) }\frac{18}{11};\ \text{(iii) }\frac{97}{45};\ \text{(iv) }\frac{41}{333}$
items.e: Write the repeating part as an infinite geometric series and use S=a/(1−r). Substitute and simplify. $\text{(i) }\frac{0.8}{1-0.1}=\frac89;\quad\text{(ii) }1+\frac{0.63}{1-0.01}=1+\frac7{11}=\frac{18}{11}$ Substitute and simplify. $\text{(iii) }2.1+\frac{0.05}{1-0.1}=\frac{21}{10}+\frac1{18}=\frac{97}{45};\quad\text{(iv) }\frac{0.123}{1-0.001}=\frac{123}{999}=\frac{41}{333}$

items.q: Find r such that: $S_{10}=244S_5$.
items.q2: r معلوم کریں تاکہ: $S_{10}=244S_5$ ۔
items.q3: r داسې پیدا کړئ چې: $S_{10}=244S_5$.
items.e: Use the geometric term and sum formulas. $a_n=a_1r^{n-1},\quad S_n=\frac{a_1(1-r^n)}{1-r}\ (r\ne1),\quad S_\infty=\frac{a_1}{1-r}\ (|r|<1)$ Substitute and simplify. $S_{10}=S_5(1+r^5)\Rightarrow1+r^5=244\Rightarrow r^5=243\Rightarrow r=3$

items.q: Prove that: $S_n(S_{3n}-S_{2n})=(S_n-S_{2n})^2$
items.q2: ثابت کریں کہ: $S_n(S_{3n}-S_{2n})=(S_n-S_{2n})^2$
items.q3: ثابت کړئ چې: $S_n(S_{3n}-S_{2n})=(S_n-S_{2n})^2$
items.a: Proved.
items.e: Let k=a/(1−r) and x=rⁿ (r≠1). Then Sₙ=k(1−x), S₂ₙ=k(1−x²), S₃ₙ=k(1−x³). Substitute and simplify. $S_n(S_{3n}-S_{2n})=k(1-x)\cdot kx^2(1-x)=k^2x^2(1-x)^2$ Substitute and simplify. $(S_n-S_{2n})^2=[k(x^2-x)]^2=k^2x^2(1-x)^2\quad\text{so both sides are equal.}$

items.q: Find the sum $S_n$ of the first n terms of the sequence $\left\{\left(\frac{1}{2}\right)^n\right\}$.
items.q2: ترتیب $\left\{\left(\frac{1}{2}\right)^n\right\}$ کے پہلے n ارکان کا مجموعہ $S_n$ معلوم کریں۔
items.q3: د ترتیب $\left\{\left(\frac{1}{2}\right)^n\right\}$ د لومړیو n حدونو مجموعه $S_n$ پیدا کړئ.
items.a: $S_n=1-\left(\frac12\right)^n$
items.e: Use the geometric term and sum formulas. $a_n=a_1r^{n-1},\quad S_n=\frac{a_1(1-r^n)}{1-r}\ (r\ne1),\quad S_\infty=\frac{a_1}{1-r}\ (|r|<1)$ Substitute and simplify. $a_1=\frac12,\ r=\frac12:\ S_n=\frac{\frac12(1-2^{-n})}{1/2}=1-2^{-n}$

items.q: The sum of three numbers in G.P. is 38, and their product is 1728; find them.
items.q2: ہندسی تصاعد میں تین اعداد کا مجموعہ 38 اور حاصلِ ضرب 1728 ہے؛ اعداد معلوم کریں۔
items.q3: په هندسي تصاعد کې د دریو عددونو مجموعه 38 او حاصل ضرب یې 1728 دی؛ هغه پیدا کړئ.
items.e: Take the three numbers as a/r, a, ar. Substitute and simplify. $a^3=1728\Rightarrow a=12;\quad12\left(\frac1r+1+r\right)=38\Rightarrow6r^2-13r+6=0\Rightarrow r=\frac32\text{ or }\frac23$

items.q: The sum of first 6 terms of a geometric series is 9 times the sum of its first three terms. Find the common ratio.
items.q2: ہندسی سلسلے کے پہلے 6 ارکان کا مجموعہ اس کے پہلے تین ارکان کے مجموعے کا 9 گنا ہے۔ مشترک نسبت معلوم کریں۔
items.q3: د یوې هندسي لړۍ د لومړیو 6 حدونو مجموعه د لومړیو دریو حدونو د مجموعې 9 چنده ده. ګډ نسبت پیدا کړئ.
items.e: Use the geometric term and sum formulas. $a_n=a_1r^{n-1},\quad S_n=\frac{a_1(1-r^n)}{1-r}\ (r\ne1),\quad S_\infty=\frac{a_1}{1-r}\ (|r|<1)$ Substitute and simplify. $S_6=S_3(1+r^3)=9S_3\Rightarrow r^3=8\Rightarrow r=2$

items.q: How many terms of the series: $1+\sqrt{3}+3+\cdots$ be added to get the sum $40+13\sqrt{3}$.
items.q2: سلسلے $1+\sqrt{3}+3+\cdots$ کے کتنے ارکان جمع کیے جائیں کہ مجموعہ $40+13\sqrt{3}$ ہو۔
items.q3: د لړۍ $1+\sqrt{3}+3+\cdots$ څو حدونه جمع شي چې مجموعه $40+13\sqrt{3}$ شي.
items.e: Use the geometric term and sum formulas. $a_n=a_1r^{n-1},\quad S_n=\frac{a_1(1-r^n)}{1-r}\ (r\ne1),\quad S_\infty=\frac{a_1}{1-r}\ (|r|<1)$ Substitute and simplify. $r=\sqrt3:\ \frac{(\sqrt3)^n-1}{\sqrt3-1}=40+13\sqrt3\Rightarrow(\sqrt3)^n=(40+13\sqrt3)(\sqrt3-1)+1=27\sqrt3=(\sqrt3)^7\Rightarrow n=7$

items.q: If $p^{th}, q^{th}, r^{th}$ terms of a G.P. be $a, b, c$ respectively, prove that $a^{q-r}b^{r-p}c^{p-q}=1$.
items.q2: اگر ہندسی تصاعد کے $p^{th}, q^{th}, r^{th}$ ارکان بالترتیب $a, b, c$ ہوں تو ثابت کریں کہ $a^{q-r}b^{r-p}c^{p-q}=1$ ۔
items.q3: که د هندسي تصاعد $p^{th}, q^{th}, r^{th}$ حدونه په ترتیب سره $a, b, c$ وي، ثابت کړئ چې $a^{q-r}b^{r-p}c^{p-q}=1$.
items.a: Proved.
items.e: Let the G.P. have first term A and common ratio R, so a=AR^{p-1}, b=AR^{q-1}, c=AR^{r-1}. Substitute and simplify. $a^{q-r}b^{r-p}c^{p-q}=A^{(q-r)+(r-p)+(p-q)}R^{(p-1)(q-r)+(q-1)(r-p)+(r-1)(p-q)}=A^0R^0=1$

items.q: Find an infinite geometric series whose sum is 6 and such that each term is four times the sum of all the terms that follow it.
items.q2: ایسا لامتناہی ہندسی سلسلہ معلوم کریں جس کا مجموعہ 6 ہو اور ہر رکن اپنے بعد آنے والے تمام ارکان کے مجموعے کا چار گنا ہو۔
items.q3: داسې نامحدوده هندسي لړۍ پیدا کړئ چې مجموعه یې 6 وي او هر حد یې د ورپسې ټولو حدونو د مجموعې څلور چنده وي.
items.e: Use the geometric term and sum formulas. $a_n=a_1r^{n-1},\quad S_n=\frac{a_1(1-r^n)}{1-r}\ (r\ne1),\quad S_\infty=\frac{a_1}{1-r}\ (|r|<1)$ Substitute and simplify. $a_1=4\cdot\frac{a_1r}{1-r}\Rightarrow1-r=4r\Rightarrow r=\frac15;\quad\frac{a_1}{1-1/5}=6\Rightarrow a_1=\frac{24}5$

items.q: If $y=\dfrac{x}{3}+\dfrac{x^2}{3^2}+\dfrac{x^3}{3^3}+\cdots$, where $0<x<3$, then show that $x=\dfrac{3y}{1+y}$
items.q2: اگر $y=\dfrac{x}{3}+\dfrac{x^2}{3^2}+\dfrac{x^3}{3^3}+\cdots$ جہاں $0<x<3$ ، تو دکھائیں کہ $x=\dfrac{3y}{1+y}$
items.q3: که $y=\dfrac{x}{3}+\dfrac{x^2}{3^2}+\dfrac{x^3}{3^3}+\cdots$ چېرې چې $0<x<3$، نو وښایئ چې $x=\dfrac{3y}{1+y}$
items.a: Proved.
items.e: The series is geometric with first term x/3 and ratio x/3, and |x/3|<1 because 0<x<3. Substitute and simplify. $y=\frac{x/3}{1-x/3}=\frac x{3-x}\Rightarrow3y-xy=x\Rightarrow x=\frac{3y}{1+y}$

items.q: A ball rebounds to half the height from which it is dropped. If it is dropped from 10 ft, how far does it travel from the moment it is dropped until the moment of its eighth bounce?
items.q2: ایک گیند جس بلندی سے گرائی جائے اس کی آدھی بلندی تک اچھلتی ہے۔ اگر اسے 10 ft سے گرایا جائے تو گرنے کے لمحے سے آٹھویں اچھال کے لمحے تک یہ کتنا فاصلہ طے کرتی ہے؟
items.q3: یو توپ له کوم لوړوالي چې غورځول شي د هغه نیمایي ته پورته ټوپ وهي. که له 10 ft څخه وغورځول شي، د غورځېدو له شېبې تر اتم ټوپ پورې څومره واټن وهي؟
items.e: Interpretation: the distance is measured until the ball strikes the ground for the eighth time. It falls 10 ft, then rises and falls 5, 5/2, … for seven rebounds. Substitute and simplify. $10+2\left(5+\frac52+\cdots+\frac{10}{2^7}\right)=10+2\cdot\frac{5\left(1-2^{-7}\right)}{1/2}=10+\frac{635}{32}=\frac{955}{32}$

items.q: A man wishes to save money by setting aside Rs.1 the first day, Rs.2 the second day, Rs.4 the third day and so on, doubling the amount each day. If this continued, how much must be set aside on the $15^{th}$ day? What is the total amount saved at the end of 30 days?
items.q2: ایک آدمی پیسے بچانا چاہتا ہے، پہلے دن Rs.1، دوسرے دن Rs.2، تیسرے دن Rs.4 اور اسی طرح ہر دن رقم دگنی کر کے۔ اگر یہ جاری رہے تو $15^{th}$ دن کتنی رقم الگ رکھنی ہوگی؟ 30 دن کے آخر میں کل کتنی رقم بچائی گئی؟
items.q3: یو سړی غواړي پیسې وسپموي، لومړۍ ورځ Rs.1، دویمه ورځ Rs.2، دریمه ورځ Rs.4 او همداسې هره ورځ اندازه دوه چنده کوي. که دا دوام ومومي، په $15^{th}$ ورځ باید څومره جلا کړي؟ د 30 ورځو په پای کې ټوله سپمول شوې اندازه څومره ده؟
items.a: $\text{Rs. }16384;\ \text{total }\text{Rs. }1073741823$
items.e: Use the geometric term and sum formulas. $a_n=a_1r^{n-1},\quad S_n=\frac{a_1(1-r^n)}{1-r}\ (r\ne1),\quad S_\infty=\frac{a_1}{1-r}\ (|r|<1)$ Substitute and simplify. $a_{15}=2^{14}=16384;\quad S_{30}=\frac{1(2^{30}-1)}{2-1}=1073741823$

items.q: The number of bacteria in a culture increased geometrically from 64000 to 729000 in 6 days. Find the daily rate of increase if the rate is assumed to be constant.
items.q2: ایک کلچر میں بیکٹیریا کی تعداد 6 دنوں میں 64000 سے 729000 تک ہندسی طور پر بڑھی۔ اگر شرح مستقل فرض کی جائے تو روزانہ اضافے کی شرح معلوم کریں۔
items.q3: په یوه کلچر کې د باکتریاوو شمېر په 6 ورځو کې له 64000 څخه 729000 ته په هندسي ډول زیات شو. که کچه ثابته وګڼل شي، د ورځني زیاتوالي کچه پیدا کړئ.
items.a: $50\%$ per day
items.e: Use the geometric term and sum formulas. $a_n=a_1r^{n-1},\quad S_n=\frac{a_1(1-r^n)}{1-r}\ (r\ne1),\quad S_\infty=\frac{a_1}{1-r}\ (|r|<1)$ Substitute and simplify. $64000r^6=729000\Rightarrow r^6=\frac{729}{64}=\left(\frac32\right)^6\Rightarrow r=\frac32,\ \text{increase}=\frac12=50\%$

items.q: Find the indicated term of each of the following harmonic progressions: (i) $\frac{1}{2}, \frac{1}{5}, \frac{1}{8},\ldots$; $9^{th}$ term (ii) $6, 2, \frac{6}{5},\ldots$; $20^{th}$ term (iii) $5\frac{2}{3}, 3\frac{2}{5}, 2\frac{3}{7},\ldots$; $8^{th}$ term
items.q2: درج ذیل ہر ہارمونک تصاعد کا مطلوبہ رکن معلوم کریں: (i) $\frac{1}{2}, \frac{1}{5}, \frac{1}{8},\ldots$ ؛ $9^{th}$ رکن (ii) $6, 2, \frac{6}{5},\ldots$ ؛ $20^{th}$ رکن (iii) $5\frac{2}{3}, 3\frac{2}{5}, 2\frac{3}{7},\ldots$ ؛ $8^{th}$ رکن
items.q3: د لاندې هر هارمونیک تصاعد ښودل شوی حد پیدا کړئ: (i) $\frac{1}{2}, \frac{1}{5}, \frac{1}{8},\ldots$؛ $9^{th}$ حد (ii) $6, 2, \frac{6}{5},\ldots$؛ $20^{th}$ حد (iii) $5\frac{2}{3}, 3\frac{2}{5}, 2\frac{3}{7},\ldots$؛ $8^{th}$ حد
items.a: $\text{(i) }\frac1{26};\ \text{(ii) }\frac2{13};\ \text{(iii) }1$

items.e: Part (i) Write every fraction with the common denominator $8!$. $\frac1{6!}=\frac{8\cdot7}{8!},\quad\frac2{7!}=\frac{2\cdot8}{8!},\quad\frac3{8!}$ Add the numerators. $\frac{56+16+3}{8!}=\frac{75}{8!}$ Hence proved. Part (ii) Expand the factorials and cancel common factors. $\frac{(n+5)!}{(n+3)!}=\frac{(n+5)(n+4)(n+3)!}{(n+3)!}=(n+5)(n+4)$ Multiply out. $(n+5)(n+4)=n^2+9n+20$ Hence proved.

items.e: Part (i) Separate the even and odd factors of $(2n)!$. $(2n)!=[2\cdot4\cdot6\cdots2n]\,[1\cdot3\cdot5\cdots(2n-1)]$ Take a factor 2 out of each even number. $2\cdot4\cdots2n=2^n(1\cdot2\cdots n)=2^n\,n!$ Divide by $n!$. $\frac{(2n)!}{n!}=2^n\,(1\cdot3\cdot5\cdots(2n-1))$ Hence proved. Part (ii) Use part (i) and $(2n+1)!=(2n+1)\,(2n)!$. $\frac{(2n+1)!}{n!}=(2n+1)\frac{(2n)!}{n!}=2^n(1\cdot3\cdots(2n-1))(2n+1)$ Hence proved.

items.q: Solve the following for n. (i) ${}^nC_2=36$ (ii) ${}^{n+1}C_4=6\cdot{}^{n-1}C_2$ (iii) ${}^{n^2}C_2=30\cdot{}^nC_3$
items.q2: درج ذیل کو n کے لیے حل کریں۔ (i) ${}^nC_2=36$ (ii) ${}^{n+1}C_4=6\cdot{}^{n-1}C_2$ (iii) ${}^{n^2}C_2=30\cdot{}^nC_3$
items.q3: لاندې د n لپاره حل کړئ. (i) ${}^nC_2=36$ (ii) ${}^{n+1}C_4=6\cdot{}^{n-1}C_2$ (iii) ${}^{n^2}C_2=30\cdot{}^nC_3$
items.e: Part (i) Use ${}^nC_r=\dfrac{n!}{r!\,(n-r)!}$. $\frac{n(n-1)}2=36\Rightarrow n^2-n-72=0$ Solve the resulting equation and keep only the admissible (positive integer) value. $(n-9)(n+8)=0\Rightarrow n=9$ Part (ii) Use ${}^nC_r=\dfrac{n!}{r!\,(n-r)!}$. $\frac{(n+1)n(n-1)(n-2)}{24}=6\cdot\frac{(n-1)(n-2)}2$ Solve the resulting equation and keep only the admissible (positive integer) value. $\frac{(n+1)n}{24}=3\Rightarrow n^2+n-72=0\Rightarrow(n+9)(n-8)=0\Rightarrow n=8$ Part (iii) Use ${}^nC_r=\dfrac{n!}{r!\,(n-r)!}$. $\frac{n^2(n^2-1)}2=30\cdot\frac{n(n-1)(n-2)}6$ Cancel $n(n-1)$ (non-zero). $\frac{n(n+1)}2=5(n-2)$ Solve the resulting equation and keep only the admissible (positive integer) value. $n^2-9n+20=0\Rightarrow(n-4)(n-5)=0\Rightarrow n=4,5$

items.q: Prove that (i) ${}^{n-1}C_r+{}^{n-1}C_{r-1}={}^nC_r$ (ii) $r\cdot{}^nC_r=n\cdot{}^{n-1}C_{r-1}$
items.q2: ثابت کریں کہ (i) ${}^{n-1}C_r+{}^{n-1}C_{r-1}={}^nC_r$ (ii) $r\cdot{}^nC_r=n\cdot{}^{n-1}C_{r-1}$
items.q3: ثابت کړئ چې (i) ${}^{n-1}C_r+{}^{n-1}C_{r-1}={}^nC_r$ (ii) $r\cdot{}^nC_r=n\cdot{}^{n-1}C_{r-1}$
items.a: (i) Proved (see the steps).; (ii) Proved (see the steps).
items.e: Part (i) Use ${}^nC_r=\dfrac{n!}{r!\,(n-r)!}$. ${}^{n-1}C_r+{}^{n-1}C_{r-1}=\frac{(n-1)!}{r!\,(n-1-r)!}+\frac{(n-1)!}{(r-1)!\,(n-r)!}$ Take the common denominator $r!\,(n-r)!$. $=\frac{(n-1)!\,[(n-r)+r]}{r!\,(n-r)!}=\frac{n!}{r!\,(n-r)!}={}^nC_r$ Hence proved. Part (ii) Use ${}^nC_r=\dfrac{n!}{r!\,(n-r)!}$. $r\cdot{}^nC_r=r\cdot\frac{n!}{r!\,(n-r)!}=\frac{n\,(n-1)!}{(r-1)!\,(n-r)!}$ Recognise ${}^{n-1}C_{r-1}$. $=n\cdot\frac{(n-1)!}{(r-1)!\,((n-1)-(r-1))!}=n\cdot{}^{n-1}C_{r-1}$ Hence proved.

Hence the statement is true for $n=k+1$. By mathematical induction it holds for every positive integer $n$. Part (ii) Check the statement for $n=1$. $n=1:\ \frac{10^2-9-10}{81}=\frac{81}{81}=1$ Assume the statement is true for $n=k$. $10^{k+1}-9k-10=81m\ \text{ for some integer }m$ Add the next term (or work with $n=k+1$) and simplify to the required form. $10^{k+2}-9(k+1)-10=10\left(10^{k+1}-9k-10\right)+81k+81=810m+81(k+1)=81(10m+k+1)$ Hence the statement is true for $n=k+1$. By mathematical induction it holds for every positive integer $n$.

items.q2: (i) دکھائیں کہ $5$، $3^{2n-1}+2^{2n-1}$ کا جز ضربی ہے جہاں $n$ کوئی بھی مثبت صحیح عدد ہے۔ (ii) ثابت کریں کہ تمام مثبت صحیح اعداد کے لیے $2^{2n}-1$، $3$ کا ضعف ہے۔
items.q3: (i) وښایاست چې $5$ د $3^{2n-1}+2^{2n-1}$ فکتور دی چېرته چې $n$ هر مثبت صحیح عدد دی. (ii) ثابته کړئ چې د ټولو مثبتو صحیحو عددونو لپاره $2^{2n}-1$ د $3$ مضرب دی.
items.a: (i) Proved: 5 is a factor of $3^{2n-1}+2^{2n-1}$.; (ii) Proved: $2^{2n}-1$ is a multiple of 3.
items.e: Part (i) Check the statement for $n=1$. $n=1:\ 3^1+2^1=5$ Assume the statement is true for $n=k$. $3^{2k-1}+2^{2k-1}=5m$ Add the next term (or work with $n=k+1$) and simplify to the required form. $3^{2k+1}+2^{2k+1}=9\cdot3^{2k-1}+4\cdot2^{2k-1}=4\left(3^{2k-1}+2^{2k-1}\right)+5\cdot3^{2k-1}=5\left(4m+3^{2k-1}\right)$ Hence the statement is true for $n=k+1$. By mathematical induction it holds for every positive integer $n$. Part (ii) Check the statement for $n=1$. $n=1:\ 2^2-1=3$ Assume the statement is true for $n=k$. $2^{2k}-1=3m$ Add the next term (or work with $n=k+1$) and simplify to the required form. $2^{2(k+1)}-1=4\cdot2^{2k}-1=4\left(2^{2k}-1\right)+3=12m+3=3(4m+1)$ Hence the statement is true for $n=k+1$. By mathematical induction it holds for every positive integer $n$.

items.q: Show that $a+b$ is a factor of $a^n-b^n$ for all even positive integer $n$.
items.q2: دکھائیں کہ تمام جفت مثبت صحیح اعداد $n$ کے لیے $a+b$، $a^n-b^n$ کا جز ضربی ہے۔
items.q3: وښایاست چې د ټولو جفتو مثبتو صحیحو عددونو $n$ لپاره $a+b$ د $a^n-b^n$ فکتور دی.
items.a: Proved.
items.e: Let $n=2m$ and induct on $m$. For $m=1$: $a^2-b^2=(a+b)(a-b)$, divisible by $a+b$. Assume $a+b$ divides $a^{2m}-b^{2m}$. Rewrite the next even power. $a^{2m+2}-b^{2m+2}=a^2\left(a^{2m}-b^{2m}\right)+b^{2m}\left(a^2-b^2\right)$ Both parts are divisible by $a+b$, so is their sum; by induction the result holds for every even $n$.

items.q: Expand by using Binomial theorem. (i) $\left(x^2-\dfrac1y\right)^4$ (ii) $(1+xy)^7$ (iii) $\left(\sqrt y+\dfrac1{\sqrt y}\right)^5$
items.q2: دو رقمی قضیے کی مدد سے پھیلائیں۔ (i) $\left(x^2-\dfrac1y\right)^4$ (ii) $(1+xy)^7$ (iii) $\left(\sqrt y+\dfrac1{\sqrt y}\right)^5$
items.q3: د دوه حدي قضیې په کارولو سره پراخ کړئ. (i) $\left(x^2-\dfrac1y\right)^4$ (ii) $(1+xy)^7$ (iii) $\left(\sqrt y+\dfrac1{\sqrt y}\right)^5$
items.e: Part (i) Use the binomial theorem $(p+q)^n=\sum_{r=0}^{n}\binom nr p^{n-r}q^r$. Substitute and simplify. $(x^2-1/y)^4=x^8-4x^6y^{-1}+6x^4y^{-2}-4x^2y^{-3}+y^{-4}$ Part (ii) Use the binomial theorem $(p+q)^n=\sum_{r=0}^{n}\binom nr p^{n-r}q^r$. Substitute and simplify. $(1+xy)^7=\sum_{r=0}^7\binom7r(xy)^r$ Part (iii) Use the binomial theorem $(p+q)^n=\sum_{r=0}^{n}\binom nr p^{n-r}q^r$. Substitute and simplify. $\left(\sqrt y+\frac1{\sqrt y}\right)^5=\sum_{r=0}^5\binom5r y^{(5-2r)/2}$

items.q: Find the indicated term in the expansions. (i) $4^{\text{th}}$ term in $(2+a)^7$ (ii) $8^{\text{th}}$ term in $\left(\dfrac x2-\dfrac3y\right)^{10}$ (iii) $3^{\text{rd}}$ term in $\left(x^2+\dfrac1{\sqrt x}\right)^4$
items.q2: توسیعات میں مذکورہ رکن معلوم کریں۔ (i) $(2+a)^7$ میں چوتھا رکن (ii) $\left(\dfrac x2-\dfrac3y\right)^{10}$ میں آٹھواں رکن (iii) $\left(x^2+\dfrac1{\sqrt x}\right)^4$ میں تیسرا رکن
items.q3: په پراختیاوو کې ښودل شوی حد پیدا کړئ. (i) په $(2+a)^7$ کې څلورم حد (ii) په $\left(\dfrac x2-\dfrac3y\right)^{10}$ کې اتم حد (iii) په $\left(x^2+\dfrac1{\sqrt x}\right)^4$ کې دریم حد
items.e: Part (i) The general term is $T_{r+1}=\binom nr p^{n-r}q^r$. Substitute and simplify. $T_4=\binom73\,2^{4}a^{3}=35\cdot16\,a^3=560a^3$ Part (ii) The general term is $T_{r+1}=\binom nr p^{n-r}q^r$. Substitute and simplify. $T_8=\binom{10}7\left(\frac x2\right)^3\left(-\frac3y\right)^7=-120\cdot\frac{3^7}{8}\cdot\frac{x^3}{y^7}=-32805\,\frac{x^3}{y^7}$ Part (iii) The general term is $T_{r+1}=\binom nr p^{n-r}q^r$. Substitute and simplify. $T_3=\binom42\left(x^2\right)^2\left(x^{-1/2}\right)^2=6x^{4-1}=6x^3$

items.q: Find the term independent of $x$ in the following expansions. (i) $\left(\dfrac{4a^2}3-\dfrac3{2a}\right)^9$ (ii) $\left(x-\dfrac3{x^4}\right)^{10}$ (iii) $\left(x-\dfrac1{x^2}\right)^{21}$
items.q2: درج ذیل توسیعات میں $x$ سے آزاد رکن معلوم کریں۔ (i) $\left(\dfrac{4a^2}3-\dfrac3{2a}\right)^9$ (ii) $\left(x-\dfrac3{x^4}\right)^{10}$ (iii) $\left(x-\dfrac1{x^2}\right)^{21}$
items.q3: په لاندې پراختیاوو کې له $x$ نه خپلواک حد پیدا کړئ. (i) $\left(\dfrac{4a^2}3-\dfrac3{2a}\right)^9$ (ii) $\left(x-\dfrac3{x^4}\right)^{10}$ (iii) $\left(x-\dfrac1{x^2}\right)^{21}$
items.e: Part (i) The general term is $T_{r+1}=\binom nr p^{n-r}q^r$. Substitute and simplify. $T_{r+1}=\binom9r\left(\frac{4a^2}3\right)^{9-r}\left(-\frac3{2a}\right)^r:\ \ a^{18-3r}=a^0\Rightarrow r=6$ Substitute and simplify. $T_7=\binom96\left(\frac{4}{3}\right)^3\left(-\frac32\right)^6\cdot a^0=2268$ Part (ii) The general term is $T_{r+1}=\binom nr p^{n-r}q^r$. Substitute and simplify. $T_{r+1}=\binom{10}r x^{10-r}\left(-\frac3{x^4}\right)^r:\ 10-5r=0\Rightarrow r=2$ Substitute and simplify. $T_3=\binom{10}2(-3)^2=45\cdot9=405$ Part (iii) The general term is $T_{r+1}=\binom nr p^{n-r}q^r$. Substitute and simplify. $T_{r+1}=\binom{21}r x^{21-r}\left(-\frac1{x^2}\right)^r:\ 21-3r=0\Rightarrow r=7$ Substitute and simplify. $T_8=(-1)^7\binom{21}7=-116280$

items.q: Find the coefficient of (i) $x^{23}$ in $(x^2-x)^{20}$ (ii) $\dfrac1{x^4}$ in $\left(2-\dfrac1x\right)^8$ (iii) $a^6b^3$ in $\left(2a-\dfrac b3\right)^9$
items.q2: سر معلوم کریں (i) $(x^2-x)^{20}$ میں $x^{23}$ کا (ii) $\left(2-\dfrac1x\right)^8$ میں $\dfrac1{x^4}$ کا (iii) $\left(2a-\dfrac b3\right)^9$ میں $a^6b^3$ کا
items.q3: ضریب پیدا کړئ (i) په $(x^2-x)^{20}$ کې د $x^{23}$ (ii) په $\left(2-\dfrac1x\right)^8$ کې د $\dfrac1{x^4}$ (iii) په $\left(2a-\dfrac b3\right)^9$ کې د $a^6b^3$
items.e: Part (i) The general term is $T_{r+1}=\binom nr p^{n-r}q^r$. Substitute and simplify. $(x^2-x)^{20}=x^{20}(x-1)^{20}:\ \text{need the coefficient of }x^3\text{ in }(x-1)^{20}$ Substitute and simplify. $\binom{20}{17}(-1)^{17}=-\binom{20}3=-1140$ Part (ii) The general term is $T_{r+1}=\binom nr p^{n-r}q^r$. Substitute and simplify. $T_{r+1}=\binom8r2^{8-r}\left(-\frac1x\right)^r:\ x^{-r}=x^{-4}\Rightarrow r=4$ Substitute and simplify. $\binom84\,2^4=70\cdot16=1120=2^4\cdot{}^8C_4$ Part (iii) The general term is $T_{r+1}=\binom nr p^{n-r}q^r$. Substitute and simplify. $a^6b^3:\ r=3,\quad \binom93(2a)^6\left(-\frac b3\right)^3=-84\cdot64\cdot\frac1{27}a^6b^3$ Substitute and simplify. $=-\frac{5376}{27}=-\frac{1792}9$

items.q: Find the middle term in the expansion of: (i) $\left(\dfrac ax+bx\right)^8$ (ii) $\left(3x-\dfrac{x^2}2\right)^9$ (iii) $\left(3x^2-\dfrac y3\right)^{10}$
items.q2: توسیع میں درمیانی رکن معلوم کریں: (i) $\left(\dfrac ax+bx\right)^8$ (ii) $\left(3x-\dfrac{x^2}2\right)^9$ (iii) $\left(3x^2-\dfrac y3\right)^{10}$
items.q3: په پراختیا کې منځنی حد پیدا کړئ: (i) $\left(\dfrac ax+bx\right)^8$ (ii) $\left(3x-\dfrac{x^2}2\right)^9$ (iii) $\left(3x^2-\dfrac y3\right)^{10}$
items.e: Part (i) For $n=8$ (even) there is one middle term, $T_5$. Substitute and simplify. $T_5=\binom84\left(\frac ax\right)^4(bx)^4=70a^4b^4$ Part (ii) For $n=9$ (odd) there are two middle terms, $T_5$ and $T_6$. Substitute and simplify. $T_5=\binom94(3x)^5\left(-\frac{x^2}2\right)^4=126\cdot243\cdot\frac1{16}x^{13}=\frac{15309}8x^{13}$ Substitute and simplify. $T_6=\binom95(3x)^4\left(-\frac{x^2}2\right)^5=-126\cdot81\cdot\frac1{32}x^{14}=-\frac{5103}{16}x^{14}$ Part (iii) For $n=10$ the middle term is $T_6$. Substitute and simplify. $T_6=\binom{10}5\left(3x^2\right)^5\left(-\frac y3\right)^5=-252x^{10}y^5$

items.q: Find the constant term in the expansion of $\left(2\sqrt x-\dfrac3{x\sqrt x}\right)^{23}$.
items.q2: $\left(2\sqrt x-\dfrac3{x\sqrt x}\right)^{23}$ کی توسیع میں مستقل رکن معلوم کریں۔
items.q3: د $\left(2\sqrt x-\dfrac3{x\sqrt x}\right)^{23}$ په پراختیا کې ثابت حد پیدا کړئ.
items.a: There is no constant term.
items.e: The general term is $T_{r+1}=\binom nr p^{n-r}q^r$. Substitute and simplify. $T_{r+1}=\binom{23}r\left(2\sqrt x\right)^{23-r}\left(-3x^{-3/2}\right)^r\ \propto\ x^{(23-4r)/2}$ A constant term needs $23-4r=0$, i.e. $r=23/4$, which is not an integer. So no constant term exists.

Part (i) In $(p+q)^n+(p-q)^n$ the odd powers of $q$ cancel and the even-power terms double. Substitute and simplify. $2\left[2^5+\binom52 2^3(\sqrt3)^2+\binom54 2(\sqrt3)^4\right]=2[32+240+90]=724$ Part (ii) In $(p+q)^n-(p-q)^n$ the even powers of $q$ cancel and the odd-power terms double. Substitute and simplify. $2\left[\binom41\sqrt2+\binom43(\sqrt2)^3\right]=2[4\sqrt2+8\sqrt2]=24\sqrt2$ Part (iii) Substitute and simplify. $2\left[a^5+\binom52a^3b^2+\binom54ab^4\right]=2a^5+20a^3b^2+10ab^4$

items.q: Find the numerically greatest term in $(3-2x)^{10}$, when $x=\dfrac34$.
items.q2: $(3-2x)^{10}$ میں عددی لحاظ سے سب سے بڑا رکن معلوم کریں جب $x=\dfrac34$ ہو۔
items.q3: په $(3-2x)^{10}$ کې عددي لحاظ تر ټولو لوی حد پیدا کړئ، کله چې $x=\dfrac34$ وي.
items.e: For $(a+b)^n$, $\left|\frac{T_{r+1}}{T_r}\right|=\frac{n-r+1}{r}\left|\frac ba\right|$. Here $a=3$, $b=-2x=-\frac32$. Substitute and simplify. $\frac{11-r}{r}\cdot\frac12\ge1\iff r\le\frac{11}3\Rightarrow r=3\text{ gives the greatest term }T_4$ Substitute and simplify. $T_4=\binom{10}33^7\left(-\frac32\right)^3=-120\cdot2187\cdot\frac{27}8=-885735$

items.q: Find the numerically greatest term in the expansion of $(x-y)^{20}$ when $x=12$ and $y=4$.
items.q2: $(x-y)^{20}$ کی توسیع میں عددی لحاظ سے سب سے بڑا رکن معلوم کریں جب $x=12$ اور $y=4$ ہو۔
items.q3: د $(x-y)^{20}$ په پراختیا کې عددي لحاظ تر ټولو لوی حد پیدا کړئ کله چې $x=12$ او $y=4$ وي.
items.e: Here $a=x=12$, $b=-y=-4$: $\left|\frac{T_{r+1}}{T_r}\right|=\frac{21-r}{r}\cdot\frac13\ge1\iff r\le\frac{21}4=5.25$. Substitute and simplify. $r=5\Rightarrow T_6=\binom{20}512^{15}(-4)^5=-15504\cdot12^{15}\cdot4^5$ The printed key shows a different exponent pattern; the value computed here is the greatest term by the ratio test.

items.q: Prove that sum of Binomial coefficients of order $n=2^n$. Also prove the sum of odd binomial coefficients $=$ sum of even Binomial coefficients $=2^{n-1}$.
items.q2: ثابت کریں کہ درجہ $n$ کے دو رقمی سروں کا مجموعہ $=2^n$ ہے۔ یہ بھی ثابت کریں کہ طاق دو رقمی سروں کا مجموعہ $=$ جفت دو رقمی سروں کا مجموعہ $=2^{n-1}$ ہے۔
items.q3: ثابته کړئ چې د $n$ درجې د دوه حدي ضریبونو مجموعه $=2^n$ ده. همداراز ثابته کړئ چې د تاقو دوه حدي ضریبونو مجموعه $=$ د جفتو دوه حدي ضریبونو مجموعه $=2^{n-1}$ ده.
items.a: Proved: $\sum\binom nr=2^n$ and $\sum_{\text{odd}}=\sum_{\text{even}}=2^{n-1}$
items.e: Put $x=1$ in $(1+x)^n=\sum\binom nrx^r$. $2^n=\binom n0+\binom n1+\cdots+\binom nn$ Put $x=-1$. $0=\left[\binom n0+\binom n2+\cdots\right]-\left[\binom n1+\binom n3+\cdots\right]$ So the even-order and odd-order sums are equal; together they equal $2^n$, hence each is $2^{n-1}$.

items.q: Consider $(1+x)^n$ and take $\dbinom nr=C_r$. Show that $C_1+2C_2x+3C_3x^2+\cdots+nC_nx^{n-1}=n(1+x)^{n-1}$
items.q2: $(1+x)^n$ پر غور کریں اور $\dbinom nr=C_r$ لیں۔ دکھائیں کہ $C_1+2C_2x+3C_3x^2+\cdots+nC_nx^{n-1}=n(1+x)^{n-1}$
items.q3: $(1+x)^n$ وګورئ او $\dbinom nr=C_r$ واخلئ. وښایاست چې $C_1+2C_2x+3C_3x^2+\cdots+nC_nx^{n-1}=n(1+x)^{n-1}$
items.a: Proved.
items.e: Write $(1+x)^n=C_0+C_1x+C_2x^2+\cdots+C_nx^n$ and differentiate both sides with respect to $x$. $n(1+x)^{n-1}=C_1+2C_2x+3C_3x^2+\cdots+nC_nx^{n-1}$ Alternatively, $rC_r=n\binom{n-1}{r-1}$, so the right side is $n\sum\binom{n-1}{r-1}x^{r-1}=n(1+x)^{n-1}$.

items.q: Find the first four terms in the expansions of (i) $(1-x)^{-\frac12}$ (ii) $(1-x)^{\frac32}$ (iii) $(8+12x)^{\frac23}$
items.q2: توسیعات کے پہلے چار ارکان معلوم کریں (i) $(1-x)^{-\frac12}$ (ii) $(1-x)^{\frac32}$ (iii) $(8+12x)^{\frac23}$
items.q3: د پراختیاوو لومړي څلور حدونه پیدا کړئ (i) $(1-x)^{-\frac12}$ (ii) $(1-x)^{\frac32}$ (iii) $(8+12x)^{\frac23}$
items.a: (i) $1+\dfrac x2+\dfrac{3x^2}8+\dfrac{5x^3}{16}+\cdots$; (ii) $1-\dfrac{3x}2+\dfrac{3x^2}8+\dfrac{x^3}{16}+\cdots$; (iii) $4+4x-x^2+\dfrac23x^3+\cdots$
items.e: Part (i) Use $(1+z)^m=1+mz+\frac{m(m-1)}{2!}z^2+\frac{m(m-1)(m-2)}{3!}z^3+\cdots,\ |z|<1$. Substitute and simplify. $(1-x)^{-1/2}:\ m=-\tfrac12,\ z=-x$ Part (ii) Use $(1+z)^m=1+mz+\frac{m(m-1)}{2!}z^2+\frac{m(m-1)(m-2)}{3!}z^3+\cdots,\ |z|<1$. Substitute and simplify. $(1-x)^{3/2}:\ m=\tfrac32,\ z=-x$ Part (iii) Use $(1+z)^m=1+mz+\frac{m(m-1)}{2!}z^2+\frac{m(m-1)(m-2)}{3!}z^3+\cdots,\ |z|<1$. Substitute and simplify. $(8+12x)^{2/3}=8^{2/3}\left(1+\tfrac32x\right)^{2/3}=4\left[1+x-\tfrac14x^2+\tfrac16x^3-\cdots\right]$

items.q: (i) Find $\sqrt{26}$ correct to 3 decimal places. (ii) Evaluate $\dfrac1{\sqrt{0.998}}$ to four significant figures. (iii) Find the cube root of 126 correct to five decimal places.
items.q2: (i) $\sqrt{26}$ کو 3 اعشاریہ مقامات تک درست معلوم کریں۔ (ii) $\dfrac1{\sqrt{0.998}}$ کی قیمت چار بامعنی ہندسوں تک معلوم کریں۔ (iii) 126 کا مکعب جذر پانچ اعشاریہ مقامات تک درست معلوم کریں۔
items.q3: (i) $\sqrt{26}$ د 3 اعشاري ځایونو پورې سم پیدا کړئ. (ii) $\dfrac1{\sqrt{0.998}}$ تر څلورو معنوي عددونو پورې ارزول. (iii) د 126 مکعبي جذر تر پنځو اعشاري ځایونو پورې سم پیدا کړئ.
items.e: Part (i) Use $(1+z)^m=1+mz+\frac{m(m-1)}{2!}z^2+\frac{m(m-1)(m-2)}{3!}z^3+\cdots,\ |z|<1$. Substitute and simplify. $\sqrt{26}=5\left(1+\tfrac1{25}\right)^{1/2}=5\left[1+\tfrac1{50}-\tfrac1{5000}+\cdots\right]=5.0990\ldots\approx5.099$ Part (ii) Use $(1+z)^m=1+mz+\frac{m(m-1)}{2!}z^2+\frac{m(m-1)(m-2)}{3!}z^3+\cdots,\ |z|<1$. Substitute and simplify. $\frac1{\sqrt{0.998}}=(1-0.002)^{-1/2}=1+0.001+0.0000015+\cdots=1.0010015\approx1.001$ Part (iii) Use $(1+z)^m=1+mz+\frac{m(m-1)}{2!}z^2+\frac{m(m-1)(m-2)}{3!}z^3+\cdots,\ |z|<1$. Substitute and simplify. $\sqrt[3]{126}=5\left(1+\tfrac1{125}\right)^{1/3}=5\left[1+\tfrac1{375}-\tfrac1{70\,312.5}\cdots\right]\approx5.01330$

items.q: Expand: $\sqrt{\dfrac{1-x}{1+x}}$ up to $x^3$.
items.q2: $\sqrt{\dfrac{1-x}{1+x}}$ کو $x^3$ تک پھیلائیں۔
items.q3: $\sqrt{\dfrac{1-x}{1+x}}$ تر $x^3$ پورې پراخ کړئ.
items.a: $1-x+\dfrac{x^2}2-\dfrac{x^3}2+\cdots$
items.e: Use $(1+z)^m=1+mz+\frac{m(m-1)}{2!}z^2+\frac{m(m-1)(m-2)}{3!}z^3+\cdots,\ |z|<1$. Substitute and simplify. $(1-x)^{1/2}(1+x)^{-1/2}=\left[1-\tfrac x2-\tfrac{x^2}8-\tfrac{x^3}{16}\right]\left[1-\tfrac x2+\tfrac{3x^2}8-\tfrac{5x^3}{16}\right]=1-x+\tfrac{x^2}2-\tfrac{x^3}2$

items.q: If $x$ is such that $x^2$ and higher powers may be neglected, then show that $\sqrt{\dfrac{1-3x}{1+4x}}=1-\dfrac{7x}2$
items.q2: اگر $x$ ایسا ہو کہ $x^2$ اور بلند قوتیں نظر انداز کی جا سکیں تو دکھائیں کہ $\sqrt{\dfrac{1-3x}{1+4x}}=1-\dfrac{7x}2$
items.q3: که $x$ داسې وي چې $x^2$ او لوړ توانونه له پامه غورځول شي نو وښایاست چې $\sqrt{\dfrac{1-3x}{1+4x}}=1-\dfrac{7x}2$
items.a: Proved.
items.e: Use $(1+z)^m=1+mz+\frac{m(m-1)}{2!}z^2+\frac{m(m-1)(m-2)}{3!}z^3+\cdots,\ |z|<1$. Substitute and simplify. $(1-3x)^{1/2}(1+4x)^{-1/2}\approx\left(1-\tfrac{3x}2\right)(1-2x)\approx1-\tfrac{7x}2\quad(x^2\text{ neglected})$

items.q: If $x$ is so small that its square and higher powers can be neglected, then show that $\dfrac{(8+3x)^{\frac23}}{(2+3x)\sqrt{4-5x}}=1-\dfrac58x$
items.q2: اگر $x$ اتنا چھوٹا ہو کہ اس کا مربع اور بلند قوتیں نظر انداز کی جا سکیں تو دکھائیں کہ $\dfrac{(8+3x)^{\frac23}}{(2+3x)\sqrt{4-5x}}=1-\dfrac58x$
items.q3: که $x$ دومره کوچنی وي چې مربع او لوړ توانونه یې له پامه غورځول شي نو وښایاست چې $\dfrac{(8+3x)^{\frac23}}{(2+3x)\sqrt{4-5x}}=1-\dfrac58x$
items.a: Proved.
items.e: Use $(1+z)^m=1+mz+\frac{m(m-1)}{2!}z^2+\frac{m(m-1)(m-2)}{3!}z^3+\cdots,\ |z|<1$. items.q: Find the sum of the following: (i) $1-\dfrac1{2^2}+\dfrac{1\cdot3}{2!}\cdot\dfrac1{2^4}+\cdots$ (ii) $1+\dfrac58+\dfrac{5\cdot8}{8\cdot12}+\dfrac{5\cdot8\cdot11}{8\cdot12\cdot16}+\cdots$
items.q2: درج ذیل کا مجموعہ معلوم کریں: (i) $1-\dfrac1{2^2}+\dfrac{1\cdot3}{2!}\cdot\dfrac1{2^4}+\cdots$ (ii) $1+\dfrac58+\dfrac{5\cdot8}{8\cdot12}+\dfrac{5\cdot8\cdot11}{8\cdot12\cdot16}+\cdots$
items.q3: د لاندې مجموعه پیدا کړئ: (i) $1-\dfrac1{2^2}+\dfrac{1\cdot3}{2!}\cdot\dfrac1{2^4}+\cdots$ (ii) $1+\dfrac58+\dfrac{5\cdot8}{8\cdot12}+\dfrac{5\cdot8\cdot11}{8\cdot12\cdot16}+\cdots$
items.a: (i) $\sqrt{\dfrac23}$; (ii) $2\left(4^{2/3}-1\right)=2\left(2^{4/3}-1\right)\approx3.0397$
items.e: Part (i) Use $(1+z)^m=1+mz+\frac{m(m-1)}{2!}z^2+\frac{m(m-1)(m-2)}{3!}z^3+\cdots,\ |z|<1$. Substitute and simplify. $(1+z)^{-1/2}=1-\tfrac z2+\tfrac{1\cdot3}{2!}\tfrac{z^2}{2^2}-\cdots;\ \text{with }z=\tfrac12\text{ the terms are }1-\tfrac1{2^2}+\tfrac{1\cdot3}{2!}\tfrac1{2^4}-\cdots$ Substitute and simplify. $\text{Sum}=\left(1+\tfrac12\right)^{-1/2}=\left(\tfrac32\right)^{-1/2}=\sqrt{\tfrac23}$ Part (ii) Ratio of consecutive terms: $\frac{t_j}{t_{j-1}}=\frac{5+3(j-1)}{8+4(j-1)}$. Put $i=j+1$: it becomes $\frac34\cdot\frac{i-1/3}{i}$. For $(1-x)^{-2/3}=\sum u_ix^i$ the coefficient ratio is $\frac{u_i}{u_{i-1}}=\frac{i-1/3}i\,x$. With $x=\frac34$ this is the same ratio, and $t_0=1=2u_1$ because $u_1=\frac23\cdot\frac34=\frac12$. Substitute and simplify. $\text{Sum}=2\sum_{i\ge1}u_i=2\left[(1-x)^{-2/3}-1\right]=2\left[\left(\tfrac14\right)^{-2/3}-1\right]=2\left(4^{2/3}-1\right)$

items.q: If $y=\dfrac1{2^2}+\dfrac{1\cdot3}{2!}\cdot\dfrac1{2^4}+\dfrac{1\cdot3\cdot5}{3!}\cdot\dfrac1{2^6}+\cdots$ then $y^2+2y-1=0$
items.q2: اگر $y=\dfrac1{2^2}+\dfrac{1\cdot3}{2!}\cdot\dfrac1{2^4}+\dfrac{1\cdot3\cdot5}{3!}\cdot\dfrac1{2^6}+\cdots$ تو $y^2+2y-1=0$
items.q3: که $y=\dfrac1{2^2}+\dfrac{1\cdot3}{2!}\cdot\dfrac1{2^4}+\dfrac{1\cdot3\cdot5}{3!}\cdot\dfrac1{2^6}+\cdots$ نو $y^2+2y-1=0$
items.a: Proved.
items.e: Compare with $(1-z)^{-1/2}=1+\frac z2+\frac{1\cdot3}{2!}\frac{z^2}{2^2}+\frac{1\cdot3\cdot5}{3!}\frac{z^3}{2^3}+\cdots$. With $z=\frac12$ the series becomes $1+y$. Substitute and simplify. $1+y=\left(1-\tfrac12\right)^{-1/2}=\sqrt2\Rightarrow y=\sqrt2-1$ Substitute and simplify. $y^2+2y-1=(\sqrt2-1)^2+2(\sqrt2-1)-1=3-2\sqrt2+2\sqrt2-2-1=0$

items.a: Proved.
items.e: Expand the left side: $(1+x)^{1/n}\approx1+\frac xn+\frac{1}{2}\cdot\frac1n\left(\frac1n-1\right)x^2$. Both give $1+\frac xn-\frac{(n-1)x^2}{2n^2}$ up to $x^2$, so $\sqrt[n]{1+x}\approx\frac{2n+(n+1)x}{2n+(n-1)x}$.

items.q: For every positive integer $n$, prove that $7^n-3^n$ is divisible by 4.
items.q2: ہر مثبت صحیح عدد $n$ کے لیے ثابت کریں کہ $7^n-3^n$، 4 سے تقسیم پذیر ہے۔
items.q3: د هر مثبت صحیح عدد $n$ لپاره ثابته کړئ چې $7^n-3^n$ په 4 د تقسیم وړ دی.
items.a: Proved.
items.e: Check the statement for $n=1$. $n=1:\ 7-3=4$ Assume the statement is true for $n=k$. $7^k-3^k=4m$ Add the next term (or work with $n=k+1$) and simplify to the required form. $7^{k+1}-3^{k+1}=7\cdot7^k-3\cdot3^k=7\left(7^k-3^k\right)+4\cdot3^k=28m+4\cdot3^k=4\left(7m+3^k\right)$ Hence the statement is true for $n=k+1$. By mathematical induction it holds for every positive integer $n$.

items.q: Prove that $(1+x)^n\ge(1+nx)$, for all natural number $n$ where $x>-1$
items.q2: ثابت کریں کہ تمام قدرتی اعداد $n$ کے لیے $(1+x)^n\ge(1+nx)$ جہاں $x>-1$
items.q3: ثابته کړئ چې د ټولو طبیعي عددونو $n$ لپاره $(1+x)^n\ge(1+nx)$ چېرته چې $x>-1$
items.a: Proved.
items.e: For $x>-1$ and $n=1$: $(1+x)^1=1+x$, so the statement holds. Assume the statement is true for $n=k$. $(1+x)^k\ge1+kx$ Add the next term (or work with $n=k+1$) and simplify to the required form. $(1+x)^{k+1}=(1+x)(1+x)^k\ge(1+x)(1+kx)=1+(k+1)x+kx^2\ge1+(k+1)x$ We used $1+x>0$ (to keep the inequality direction) and $kx^2\ge0$. Hence the statement is true for $n=k+1$. By mathematical induction it holds for every positive integer $n$.

items.q3: $f(x)=x^2+x-1$، (i) انځورونه $-2,0,2,5$ پیدا کړئ (ii) که $f(x)=5$ وي نو د $x$ ارزښتونه پیدا کړئ (iii) $f(x+1)$ پیدا کړئ (iv) $\dfrac{f(x+h)-f(x)}h$ پیدا کړئ
items.e: Part (i) Substitute and simplify. $f(-2)=4-2-1=1,\ f(0)=-1,\ f(2)=4+2-1=5,\ f(5)=25+5-1=29$ Part (ii) Substitute and simplify. $x^2+x-1=5\Rightarrow x^2+x-6=0\Rightarrow(x+3)(x-2)=0$ Part (iii) Substitute and simplify. $f(x+1)=(x+1)^2+(x+1)-1=x^2+2x+1+x+1-1=x^2+3x+1$ Part (iv) Substitute and simplify. $\frac{f(x+h)-f(x)}h=\frac{(x+h)^2+(x+h)-x^2-x}h=\frac{2xh+h^2+h}h=2x+h+1$

items.q: If $f(x)=7x-2$, $g(x)=\dfrac{2x}{x^2-4}$, $h(x)=4\sqrt{25-x^2}$, $k(x)=x^2+1$, then determine (i) $f(6),g(-1),h(4),k\left(\dfrac12\right)$ (ii) $\dfrac{f(x)-f(2)}{x-2}$
items.q2: اگر $f(x)=7x-2$، $g(x)=\dfrac{2x}{x^2-4}$، $h(x)=4\sqrt{25-x^2}$، $k(x)=x^2+1$ ہوں تو معلوم کریں (i) $f(6),g(-1),h(4),k\left(\dfrac12\right)$ (ii) $\dfrac{f(x)-f(2)}{x-2}$
items.q3: که $f(x)=7x-2$، $g(x)=\dfrac{2x}{x^2-4}$، $h(x)=4\sqrt{25-x^2}$، $k(x)=x^2+1$ وي نو پیدا کړئ (i) $f(6),g(-1),h(4),k\left(\dfrac12\right)$ (ii) $\dfrac{f(x)-f(2)}{x-2}$
items.e: Part (i) Substitute and simplify. $f(6)=7(6)-2=40;\ g(-1)=\frac{-2}{1-4}=\frac23;\ h(4)=4\sqrt{25-16}=12;\ k\left(\tfrac12\right)=\tfrac14+1=\tfrac54$ Part (ii) Substitute and simplify. $\frac{f(x)-f(2)}{x-2}=\frac{(7x-2)-12}{x-2}=\frac{7(x-2)}{x-2}=7\quad(x\ne2)$

items.q: Find all real values of $x$ such that $f(x)=0$. (i) $f(x)=15x-3$ (ii) $f(x)=x^2-8x+15$ (iii) $f(x)=x^3-x$ (iv) $f(x)=x^3-x^2-5x+5$
items.q2: $x$ کی تمام حقیقی قیمتیں معلوم کریں تاکہ $f(x)=0$ ہو۔ (i) $f(x)=15x-3$ (ii) $f(x)=x^2-8x+15$ (iii) $f(x)=x^3-x$ (iv) $f(x)=x^3-x^2-5x+5$
items.q3: د $x$ ټول حقیقي ارزښتونه پیدا کړئ چې $f(x)=0$ شي. (i) $f(x)=15x-3$ (ii) $f(x)=x^2-8x+15$ (iii) $f(x)=x^3-x$ (iv) $f(x)=x^3-x^2-5x+5$
items.e: Part (i) Substitute and simplify. $15x-3=0\Rightarrow x=\tfrac15$ Part (ii) Substitute and simplify. $x^2-8x+15=(x-3)(x-5)=0$ Part (iii) Substitute and simplify. $x^3-x=x(x-1)(x+1)=0$ Part (iv) Substitute and simplify. $x^3-x^2-5x+5=x^2(x-1)-5(x-1)=(x-1)(x^2-5)=0$

items.q: Find the domain and range of the function $f(x)$. (i) $f(x)=5x^2+2x-1$ (ii) $f(x)=\sqrt{x^2-16}$
items.q2: تفاعل $f(x)$ کا دائرہ اور سعت معلوم کریں۔ (i) $f(x)=5x^2+2x-1$ (ii) $f(x)=\sqrt{x^2-16}$
items.q3: د تابع $f(x)$ ډومین او رینج پیدا کړئ. (i) $f(x)=5x^2+2x-1$ (ii) $f(x)=\sqrt{x^2-16}$
items.a: (i) Domain $=R$; Range $=\left[-\frac65,\infty\right)$; (ii) Domain $=R-(-4,4)$; Range $=[0,\infty)$
items.e: Part (i) Substitute and simplify. $5x^2+2x-1=5\left(x+\tfrac15\right)^2-\tfrac65\ge-\tfrac65$ The printed key lists the range as $R$; a quadratic with positive leading coefficient has a least value, so the range is $[-6/5,\infty)$. Part (ii) Substitute and simplify. $x^2-16\ge0\Rightarrow|x|\ge4;\quad\sqrt{x^2-16}\ge0\text{ and takes every value }\ge0$

items.q: Find the inverse function of the following functions (i) $f(x)=2x-3$ (ii) $f(x)=\dfrac13x-5$ (iii) $f(x)=\dfrac{2-x}5$ (iv) $f(x)=4+\sqrt{2x}$
items.q2: درج ذیل تفاعل کے معکوس تفاعل معلوم کریں (i) $f(x)=2x-3$ (ii) $f(x)=\dfrac13x-5$ (iii) $f(x)=\dfrac{2-x}5$ (iv) $f(x)=4+\sqrt{2x}$
items.q3: د لاندې تابعګانو معکوس تابعګانې پیدا کړئ (i) $f(x)=2x-3$ (ii) $f(x)=\dfrac13x-5$ (iii) $f(x)=\dfrac{2-x}5$ (iv) $f(x)=4+\sqrt{2x}$
items.e: Part (i) Put $y=f(x)$, solve for $x$, then interchange $x$ and $y$. Substitute and simplify. $y=2x-3\Rightarrow x=\frac{y+3}2$ Part (ii) Put $y=f(x)$, solve for $x$, then interchange $x$ and $y$. Substitute and simplify. $y=\tfrac13x-5\Rightarrow x=3(y+5)=3y+15$ Part (iii) Put $y=f(x)$, solve for $x$, then interchange $x$ and $y$. Substitute and simplify. $y=\frac{2-x}5\Rightarrow x=2-5y$ Part (iv) Put $y=f(x)$, solve for $x$, then interchange $x$ and $y$. Substitute and simplify. $y=4+\sqrt{2x}\Rightarrow(y-4)^2=2x\Rightarrow x=\tfrac12(y-4)^2,\ y\ge4$

items.q2: اگر $f(x)=x^3-2$ ہو تو معلوم کریں (i) $f^{-1}(x)$ (ii) $f^{-1}(3)$
items.q3: که $f(x)=x^3-2$ وي نو پیدا کړئ (i) $f^{-1}(x)$ (ii) $f^{-1}(3)$
items.e: Part (i) Put $y=f(x)$, solve for $x$, then interchange $x$ and $y$. Substitute and simplify. $y=x^3-2\Rightarrow x=\sqrt[3]{y+2}$ Part (ii) Substitute and simplify. $f^{-1}(3)=\sqrt[3]{3+2}=\sqrt[3]5$

items.q3: که $f(x)=\dfrac{x-4}{x-3}$ وي نو پیدا کړئ (i) د $f$ ډومین او رینج. (ii) د $f^{-1}$ ډومین او رینج

items.q: Find the point of intersection graphically of the following linear functions with the coordinate axes. (i) $f(x)=x-3$ (ii) $f(x)=2x+1$
items.q2: درج ذیل خطی تفاعل کا محوری محوروں کے ساتھ نقطۂ تقاطع ترسیمی طور پر معلوم کریں۔ (i) $f(x)=x-3$ (ii) $f(x)=2x+1$
items.q3: د لاندې خطي تابعګانو د همغږو محورونو سره د تقاطع ټکی ګرافي ډول پیدا کړئ. (i) $f(x)=x-3$ (ii) $f(x)=2x+1$
items.a: (i) $x$-axis at $(3,0)$; $y$-axis at $(0,-3)$; (ii) $x$-axis at $\left(-\frac12,0\right)$; $y$-axis at $(0,1)$
items.e: Part (i) Substitute and simplify. $y=0\Rightarrow x=3;\quad x=0\Rightarrow y=-3$ Part (ii) Substitute and simplify. $y=0\Rightarrow x=-\tfrac12;\quad x=0\Rightarrow y=1$

items.q: Find the point of intersection graphically of the following functions. (i) $f(x)=-x+2,\ g(x)=2x+1$ (ii) $f(x)=3x-2,\ g(x)=-x+6$
items.q2: درج ذیل تفاعل کا نقطۂ تقاطع ترسیمی طور پر معلوم کریں۔ (i) $f(x)=-x+2,\ g(x)=2x+1$ (ii) $f(x)=3x-2,\ g(x)=-x+6$
items.q3: د لاندې تابعګانو د تقاطع ټکی ګرافي ډول پیدا کړئ. (i) $f(x)=-x+2,\ g(x)=2x+1$ (ii) $f(x)=3x-2,\ g(x)=-x+6$
items.a: (i) $\left(\frac13,\frac53\right)$; (ii) $(2,4)$
items.e: Part (i) Substitute and simplify. $-x+2=2x+1\Rightarrow x=\tfrac13,\ y=2-\tfrac13=\tfrac53$ Part (ii) Substitute and simplify. $3x-2=-x+6\Rightarrow x=2,\ y=4$

items.q: Find the point of intersection graphically of the following functions. (i) $f(x)=-x^2+4,\ g(x)=x+2$ (ii) $f(x)=x^2+x-3,\ g(x)=-2x-5$
items.q2: درج ذیل تفاعل کا نقطۂ تقاطع ترسیمی طور پر معلوم کریں۔ (i) $f(x)=-x^2+4,\ g(x)=x+2$ (ii) $f(x)=x^2+x-3,\ g(x)=-2x-5$
items.q3: د لاندې تابعګانو د تقاطع ټکی ګرافي ډول پیدا کړئ. (i) $f(x)=-x^2+4,\ g(x)=x+2$ (ii) $f(x)=x^2+x-3,\ g(x)=-2x-5$
items.e: Part (i) Substitute and simplify. $-x^2+4=x+2\Rightarrow x^2+x-2=0\Rightarrow(x+2)(x-1)=0;\ y=x+2:\ (1,3),(-2,0)$ Part (ii) Substitute and simplify. $x^2+x-3=-2x-5\Rightarrow x^2+3x+2=0\Rightarrow(x+1)(x+2)=0;\ y=-2x-5:\ (-1,-3),(-2,-1)$

items.q: The paths of two airplanes A and B in the plane are determined by the straight lines $2x-y=6$ and $3x+y=4$ respectively. Find the point where the two paths cross each other.
items.q2: ہوائی جہاز A اور B کے مستوی میں راستے بالترتیب سیدھے خطوط $2x-y=6$ اور $3x+y=4$ سے متعین ہوتے ہیں۔ وہ نقطہ معلوم کریں جہاں دونوں راستے ایک دوسرے کو کاٹتے ہیں۔
items.q3: د دوو الوتکو A او B لارې په سطحه کې په ترتیب سره د سیدو کرښو $2x-y=6$ او $3x+y=4$ په واسطه ټاکل کېږي. هغه ټکی پیدا کړئ چېرته چې دواړه لارې یو بل غوڅوي.
items.e: Substitute and simplify. $2x-y=6,\ 3x+y=4\Rightarrow5x=10\Rightarrow x=2,\ y=-2$

items.q: A pilot makes a check flight in an air. Going directly into the wind, he covers a distance of 24 km in 6 minutes. Going with the wind, he covers the distance in 4 minutes. Find his air speed and velocity of the wind in km/min.
items.q2: ایک پائلٹ ہوا میں معائنہ پرواز کرتا ہے۔ ہوا کی سمت کے مخالف براہ راست جاتے ہوئے وہ 6 منٹ میں 24 کلومیٹر کا فاصلہ طے کرتا ہے۔ ہوا کی سمت میں جاتے ہوئے وہ یہی فاصلہ 4 منٹ میں طے کرتا ہے۔ اس کی ہوائی رفتار اور ہوا کی رفتار کلومیٹر فی منٹ میں معلوم کریں۔
items.q3: یو الوتکه چلوونکی په هوا کې د معاینې الوتنه کوي. په مستقیم ډول د باد خلاف تللو سره هغه په 6 دقیقو کې 24 کیلومتره واټن وهي. د باد په لور تللو سره هغه همدا واټن په 4 دقیقو کې وهي. د هغه د هوا سرعت او د باد سرعت په کیلومیټر په دقیقه کې پیدا کړئ.
items.a: Air speed $=5$ km/min, wind velocity $=1$ km/min
items.e: Let air speed $a$ and wind speed $w$. Against the wind: $a-w=\frac{24}6=4$. With the wind: $a+w=\frac{24}4=6$. Substitute and simplify. $a=\frac{4+6}2=5,\quad w=\frac{6-4}2=1$

items.q: Find domain of $f(x)=\sqrt{3-\sqrt{12-x^2}}$.
items.q2: $f(x)=\sqrt{3-\sqrt{12-x^2}}$ کا دائرہ معلوم کریں۔
items.q3: د $f(x)=\sqrt{3-\sqrt{12-x^2}}$ ډومین پیدا کړئ.
items.a: Domain $f=\left[-2\sqrt3,-\sqrt3\right]\cup\left[\sqrt3,2\sqrt3\right]$
items.e: Substitute and simplify. $12-x^2\ge0\Rightarrow|x|\le2\sqrt3;\quad3-\sqrt{12-x^2}\ge0\Rightarrow12-x^2\le9\Rightarrow|x|\ge\sqrt3$

items.q: Find a polynomial function $f(x)$ of the second degree when $f(0)=5,\ f(-1)=10,\ f(1)=6$.
items.q2: دوسرے درجے کا کثیر رقمی تفاعل $f(x)$ معلوم کریں جب $f(0)=5,\ f(-1)=10,\ f(1)=6$ ہو۔
items.q3: د دویمې درجې څو حدي تابع $f(x)$ پیدا کړئ کله چې $f(0)=5,\ f(-1)=10,\ f(1)=6$ وي.
items.e: Substitute and simplify. $f(x)=ax^2+bx+c:\ c=5;\ a-b+5=10;\ a+b+5=6\Rightarrow a-b=5,\ a+b=1\Rightarrow a=3,\ b=-2$

items.q: Find the range of each of the following functions: (i) $f(x)=x^2+2,\ x\in\mathbb R$ (ii) $f(x)=x,\ x\in\mathbb R$
items.q2: درج ذیل تفاعل میں سے ہر ایک کی سعت معلوم کریں: (i) $f(x)=x^2+2,\ x\in\mathbb R$ (ii) $f(x)=x,\ x\in\mathbb R$
items.q3: د لاندې هر تابع رینج پیدا کړئ: (i) $f(x)=x^2+2,\ x\in\mathbb R$ (ii) $f(x)=x,\ x\in\mathbb R$
items.e: Substitute and simplify. $\text{(i) }x^2\ge0\Rightarrow x^2+2\ge2;\quad\text{(ii) }f(x)=x\text{ takes every real value}$

items.q: If $f(x)=8x-7$, find (i) $f^{-1}(9)$ (ii) $f^{-1}\left(\dfrac{11}3\right)$
items.q2: اگر $f(x)=8x-7$ ہو تو معلوم کریں (i) $f^{-1}(9)$ (ii) $f^{-1}\left(\dfrac{11}3\right)$
items.q3: که $f(x)=8x-7$ وي نو پیدا کړئ (i) $f^{-1}(9)$ (ii) $f^{-1}\left(\dfrac{11}3\right)$
items.e: Substitute and simplify. $f^{-1}(y)=\frac{y+7}8:\ f^{-1}(9)=2,\ f^{-1}\left(\tfrac{11}3\right)=\tfrac{32/3}8=\tfrac43$

items.q: Given that $f(x)=x^3-ax^2+bx+1$. If $f(2)=-3$ and $f(-1)=0$, find the value of $a$ and $b$.
items.q2: دیا گیا ہے $f(x)=x^3-ax^2+bx+1$۔ اگر $f(2)=-3$ اور $f(-1)=0$ ہو تو $a$ اور $b$ کی قیمت معلوم کریں۔
items.q3: ورکړل شوی دی $f(x)=x^3-ax^2+bx+1$. که $f(2)=-3$ او $f(-1)=0$ وي نو د $a$ او $b$ ارزښت پیدا کړئ.
items.e: Substitute and simplify. $f(2)=8-4a+2b+1=-3\Rightarrow2a-b=6;\quad f(-1)=-1-a-b+1=0\Rightarrow b=-a$ Substitute and simplify. $3a=6\Rightarrow a=2,\ b=-2$ The printed key shows "$b=-2y$", an obvious misprint for $b=-2$.

items.q: Find the point of intersection graphically of the following functions. (i) $f(x)=x+4,\ g(x)=-2x+3$ (ii) $f(x)=x^2-x-2,\ g(x)=-3x-3$
items.q2: درج ذیل تفاعل کا نقطۂ تقاطع ترسیمی طور پر معلوم کریں۔ (i) $f(x)=x+4,\ g(x)=-2x+3$ (ii) $f(x)=x^2-x-2,\ g(x)=-3x-3$
items.q3: د لاندې تابعګانو د تقاطع ټکی ګرافي ډول پیدا کړئ. (i) $f(x)=x+4,\ g(x)=-2x+3$ (ii) $f(x)=x^2-x-2,\ g(x)=-3x-3$
items.a: (i) $\left(-\frac13,\frac{11}3\right)$; (ii) $(-1,0)$ (the line touches the parabola)
items.e: Substitute and simplify. $\text{(i) }x+4=-2x+3\Rightarrow x=-\tfrac13,\ y=\tfrac{11}3$ Substitute and simplify. $\text{(ii) }x^2-x-2=-3x-3\Rightarrow(x+1)^2=0\Rightarrow x=-1,\ y=0\ (\text{tangent})$

items.q: (i) Maximize $f(x,y)=2x+y$ subject to the constraints $x+y\le6,\ x+y\ge1,\ x,y\ge0$ (ii) Maximize $f(x,y)=3x+5y$ subject to the constraints $2x+3y\le12,\ 3x+2y\le12,\ x+y\ge2,\ x\ge0,\ y\ge0$
items.q2: (i) $f(x,y)=2x+y$ کو زیادہ سے زیادہ کریں، پابندیوں $x+y\le6,\ x+y\ge1,\ x,y\ge0$ کے تحت (ii) $f(x,y)=3x+5y$ کو زیادہ سے زیادہ کریں، پابندیوں $2x+3y\le12,\ 3x+2y\le12,\ x+y\ge2,\ x\ge0,\ y\ge0$ کے تحت
items.q3: (i) $f(x,y)=2x+y$ زیات کړئ، د بندیزونو $x+y\le6,\ x+y\ge1,\ x,y\ge0$ لاندې (ii) $f(x,y)=3x+5y$ زیات کړئ، د بندیزونو $2x+3y\le12,\ 3x+2y\le12,\ x+y\ge2,\ x\ge0,\ y\ge0$ لاندې
items.a: (i) Maximum value $12$ at the corner point $(6,0)$.; (ii) Maximum value $20$ at the corner point $(0,4)$.
items.e: Part (i) Find the corner points of the feasible region, evaluate the objective function at each and choose the largest (or smallest) value. Substitute and simplify. $(0,1):1;\ (0,6):6;\ (1,0):2;\ (6,0):12\Rightarrow f_{\max}=12\text{ at }(6,0)$ Part (ii) Find the corner points of the feasible region, evaluate the objective function at each and choose the largest (or smallest) value. Substitute and simplify. $(0,2):10;\ (0,4):20;\ (2,0):6;\ (4,0):12;\ \left(\tfrac{12}5,\tfrac{12}5\right):\tfrac{96}5=19.2\Rightarrow f_{\max}=20\text{ at }(0,4)$

items.q: (i) Find the maximum and minimum values of the function $f(x,y)=5x+2y$ subject to the constraints $2x+y\ge2,\ x+2y\le10,\ x\ge0,\ y\ge0$ (ii) Find the maximum and minimum values of the function $f(x,y)=7x+21y$ subject to the constraints $2x+y\ge2,\ 2x+3y\le6,\ x+2y\le8,\ x\ge0,\ y\ge0$
items.q2: (i) تفاعل $f(x,y)=5x+2y$ کی زیادہ سے زیادہ اور کم سے کم قیمتیں معلوم کریں، پابندیوں $2x+y\ge2,\ x+2y\le10,\ x\ge0,\ y\ge0$ کے تحت (ii) تفاعل $f(x,y)=7x+21y$ کی زیادہ سے زیادہ اور کم سے کم قیمتیں معلوم کریں، پابندیوں $2x+y\ge2,\ 2x+3y\le6,\ x+2y\le8,\ x\ge0,\ y\ge0$ کے تحت
items.q3: (i) د تابع $f(x,y)=5x+2y$ لوی او کوچنی ارزښتونه پیدا کړئ، د بندیزونو $2x+y\ge2,\ x+2y\le10,\ x\ge0,\ y\ge0$ لاندې (ii) د تابع $f(x,y)=7x+21y$ لوی او کوچنی ارزښتونه پیدا کړئ، د بندیزونو $2x+y\ge2,\ 2x+3y\le6,\ x+2y\le8,\ x\ge0,\ y\ge0$ لاندې
items.a: (i) Maximum value $50$ at $(10,0)$; minimum value $4$ at $(0,2)$.; (ii) Corner points $(0,2),(1,0),(3,0)$: maximum value $42$ at $(0,2)$; minimum value $7$ at $(1,0)$.
items.e: Part (i) Find the corner points of the feasible region, evaluate the objective function at each and choose the largest (or smallest) value. Substitute and simplify. $(0,2):4;\ (0,5):10;\ (1,0):5;\ (10,0):50$ Part (ii) Find the corner points of the feasible region, evaluate the objective function at each and choose the largest (or smallest) value. Substitute and simplify. $(0,2):42;\ (1,0):7;\ (3,0):21$ The printed key gives the maximum as 84 at $(0,4)$, but $(0,4)$ violates $2x+3y\le6$; the minimum 7 at $(1,0)$ agrees.

items.q: A company manufactures two models of bicycles, model A and model B by using two machines $M_1$ and $M_2$. Machine $M_1$ has at most 120 hours available and machine $M_2$ has a maximum of 144 hours available. Manufacturing a model A bicycle requires 5 hours in machine $M_1$ and 4 hours in machine $M_2$ and manufacturing of a model B bicycle requires 4 hours in machine $M_1$ and 8 hours in machine $M_2$. items.a: (i) $\frac{\sqrt6-\sqrt2}4$; (ii) $2+\sqrt3$; (iii) $-2-\sqrt3$; (iv) $2+\sqrt3$; (v) $\frac{\sqrt6+\sqrt2}4$; (vi) $\frac{\sqrt6+\sqrt2}4$

Substitute and simplify. $\cos(u+v)=\tfrac45\tfrac35-\tfrac35\tfrac45=0$ Substitute and simplify. $\tan u=\tfrac34,\ \tan v=\tfrac43:\ \tan(u-v)=\frac{3/4-4/3}{1+1}=-\tfrac7{24}$ Substitute and simplify. $\sin(u-v)=\tfrac35\tfrac35-\tfrac45\tfrac45=-\tfrac7{25}$ Substitute and simplify. $\cos(u-v)=\tfrac45\tfrac35+\tfrac35\tfrac45=\tfrac{24}{25}$

items.q: If $\sin\alpha=-\dfrac45$ and $\cos\beta=-\dfrac{12}{13}$, $\alpha$ in Quadrant III and $\beta$ in Quadrant II, find the exact value of: (i) $\sin(\alpha-\beta)$ (ii) $\cos(\alpha+\beta)$ (iii) $\tan(\alpha+\beta)$
items.q2: اگر $\sin\alpha=-\dfrac45$ اور $\cos\beta=-\dfrac{12}{13}$، $\alpha$ تیسرے ربع میں اور $\beta$ دوسرے ربع میں ہو تو صحیح قیمت معلوم کریں: (i) $\sin(\alpha-\beta)$ (ii) $\cos(\alpha+\beta)$ (iii) $\tan(\alpha+\beta)$
items.q3: که $\sin\alpha=-\dfrac45$ او $\cos\beta=-\dfrac{12}{13}$، $\alpha$ په دریم ربع او $\beta$ په دویم ربع کې وي نو دقیق ارزښت پیدا کړئ: (i) $\sin(\alpha-\beta)$ (ii) $\cos(\alpha+\beta)$ (iii) $\tan(\alpha+\beta)$
items.e: $\alpha$ in III: $\cos\alpha=-\frac35$. $\beta$ in II: $\sin\beta=\frac5{13}$. Substitute and simplify. $\sin(\alpha-\beta)=\left(-\tfrac45\right)\left(-\tfrac{12}{13}\right)-\left(-\tfrac35\right)\tfrac5{13}=\tfrac{48+15}{65}=\tfrac{63}{65}$ Substitute and simplify. $\cos(\alpha+\beta)=\left(-\tfrac35\right)\left(-\tfrac{12}{13}\right)-\left(-\tfrac45\right)\tfrac5{13}=\tfrac{36+20}{65}=\tfrac{56}{65}$ Substitute and simplify. $\sin(\alpha+\beta)=\left(-\tfrac45\right)\left(-\tfrac{12}{13}\right)+\left(-\tfrac35\right)\tfrac5{13}=\tfrac{33}{65}\Rightarrow\tan(\alpha+\beta)=\tfrac{33/65}{56/65}=\tfrac{33}{56}$

items.q: If $\tan\alpha=\dfrac34$, $\sec\beta=\dfrac{13}5$, and neither the terminal side of the angle of measure $\alpha$ nor $\beta$ in the first quadrant, then find: (i) $\sin(\alpha+\beta)$ (ii) $\cos(\alpha+\beta)$ (iii) $\tan(\alpha+\beta)$
items.q2: اگر $\tan\alpha=\dfrac34$، $\sec\beta=\dfrac{13}5$ ہو اور نہ $\alpha$ اور نہ $\beta$ کا انتہائی بازو پہلے ربع میں ہو تو معلوم کریں: (i) $\sin(\alpha+\beta)$ (ii) $\cos(\alpha+\beta)$ (iii) $\tan(\alpha+\beta)$
items.q3: که $\tan\alpha=\dfrac34$، $\sec\beta=\dfrac{13}5$ وي او نه د $\alpha$ او نه د $\beta$ وروستی لوری په لومړي ربع کې وي نو پیدا کړئ: (i) $\sin(\alpha+\beta)$ (ii) $\cos(\alpha+\beta)$ (iii) $\tan(\alpha+\beta)$
items.e: $\tan\alpha=\frac34>0$ with $\alpha$ not in I gives $\alpha$ in III: $\sin\alpha=-\frac35,\cos\alpha=-\frac45$. $\sec\beta=\frac{13}5>0$ with $\beta$ not in I gives $\beta$ in IV: $\cos\beta=\frac5{13},\sin\beta=-\frac{12}{13}$. Substitute and simplify. $\sin(\alpha+\beta)=\left(-\tfrac35\right)\tfrac5{13}+\left(-\tfrac45\right)\left(-\tfrac{12}{13}\right)=\tfrac{-15+48}{65}=\tfrac{33}{65}$ Substitute and simplify. $\cos(\alpha+\beta)=\left(-\tfrac45\right)\tfrac5{13}-\left(-\tfrac35\right)\left(-\tfrac{12}{13}\right)=\tfrac{-20-36}{65}=-\tfrac{56}{65}$ Substitute and simplify. $\tan(\alpha+\beta)=\tfrac{33/65}{-56/65}=-\tfrac{33}{56}$

items.e: Substitute and simplify. $\text{(i) }\cos\alpha=\cos\left(2\cdot\tfrac\alpha2\right)=\cos^2\tfrac\alpha2-\sin^2\tfrac\alpha2=\cos^2\tfrac\alpha2-\left(1-\cos^2\tfrac\alpha2\right)=2\cos^2\tfrac\alpha2-1$ Substitute and simplify. $\cos\alpha=\left(1-\sin^2\tfrac\alpha2\right)-\sin^2\tfrac\alpha2=1-2\sin^2\tfrac\alpha2$ Substitute and simplify. $\text{(ii) }\sin(\alpha+\beta)\sin(\alpha-\beta)=\sin^2\alpha\cos^2\beta-\cos^2\alpha\sin^2\beta$ Substitute and simplify. $=(1-\cos^2\alpha)\cos^2\beta-\cos^2\alpha(1-\cos^2\beta)=\cos^2\beta-\cos^2\alpha$

items.q: Show that: (i) $\cot(\alpha+\beta)=\dfrac{\cot\alpha\cot\beta-1}{\cot\alpha+\cot\beta}$ (ii) $\dfrac{\sin(\alpha+\beta)}{\cos\alpha\cos\beta}=\tan\alpha+\tan\beta$
items.q2: دکھائیں کہ: (i) $\cot(\alpha+\beta)=\dfrac{\cot\alpha\cot\beta-1}{\cot\alpha+\cot\beta}$ (ii) $\dfrac{\sin(\alpha+\beta)}{\cos\alpha\cos\beta}=\tan\alpha+\tan\beta$
items.q3: وښایاست چې: (i) $\cot(\alpha+\beta)=\dfrac{\cot\alpha\cot\beta-1}{\cot\alpha+\cot\beta}$ (ii) $\dfrac{\sin(\alpha+\beta)}{\cos\alpha\cos\beta}=\tan\alpha+\tan\beta$
items.a: Proved.
items.e: Substitute and simplify. $\text{(i) }\cot(\alpha+\beta)=\frac{\cos\alpha\cos\beta-\sin\alpha\sin\beta}{\sin\alpha\cos\beta+\cos\alpha\sin\beta}$ Substitute and simplify. $\text{Divide numerator and denominator by }\sin\alpha\sin\beta:\ \frac{\cot\alpha\cot\beta-1}{\cot\beta+\cot\alpha}$ Substitute and simplify. $\text{(ii) }\frac{\sin(\alpha+\beta)}{\cos\alpha\cos\beta}=\frac{\sin\alpha\cos\beta+\cos\alpha\sin\beta}{\cos\alpha\cos\beta}=\tan\alpha+\tan\beta$

items.q: Prove that: $\dfrac{\sin\theta}{\sec4\theta}+\dfrac{\cos\theta}{\csc4\theta}=\sin5\theta$
items.q2: ثابت کریں کہ: $\dfrac{\sin\theta}{\sec4\theta}+\dfrac{\cos\theta}{\csc4\theta}=\sin5\theta$
items.q3: ثابته کړئ چې: $\dfrac{\sin\theta}{\sec4\theta}+\dfrac{\cos\theta}{\csc4\theta}=\sin5\theta$
items.a: Proved.
items.e: Substitute and simplify. $\frac{\sin\theta}{\sec4\theta}+\frac{\cos\theta}{\csc4\theta}=\sin\theta\cos4\theta+\cos\theta\sin4\theta=\sin(\theta+4\theta)=\sin5\theta$

items.q: Show that: $\dfrac{\sin(180^\circ-\alpha)\cos(270^\circ-\alpha)}{\sin(180^\circ+\alpha)\cos(270^\circ+\alpha)}=1$
items.q2: دکھائیں کہ: $\dfrac{\sin(180^\circ-\alpha)\cos(270^\circ-\alpha)}{\sin(180^\circ+\alpha)\cos(270^\circ+\alpha)}=1$
items.q3: وښایاست چې: $\dfrac{\sin(180^\circ-\alpha)\cos(270^\circ-\alpha)}{\sin(180^\circ+\alpha)\cos(270^\circ+\alpha)}=1$
items.a: Proved.
items.e: Substitute and simplify. $\sin(180^\circ-\alpha)=\sin\alpha,\ \cos(270^\circ-\alpha)=-\sin\alpha,\ \sin(180^\circ+\alpha)=-\sin\alpha,\ \cos(270^\circ+\alpha)=\sin\alpha$ Substitute and simplify. $\frac{(\sin\alpha)(-\sin\alpha)}{(-\sin\alpha)(\sin\alpha)}=\frac{-\sin^2\alpha}{-\sin^2\alpha}=1$

items.q: If $\alpha,\beta,\gamma$ are the angles of a triangle ABC, show that $\cot\dfrac\alpha2+\cot\dfrac\beta2+\cot\dfrac\gamma2=\cot\dfrac\alpha2\cot\dfrac\beta2\cot\dfrac\gamma2$
items.q2: اگر $\alpha,\beta,\gamma$ مثلث ABC کے زاویے ہوں تو دکھائیں کہ $\cot\dfrac\alpha2+\cot\dfrac\beta2+\cot\dfrac\gamma2=\cot\dfrac\alpha2\cot\dfrac\beta2\cot\dfrac\gamma2$
items.q3: که $\alpha,\beta,\gamma$ د مثلث ABC زاویې وي نو وښایاست چې $\cot\dfrac\alpha2+\cot\dfrac\beta2+\cot\dfrac\gamma2=\cot\dfrac\alpha2\cot\dfrac\beta2\cot\dfrac\gamma2$
items.a: Proved.
items.e: Substitute and simplify. $\tfrac\alpha2+\tfrac\beta2+\tfrac\gamma2=90^\circ\Rightarrow\cot\left(\tfrac\alpha2+\tfrac\beta2\right)=\cot\left(90^\circ-\tfrac\gamma2\right)=\tan\tfrac\gamma2=\frac1{\cot(\gamma/2)}$ Substitute and simplify. $\frac{\cot\frac\alpha2\cot\frac\beta2-1}{\cot\frac\alpha2+\cot\frac\beta2}=\frac1{\cot\frac\gamma2}\Rightarrow\cot\tfrac\gamma2\left(\cot\tfrac\alpha2\cot\tfrac\beta2-1\right)=\cot\tfrac\alpha2+\cot\tfrac\beta2$ Substitute and simplify. $\Rightarrow\cot\tfrac\alpha2\cot\tfrac\beta2\cot\tfrac\gamma2=\cot\tfrac\alpha2+\cot\tfrac\beta2+\cot\tfrac\gamma2$

items.q: If $\alpha+\beta+\gamma=180^\circ$, show that $\cot\alpha\cot\beta+\cot\beta\cot\gamma+\cot\gamma\cot\alpha=1$
items.q2: اگر $\alpha+\beta+\gamma=180^\circ$ ہو تو دکھائیں کہ $\cot\alpha\cot\beta+\cot\beta\cot\gamma+\cot\gamma\cot\alpha=1$
items.q3: که $\alpha+\beta+\gamma=180^\circ$ وي نو وښایاست چې $\cot\alpha\cot\beta+\cot\beta\cot\gamma+\cot\gamma\cot\alpha=1$
items.a: Proved.
items.e: Substitute and simplify. $\alpha+\beta=180^\circ-\gamma\Rightarrow\cot(\alpha+\beta)=-\cot\gamma$ Substitute and simplify. $\frac{\cot\alpha\cot\beta-1}{\cot\alpha+\cot\beta}=-\cot\gamma\Rightarrow\cot\alpha\cot\beta-1=-\cot\gamma\cot\alpha-\cot\gamma\cot\beta$ Substitute and simplify. $\Rightarrow\cot\alpha\cot\beta+\cot\beta\cot\gamma+\cot\gamma\cot\alpha=1$

items.q: Express each of the following in the form $r\sin(\theta+\phi)$ where terminal ray of $\theta$ and $\phi$ are in the first quadrant. (i) $4\sin\theta+3\cos\theta$ (ii) $15\sin\theta+8\cos\theta$ (iii) $2\sin\theta-5\cos\theta$ (iv) $\sin\theta+\cos\theta$
items.q2: ہر ایک کو $r\sin(\theta+\phi)$ کی صورت میں لکھیں جہاں $\theta$ اور $\phi$ کی انتہائی شعاعیں پہلے ربع میں ہیں۔ (i) $4\sin\theta+3\cos\theta$ (ii) $15\sin\theta+8\cos\theta$ (iii) $2\sin\theta-5\cos\theta$ (iv) $\sin\theta+\cos\theta$
items.q3: هر یو د $r\sin(\theta+\phi)$ په بڼه ولیکئ چېرته چې د $\theta$ او $\phi$ وروستي وړانګې په لومړي ربع کې دي. (i) $4\sin\theta+3\cos\theta$ (ii) $15\sin\theta+8\cos\theta$ (iii) $2\sin\theta-5\cos\theta$ (iv) $\sin\theta+\cos\theta$
items.a: (i) $5\sin(\theta+\phi)$, $\sin\phi=\frac35,\cos\phi=\frac45$; (ii) $17\sin(\theta+\phi)$, $\sin\phi=\frac8{17},\cos\phi=\frac{15}{17}$; (iii) $\sqrt{29}\sin(\theta+\phi)$, $\sin\phi=\frac{-5}{\sqrt{29}},\cos\phi=\frac2{\sqrt{29}}$; (iv) $\sqrt2\sin(\theta+\phi)$, $\sin\phi=\cos\phi=\frac1{\sqrt2}$
items.e: Write $a\sin\theta+b\cos\theta=r\sin(\theta+\phi)=r\sin\theta\cos\phi+r\cos\theta\sin\phi$, so $r\cos\phi=a$, $r\sin\phi=b$ and $r=\sqrt{a^2+b^2}$. Substitute and simplify. $\text{(i) }a=4,b=3:\ r=5,\ \cos\phi=\tfrac45,\ \sin\phi=\tfrac35;\quad\text{(ii) }a=15\ \text{(coefficient of }\sin),\ b=8:\ r=17,\ \cos\phi=\tfrac{15}{17},\ \sin\phi=\tfrac8{17}$ Substitute and simplify. $\text{(iii) }a=2,b=-5:\ r=\sqrt{29},\ \cos\phi=\tfrac2{\sqrt{29}},\ \sin\phi=\tfrac{-5}{\sqrt{29}};\quad\text{(iv) }a=b=1:\ r=\sqrt2,\ \cos\phi=\sin\phi=\tfrac1{\sqrt2}$ In (iii) $\phi$ is in the fourth quadrant, as the printed key also shows.

items.q: Find the values of $\sin2\theta$, $\cos2\theta$ and $\tan2\theta$, given $\tan\theta=-\dfrac15$, $\theta$ in quadrant II.
items.q2: $\sin2\theta$، $\cos2\theta$ اور $\tan2\theta$ کی قیمتیں معلوم کریں، دیا گیا ہے $\tan\theta=-\dfrac15$، $\theta$ دوسرے ربع میں ہے۔
items.q3: د $\sin2\theta$، $\cos2\theta$ او $\tan2\theta$ ارزښتونه پیدا کړئ، ورکړل شوی دی $\tan\theta=-\dfrac15$، $\theta$ په دویم ربع کې دی.
items.a: $\sin2\theta=-\frac5{13},\ \cos2\theta=\frac{12}{13},\ \tan2\theta=-\frac5{12}$
items.e: Use $\sin2\theta=2\sin\theta\cos\theta$, $\cos2\theta=\cos^2\theta-\sin^2\theta=2\cos^2\theta-1=1-2\sin^2\theta$, $\tan2\theta=\frac{2\tan\theta}{1-\tan^2\theta}$. Substitute and simplify. $\tan\theta=-\tfrac15,\ \theta\in\text{II}:\ \sin\theta=\tfrac1{\sqrt{26}},\ \cos\theta=-\tfrac5{\sqrt{26}}$ Substitute and simplify. $\sin2\theta=2\cdot\tfrac1{\sqrt{26}}\cdot\left(-\tfrac5{\sqrt{26}}\right)=-\tfrac5{13};\ \cos2\theta=\tfrac{25-1}{26}=\tfrac{12}{13};\ \tan2\theta=\tfrac{-5/13}{12/13}=-\tfrac5{12}$

items.q: If $\sin\theta=\dfrac5{13}$ and terminal ray of $\theta$ is in the second quadrant, then find (i) $\sin2\theta$ (ii) $\cos2\theta$ (iii) $\tan2\theta$
items.q2: اگر $\sin\theta=\dfrac5{13}$ اور $\theta$ کی انتہائی شعاع دوسرے ربع میں ہو تو معلوم کریں (i) $\sin2\theta$ (ii) $\cos2\theta$ (iii) $\tan2\theta$
items.q3: که $\sin\theta=\dfrac5{13}$ او د $\theta$ وروستۍ وړانګه په دویم ربع کې وي نو پیدا کړئ (i) $\sin2\theta$ (ii) $\cos2\theta$ (iii) $\tan2\theta$
items.e: Use $\sin2\theta=2\sin\theta\cos\theta$, $\cos2\theta=\cos^2\theta-\sin^2\theta=2\cos^2\theta-1=1-2\sin^2\theta$, $\tan2\theta=\frac{2\tan\theta}{1-\tan^2\theta}$. Substitute and simplify. $\sin\theta=\tfrac5{13},\ \theta\in\text{II}\Rightarrow\cos\theta=-\tfrac{12}{13}$ Substitute and simplify. $\sin2\theta=2\cdot\tfrac5{13}\left(-\tfrac{12}{13}\right)=-\tfrac{120}{169};\ \cos2\theta=1-2\cdot\tfrac{25}{169}=\tfrac{119}{169};\ \tan2\theta=-\tfrac{120}{119}$

items.q: If $\sin\theta=\dfrac45$ and terminal ray of $\theta$ is in the second quadrant, then find (i) $\sin2\theta$ (ii) $\cos\dfrac\theta2$
items.q2: اگر $\sin\theta=\dfrac45$ اور $\theta$ کی انتہائی شعاع دوسرے ربع میں ہو تو معلوم کریں (i) $\sin2\theta$ (ii) $\cos\dfrac\theta2$
items.q3: که $\sin\theta=\dfrac45$ او د $\theta$ وروستۍ وړانګه په دویم ربع کې وي نو پیدا کړئ (i) $\sin2\theta$ (ii) $\cos\dfrac\theta2$
items.e: Use $\sin2\theta=2\sin\theta\cos\theta$, $\cos2\theta=\cos^2\theta-\sin^2\theta=2\cos^2\theta-1=1-2\sin^2\theta$, $\tan2\theta=\frac{2\tan\theta}{1-\tan^2\theta}$. Use $\sin\frac\theta2=\pm\sqrt{\frac{1-\cos\theta}2}$, $\cos\frac\theta2=\pm\sqrt{\frac{1+\cos\theta}2}$, $\tan\frac\theta2=\frac{1-\cos\theta}{\sin\theta}$, choosing the sign from the quadrant of $\frac\theta2$. Substitute and simplify. $\sin\theta=\tfrac45,\ \cos\theta=-\tfrac35:\ \sin2\theta=2\cdot\tfrac45\left(-\tfrac35\right)=-\tfrac{24}{25}$ Substitute and simplify. $\theta\in\text{II}\Rightarrow\tfrac\theta2\in\text{I}:\ \cos\tfrac\theta2=\sqrt{\tfrac{1-3/5}2}=\sqrt{\tfrac15}=\tfrac1{\sqrt5}$

items.q: If $\cos\theta=-\dfrac37$ and terminal ray of $\theta$ is in 3rd quadrant, then find $\sin\dfrac\theta2$.
items.q2: اگر $\cos\theta=-\dfrac37$ اور $\theta$ کی انتہائی شعاع تیسرے ربع میں ہو تو $\sin\dfrac\theta2$ معلوم کریں۔
items.q3: که $\cos\theta=-\dfrac37$ او د $\theta$ وروستۍ وړانګه په دریم ربع کې وي نو $\sin\dfrac\theta2$ پیدا کړئ.
items.a: $\dfrac{\sqrt5}{\sqrt7}$
items.e: Use $\sin\frac\theta2=\pm\sqrt{\frac{1-\cos\theta}2}$, $\cos\frac\theta2=\pm\sqrt{\frac{1+\cos\theta}2}$, $\tan\frac\theta2=\frac{1-\cos\theta}{\sin\theta}$, choosing the sign from the quadrant of $\frac\theta2$. Substitute and simplify. $\theta\in\text{III}\Rightarrow\tfrac\theta2\in\text{II}\ (\sin>0):\ \sin\tfrac\theta2=\sqrt{\tfrac{1+3/7}2}=\sqrt{\tfrac57}=\tfrac{\sqrt5}{\sqrt7}$

items.q: Use double angle identities to evaluate exactly. (i) $\sin\dfrac{2\pi}3$ (ii) $\cos\dfrac{2\pi}3$
items.q2: دوہرے زاویے کی مماثلتیں استعمال کر کے صحیح قیمت معلوم کریں۔ (i) $\sin\dfrac{2\pi}3$ (ii) $\cos\dfrac{2\pi}3$
items.q3: د دوه چنده زاویې هویتونه په کارولو دقیق ارزول. (i) $\sin\dfrac{2\pi}3$ (ii) $\cos\dfrac{2\pi}3$
items.a: (i) $\frac{\sqrt3}2$; (ii) $-\frac12$
items.e: Use $\sin2\theta=2\sin\theta\cos\theta$, $\cos2\theta=\cos^2\theta-\sin^2\theta=2\cos^2\theta-1=1-2\sin^2\theta$, $\tan2\theta=\frac{2\tan\theta}{1-\tan^2\theta}$. Substitute and simplify. $\sin\tfrac{2\pi}3=2\sin\tfrac\pi3\cos\tfrac\pi3=2\cdot\tfrac{\sqrt3}2\cdot\tfrac12=\tfrac{\sqrt3}2$ Substitute and simplify. $\cos\tfrac{2\pi}3=2\cos^2\tfrac\pi3-1=2\cdot\tfrac14-1=-\tfrac12$

items.q: $\cot2\theta=\dfrac12\left(\cot\theta-\dfrac1{\cot\theta}\right)$

items.q: $\dfrac{\sin\alpha+\cos\alpha}{\cos\alpha-\sin\alpha}+\dfrac{\sin\alpha-\cos\alpha}{\cos\alpha+\sin\alpha}=2\tan2\alpha$

items.q: $\sin6x\sin x+\cos4x\cos3x=\cos3x\cos2x$
items.q2: $\sin6x\sin x+\cos4x\cos3x=\cos3x\cos2x$
items.q3: $\sin6x\sin x+\cos4x\cos3x=\cos3x\cos2x$
items.a: Proved.
items.e: Substitute and simplify. $\sin6x\sin x=\tfrac12(\cos5x-\cos7x),\quad\cos4x\cos3x=\tfrac12(\cos7x+\cos x)$ Substitute and simplify. $\text{Sum}=\tfrac12(\cos5x+\cos x)=\tfrac12\cdot2\cos3x\cos2x=\cos3x\cos2x$

items.q: $\dfrac{\sin^2(\pi+\theta)\tan\left(\frac{3\pi}2+\theta\right)}{\cot^2\left(\frac{3\pi}2-\theta\right)\cos^2(\pi-\theta)\csc(2\pi-\theta)}=\cos\theta$

items.q3: $\dfrac{\sin^2(\pi+\theta)\tan\left(\frac{3\pi}2+\theta\right)}{\cot^2\left(\frac{3\pi}2-\theta\right)\cos^2(\pi-\theta)\csc(2\pi-\theta)}=\cos\theta$
items.a: Proved.
items.e: Substitute and simplify. $\sin^2(\pi+\theta)=\sin^2\theta,\ \tan\left(\tfrac{3\pi}2+\theta\right)=-\cot\theta,\ \cot^2\left(\tfrac{3\pi}2-\theta\right)=\tan^2\theta,\ \cos^2(\pi-\theta)=\cos^2\theta,\ \csc(2\pi-\theta)=-\csc\theta$ Substitute and simplify. $\frac{\sin^2\theta(-\cot\theta)}{\tan^2\theta\cos^2\theta(-\csc\theta)}=\frac{\sin^2\theta\cot\theta}{\sin^2\theta\csc\theta}=\frac{\cot\theta}{\csc\theta}=\cos\theta$

items.e: Substitute and simplify. $\cos(90^\circ+\theta)=-\sin\theta,\ \sec(-\theta)=\sec\theta,\ \tan(180^\circ-\theta)=-\tan\theta,\ \sec(360^\circ-\theta)=\sec\theta,\ \sin(180^\circ+\theta)=-\sin\theta,\ \cot(90^\circ-\theta)=\tan\theta$ Substitute and simplify. $\frac{(-\sin\theta)(\sec\theta)(-\tan\theta)}{(\sec\theta)(-\sin\theta)(\tan\theta)}=\frac{\sin\theta\sec\theta\tan\theta}{-\sin\theta\sec\theta\tan\theta}=-1$
